phrases.text: 一只小鸟很渴。
phrases.pinyin: yì zhī xiǎo niǎo hěn kě
phrases.translation: A little bird was very thirsty.

phrases.text: 它想喝水。
phrases.pinyin: tā xiǎng hē shuǐ
phrases.translation: It wanted to drink water.

phrases.text: 它看到一个瓶子。
phrases.pinyin: tā kàndào yí ge píngzi
phrases.translation: It saw a bottle.

phrases.text: 瓶子里有水,可是水很少。
phrases.pinyin: píngzi lǐ yǒu shuǐ kěshì shuǐ hěn shǎo
phrases.translation: There was water in the bottle, but very little.

phrases.text: 小鸟喝不到水。
phrases.pinyin: xiǎo niǎo hē bú dào shuǐ
phrases.translation: The bird could not reach the water.

phrases.text: 它想了想,看到旁边有小石头。
phrases.pinyin: tā xiǎng le xiǎng kàndào pángbiān yǒu xiǎo shítou
phrases.translation: It thought, and saw small stones nearby.

phrases.text: 小鸟把石头一个一个放进瓶子里。
phrases.pinyin: xiǎo niǎo bǎ shítou yí ge yí ge fàngjìn píngzi lǐ
phrases.translation: The bird dropped the stones into the bottle, one by one.

phrases.text: 水慢慢升上来了。
phrases.pinyin: shuǐ mànmàn shēng shànglai le
phrases.translation: The water slowly rose up.

phrases.text: 最后,小鸟喝到了水。
phrases.pinyin: zuìhòu xiǎo niǎo hēdào le shuǐ
phrases.translation: At last, the bird drank the water.

phrases.text: 小鸟真聪明!
phrases.pinyin: xiǎo niǎo zhēn cōngmíng
phrases.translation: The bird is very clever!

phrases.text: 大熊猫是中国的国宝。
phrases.pinyin: dà xióngmāo shì Zhōngguó de guóbǎo
phrases.translation: The giant panda is China's national treasure.

phrases.text: 熊猫住在中国西南的山里。
phrases.pinyin: xióngmāo zhù zài Zhōngguó xīnán de shān lǐ
phrases.translation: Pandas live in the mountains of southwestern China.

phrases.text: 它们有黑白的毛。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen yǒu hēibái de máo
phrases.translation: They have black and white fur.

phrases.text: 熊猫最喜欢吃竹子。
phrases.pinyin: xióngmāo zuì xǐhuan chī zhúzi
phrases.translation: Pandas love eating bamboo.

phrases.text: 它们每天吃十几个小时的竹子。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen měi tiān chī shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí de zhúzi
phrases.translation: They eat bamboo for over ten hours every day.

phrases.text: 早上它们睡觉,下午爬树。
phrases.pinyin: zǎoshang tāmen shuìjiào xiàwǔ pá shù
phrases.translation: In the morning they sleep; in the afternoon they climb trees.

phrases.text: 小熊猫刚生的时候是粉色的。
phrases.pinyin: xiǎo xióngmāo gāng shēng de shíhou shì fěnsè de
phrases.translation: Baby pandas are pink at first.

phrases.text: 很多游客从世界各地来看它们。
phrases.pinyin: hěn duō yóukè cóng shìjiè gèdì lái kàn tāmen
phrases.translation: Many tourists come from all over the world to see them.

phrases.text: 熊猫真可爱!
phrases.pinyin: xióngmāo zhēn kě'ài
phrases.translation: Pandas are really cute.

phrases.text: 你好!
phrases.pinyin: nǐ hǎo
phrases.translation: Hello!

phrases.text: 我是李明。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shì Lǐ Míng
phrases.translation: I am Li Ming.

phrases.text: 我是中国人。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shì Zhōngguórén
phrases.translation: I am Chinese.

phrases.text: 你叫什么名字?
phrases.pinyin: nǐ jiào shénme míngzi
phrases.translation: What is your name?

phrases.text: 我叫王小文。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiào Wáng Xiǎowén
phrases.translation: My name is Wang Xiaowen.

phrases.text: 很高兴认识你。
phrases.pinyin: hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ
phrases.translation: Nice to meet you.

phrases.text: 我家有四个人。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu sì gè rén
phrases.translation: My family has four people.

phrases.text: 爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。
phrases.pinyin: bàba māma jiějie hé wǒ
phrases.translation: Dad, mom, older sister, and me.

phrases.text: 爸爸是医生。
phrases.pinyin: bàba shì yīshēng
phrases.translation: Dad is a doctor.

phrases.text: 妈妈是老师。
phrases.pinyin: māma shì lǎoshī
phrases.translation: Mom is a teacher.

phrases.text: 姐姐是学生。
phrases.pinyin: jiějie shì xuésheng
phrases.translation: Older sister is a student.

phrases.text: 我爱我的家。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ ài wǒ de jiā
phrases.translation: I love my family.

phrases.text: 我饿了。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ è le
phrases.translation: I am hungry.

phrases.text: 我想吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng chī fàn
phrases.translation: I want to eat.

phrases.text: 我喜欢吃米饭。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan chī mǐfàn
phrases.translation: I like to eat rice.

phrases.text: 我也喜欢面条。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yě xǐhuan miàntiáo
phrases.translation: I also like noodles.

phrases.text: 妈妈做饭很好吃。
phrases.pinyin: māma zuò fàn hěn hǎochī
phrases.translation: Mom's cooking is delicious.

phrases.text: 谢谢妈妈!
phrases.pinyin: xièxie māma
phrases.translation: Thank you, Mom!

phrases.text: 今天我去商店。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ qù shāngdiàn
phrases.translation: Today I'm going to the store.

phrases.text: 我要买苹果。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yào mǎi píngguǒ
phrases.translation: I want to buy apples.

phrases.text: 苹果多少钱?
phrases.pinyin: píngguǒ duōshao qián
phrases.translation: How much are the apples?

phrases.text: 五块钱一斤。
phrases.pinyin: wǔ kuài qián yī jīn
phrases.translation: Five yuan per jin (500g).

phrases.text: 我买两斤。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ mǎi liǎng jīn
phrases.translation: I'll buy two jin.

phrases.text: 谢谢,再见!
phrases.pinyin: xièxie zàijiàn
phrases.translation: Thanks, goodbye!

phrases.text: 我学中文。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xué Zhōngwén
phrases.translation: I study Chinese.

phrases.text: 中文很有意思。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngwén hěn yǒu yìsi
phrases.translation: Chinese is very interesting.

phrases.text: 我的老师是中国人。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de lǎoshī shì Zhōngguórén
phrases.translation: My teacher is Chinese.

phrases.text: 她很好。
phrases.pinyin: tā hěn hǎo
phrases.translation: She is very nice.

phrases.text: 我每天学习。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān xuéxí
phrases.translation: I study every day.

phrases.text: 我想去中国。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó
phrases.translation: I want to go to China.

phrases.text: 今天天气很好。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo
phrases.translation: Today's weather is very nice.

phrases.text: 太阳很大。
phrases.pinyin: tàiyáng hěn dà
phrases.translation: The sun is strong.

phrases.text: 不冷也不热。
phrases.pinyin: bù lěng yě bù rè
phrases.translation: Not cold, not hot either.

phrases.text: 我想去公园。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù gōngyuán
phrases.translation: I want to go to the park.

phrases.text: 公园有很多花。
phrases.pinyin: gōngyuán yǒu hěnduō huā
phrases.translation: The park has many flowers.

phrases.text: 真漂亮!
phrases.pinyin: zhēn piàoliang
phrases.translation: So pretty!

phrases.text: 我的老师姓王。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de lǎoshī xìng Wáng
phrases.translation: My teacher's surname is Wang.

phrases.text: 她很年轻。
phrases.pinyin: tā hěn niánqīng
phrases.translation: She is very young.

phrases.text: 她教我们英文。
phrases.pinyin: tā jiāo wǒmen Yīngwén
phrases.translation: She teaches us English.

phrases.text: 她的课很有意思。
phrases.pinyin: tā de kè hěn yǒu yìsi
phrases.translation: Her class is very interesting.

phrases.text: 我们都很喜欢她。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen dōu hěn xǐhuan tā
phrases.translation: We all like her very much.

phrases.text: 她常常笑。
phrases.pinyin: tā chángcháng xiào
phrases.translation: She often smiles.

phrases.text: 中国人喜欢喝茶。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngguórén xǐhuan hē chá
phrases.translation: Chinese people like drinking tea.

phrases.text: 我也喜欢。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yě xǐhuan
phrases.translation: I like it too.

phrases.text: 爷爷每天早上喝茶。
phrases.pinyin: yéye měitiān zǎoshang hē chá
phrases.translation: Grandpa drinks tea every morning.

phrases.text: 他说茶对身体好。
phrases.pinyin: tā shuō chá duì shēntǐ hǎo
phrases.translation: He says tea is good for the body.

phrases.text: 我最喜欢绿茶。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan lǜchá
phrases.translation: I like green tea the most.

phrases.text: 喝茶让我觉得放松。
phrases.pinyin: hē chá ràng wǒ juéde fàngsōng
phrases.translation: Drinking tea makes me feel relaxed.

phrases.text: 我很爱音乐。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hěn ài yīnyuè
phrases.translation: I love music very much.

phrases.text: 我每天都听歌。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān dōu tīng gē
phrases.translation: I listen to songs every day.

phrases.text: 我喜欢中文歌。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan Zhōngwén gē
phrases.translation: I like Chinese songs.

phrases.text: 也喜欢英文歌。
phrases.pinyin: yě xǐhuan Yīngwén gē
phrases.translation: I also like English songs.

phrases.text: 我也会唱歌。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yě huì chànggē
phrases.translation: I can also sing.

phrases.text: 音乐让我开心。
phrases.pinyin: yīnyuè ràng wǒ kāixīn
phrases.translation: Music makes me happy.

phrases.text: 我有一只小狗。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yǒu yì zhī xiǎogǒu
phrases.translation: I have a little dog.

phrases.text: 它叫豆豆。
phrases.pinyin: tā jiào Dòudou
phrases.translation: It is called Doudou.

phrases.text: 它很可爱。
phrases.pinyin: tā hěn kě'ài
phrases.translation: It is very cute.

phrases.text: 它很喜欢跑。
phrases.pinyin: tā hěn xǐhuan pǎo
phrases.translation: It loves to run.

phrases.text: 每天下午我带它出去。
phrases.pinyin: měitiān xiàwǔ wǒ dài tā chūqù
phrases.translation: Every afternoon I take it out.

phrases.text: 豆豆是我最好的朋友。
phrases.pinyin: Dòudou shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou
phrases.translation: Doudou is my best friend.

phrases.text: 这是我的房间。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de fángjiān
phrases.translation: This is my room.

phrases.text: 我的房间不大,可是很干净。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de fángjiān bú dà kěshì hěn gānjìng
phrases.translation: My room is not big, but it is very clean.

phrases.text: 房间里有一张床。
phrases.pinyin: fángjiān lǐ yǒu yì zhāng chuáng
phrases.translation: There is a bed in the room.

phrases.text: 床的旁边有一个书桌。
phrases.pinyin: chuáng de pángbiān yǒu yí ge shūzhuō
phrases.translation: Next to the bed there is a desk.

phrases.text: 书桌上有很多书。
phrases.pinyin: shūzhuō shàng yǒu hěn duō shū
phrases.translation: There are many books on the desk.

phrases.text: 我喜欢在这里看书。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan zài zhèlǐ kàn shū
phrases.translation: I like to read here.

phrases.text: 我的房间有一个窗户。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de fángjiān yǒu yí ge chuānghu
phrases.translation: My room has a window.

phrases.text: 从窗户可以看见外面的树。
phrases.pinyin: cóng chuānghu kěyǐ kànjiàn wàimiàn de shù
phrases.translation: From the window I can see the trees outside.

phrases.text: 我每天七点起床。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng
phrases.translation: I get up at seven every day.

phrases.text: 起床以后,我吃早饭。
phrases.pinyin: qǐchuáng yǐhòu wǒ chī zǎofàn
phrases.translation: After getting up, I eat breakfast.

phrases.text: 我八点去上班。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ bā diǎn qù shàngbān
phrases.translation: I go to work at eight.

phrases.text: 中午我在公司吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: zhōngwǔ wǒ zài gōngsī chī fàn
phrases.translation: At noon I eat at the company.

phrases.text: 下午我很忙。
phrases.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒ hěn máng
phrases.translation: In the afternoon I am very busy.

phrases.text: 六点我回家。
phrases.pinyin: liù diǎn wǒ huí jiā
phrases.translation: I go home at six.

phrases.text: 晚上我看电视,也看书。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒ kàn diànshì yě kàn shū
phrases.translation: In the evening I watch TV and also read.

phrases.text: 我十一点睡觉。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shíyī diǎn shuìjiào
phrases.translation: I go to sleep at eleven.

phrases.text: 我家离公司很远。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiā lí gōngsī hěn yuǎn
phrases.translation: My home is far from the company.

phrases.text: 我每天坐公共汽车去上班。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù shàngbān
phrases.translation: Every day I take the bus to work.

phrases.text: 车站在我家前面。
phrases.pinyin: chēzhàn zài wǒ jiā qiánmiàn
phrases.translation: The bus stop is in front of my home.

phrases.text: 我坐三路车。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuò sān lù chē
phrases.translation: I take the number three bus.

phrases.text: 车上人很多。
phrases.pinyin: chē shàng rén hěn duō
phrases.translation: There are many people on the bus.

phrases.text: 我常常站着。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ chángcháng zhàn zhe
phrases.translation: I often stand.

phrases.text: 二十分钟以后,我到公司。
phrases.pinyin: èrshí fēnzhōng yǐhòu wǒ dào gōngsī
phrases.translation: Twenty minutes later, I arrive at the company.

phrases.text: 坐车不贵,只要两块钱。
phrases.pinyin: zuò chē bú guì zhǐ yào liǎng kuài qián
phrases.translation: The bus is not expensive — only two yuan.

phrases.text: 我有一个好朋友。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yǒu yí ge hǎo péngyou
phrases.translation: I have a good friend.

phrases.text: 她叫小美。
phrases.pinyin: tā jiào Xiǎoměi
phrases.translation: She is called Xiaomei.

phrases.text: 她是中国人,住在北京。
phrases.pinyin: tā shì Zhōngguó rén zhù zài Běijīng
phrases.translation: She is Chinese and lives in Beijing.

phrases.text: 小美很高,也很漂亮。
phrases.pinyin: Xiǎoměi hěn gāo yě hěn piàoliang
phrases.translation: Xiaomei is tall and also very pretty.

phrases.text: 她喜欢看电影。
phrases.pinyin: tā xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng
phrases.translation: She likes watching films.

phrases.text: 我们常常一起吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ chī fàn
phrases.translation: We often eat together.

phrases.text: 她的中文很好,我的不太好。
phrases.pinyin: tā de Zhōngwén hěn hǎo wǒ de bú tài hǎo
phrases.translation: Her Chinese is very good; mine is not very good.

phrases.text: 所以她教我中文。
phrases.pinyin: suǒyǐ tā jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén
phrases.translation: So she teaches me Chinese.

phrases.text: 今天我和朋友去饭馆吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ hé péngyou qù fànguǎn chī fàn
phrases.translation: Today my friend and I went to a restaurant to eat.

phrases.text: 服务员给我们菜单。
phrases.pinyin: fúwùyuán gěi wǒmen càidān
phrases.translation: The waiter gave us a menu.

phrases.text: 我看了看,不知道吃什么。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ kàn le kàn bù zhīdào chī shénme
phrases.translation: I looked at it and did not know what to eat.

phrases.text: 朋友说:"这里的鱼很好吃。"
phrases.pinyin: péngyou shuō zhèlǐ de yú hěn hǎochī
phrases.translation: My friend said: "The fish here is very tasty."

phrases.text: 我们点了鱼和青菜。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen diǎn le yú hé qīngcài
phrases.translation: We ordered fish and green vegetables.

phrases.text: 我们还要了两碗米饭。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen hái yào le liǎng wǎn mǐfàn
phrases.translation: We also asked for two bowls of rice.

phrases.text: 菜很快就来了。
phrases.pinyin: cài hěn kuài jiù lái le
phrases.translation: The food came very quickly.

phrases.text: 我们吃得很好,一共八十块。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen chī de hěn hǎo yígòng bāshí kuài
phrases.translation: We ate very well; in total it was eighty yuan.

phrases.text: 一年有四个季节。
phrases.pinyin: yì nián yǒu sì ge jìjié
phrases.translation: A year has four seasons.

phrases.text: 春天不冷也不热。
phrases.pinyin: chūntiān bù lěng yě bú rè
phrases.translation: Spring is neither cold nor hot.

phrases.text: 春天的花很漂亮。
phrases.pinyin: chūntiān de huā hěn piàoliang
phrases.translation: The spring flowers are very pretty.

phrases.text: 夏天很热,我常常游泳。
phrases.pinyin: xiàtiān hěn rè wǒ chángcháng yóuyǒng
phrases.translation: Summer is very hot, and I often swim.

phrases.text: 秋天的天气最好。
phrases.pinyin: qiūtiān de tiānqì zuì hǎo
phrases.translation: The autumn weather is the best.

phrases.text: 秋天有很多水果。
phrases.pinyin: qiūtiān yǒu hěn duō shuǐguǒ
phrases.translation: In autumn there is a lot of fruit.

phrases.text: 冬天很冷,有时候下雪。
phrases.pinyin: dōngtiān hěn lěng yǒu shíhou xià xuě
phrases.translation: Winter is very cold, and sometimes it snows.

phrases.text: 我最喜欢秋天。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan qiūtiān
phrases.translation: I like autumn best.

phrases.text: 我是学生,今年十二岁。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shì xuésheng jīnnián shí'èr suì
phrases.translation: I am a student, and I am twelve this year.

phrases.text: 我的学校不远。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de xuéxiào bù yuǎn
phrases.translation: My school is not far.

phrases.text: 我每天走路去学校。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān zǒu lù qù xuéxiào
phrases.translation: Every day I walk to school.

phrases.text: 路上要十五分钟。
phrases.pinyin: lù shàng yào shíwǔ fēnzhōng
phrases.translation: The way takes fifteen minutes.

phrases.text: 我早上八点到学校。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zǎoshang bā diǎn dào xuéxiào
phrases.translation: I arrive at school at eight in the morning.

phrases.text: 我们上午有四节课。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen shàngwǔ yǒu sì jié kè
phrases.translation: We have four classes in the morning.

phrases.text: 我最喜欢中文课。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan Zhōngwén kè
phrases.translation: I like the Chinese class best.

phrases.text: 下午四点我回家。
phrases.pinyin: xiàwǔ sì diǎn wǒ huí jiā
phrases.translation: At four in the afternoon I go home.

phrases.text: 今天是我的生日。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì
phrases.translation: Today is my birthday.

phrases.text: 我今年二十岁。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jīnnián èrshí suì
phrases.translation: I am twenty this year.

phrases.text: 妈妈做了很多好吃的菜。
phrases.pinyin: māma zuò le hěn duō hǎochī de cài
phrases.translation: Mother made many tasty dishes.

phrases.text: 朋友们都来了。
phrases.pinyin: péngyou men dōu lái le
phrases.translation: All my friends came.

phrases.text: 他们给我很多礼物。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen gěi wǒ hěn duō lǐwù
phrases.translation: They gave me many presents.

phrases.text: 我们一起吃蛋糕。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo
phrases.translation: We ate cake together.

phrases.text: 大家唱歌,很热闹。
phrases.pinyin: dàjiā chàng gē hěn rènao
phrases.translation: Everyone sang, and it was very lively.

phrases.text: 这是一个很好的生日。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì yí ge hěn hǎo de shēngrì
phrases.translation: This was a very good birthday.

phrases.text: 我们家的人喜欢不同的颜色。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen jiā de rén xǐhuan bùtóng de yánsè
phrases.translation: The people in our family like different colors.

phrases.text: 我喜欢蓝色。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan lánsè
phrases.translation: I like blue.

phrases.text: 我的衣服很多都是蓝的。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de yīfu hěn duō dōu shì lán de
phrases.translation: Many of my clothes are blue.

phrases.text: 妈妈喜欢红色。
phrases.pinyin: māma xǐhuan hóngsè
phrases.translation: Mother likes red.

phrases.text: 她说红色很好看。
phrases.pinyin: tā shuō hóngsè hěn hǎokàn
phrases.translation: She says red looks very good.

phrases.text: 爸爸喜欢黑色和白色。
phrases.pinyin: bàba xǐhuan hēisè hé báisè
phrases.translation: Father likes black and white.

phrases.text: 我妹妹最喜欢黄色。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ mèimei zuì xǐhuan huángsè
phrases.translation: My younger sister likes yellow best.

phrases.text: 她的房间里都是黄色的东西。
phrases.pinyin: tā de fángjiān lǐ dōu shì huángsè de dōngxi
phrases.translation: Everything in her room is yellow.

phrases.text: 我想去火车站,可是不认识路。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù huǒchē zhàn kěshì bù rènshi lù
phrases.translation: I wanted to go to the train station, but I did not know the way.

phrases.text: 我问一个人:"请问,火车站在哪儿?"
phrases.pinyin: wǒ wèn yí ge rén qǐngwèn huǒchē zhàn zài nǎr
phrases.translation: I asked someone: "Excuse me, where is the train station?"

phrases.text: 他说:"你往前走。"
phrases.pinyin: tā shuō nǐ wǎng qián zǒu
phrases.translation: He said: "Walk straight ahead."

phrases.text: "到那个路口往右拐。"
phrases.pinyin: dào nà ge lùkǒu wǎng yòu guǎi
phrases.translation: "At that crossing, turn right."

phrases.text: "走五分钟就到了。"
phrases.pinyin: zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le
phrases.translation: "Walk five minutes and you are there."

phrases.text: 他说:"不客气。"
phrases.pinyin: tā shuō bú kèqi
phrases.translation: He said: "You're welcome."

phrases.text: 我很快就找到了火车站。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hěn kuài jiù zhǎo dào le huǒchē zhàn
phrases.translation: I found the train station very quickly.

phrases.text: 周末我常常和朋友一起出去。
phrases.pinyin: zhōumò wǒ chángcháng hé péngyou yìqǐ chūqù
phrases.translation: On weekends I often go out with friends.

phrases.text: 星期六早上我们去跑步。
phrases.pinyin: xīngqīliù zǎoshang wǒmen qù pǎobù
phrases.translation: Saturday morning we go running.

phrases.text: 下午我们一起吃午饭。
phrases.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒmen yìqǐ chī wǔfàn
phrases.translation: In the afternoon we eat lunch together.

phrases.text: 晚上我在家看电影。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒ zài jiā kàn diànyǐng
phrases.translation: In the evening I watch movies at home.

phrases.text: 星期天我睡得很晚。
phrases.pinyin: xīngqītiān wǒ shuì de hěn wǎn
phrases.translation: On Sunday I sleep in late.

phrases.text: 然后我做作业。
phrases.pinyin: ránhòu wǒ zuò zuòyè
phrases.translation: Then I do homework.

phrases.text: 我的周末很开心。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de zhōumò hěn kāixīn
phrases.translation: My weekend is very happy.

phrases.text: 下个月我要去北京旅游。
phrases.pinyin: xià gè yuè wǒ yào qù Běijīng lǚyóu
phrases.translation: Next month I'm going to travel to Beijing.

phrases.text: 我想看长城。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kàn Chángchéng
phrases.translation: I want to see the Great Wall.

phrases.text: 我还想吃北京烤鸭。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hái xiǎng chī Běijīng kǎoyā
phrases.translation: I also want to eat Beijing roast duck.

phrases.text: 我的朋友住在北京。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de péngyou zhù zài Běijīng
phrases.translation: My friend lives in Beijing.

phrases.text: 他会带我去很多地方。
phrases.pinyin: tā huì dài wǒ qù hěnduō dìfang
phrases.translation: He will take me to many places.

phrases.text: 我已经买好机票了。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yǐjīng mǎi hǎo jīpiào le
phrases.translation: I have already bought my plane ticket.

phrases.text: 我很期待!
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hěn qīdài
phrases.translation: I'm really looking forward to it!

phrases.text: 每天早上我都去咖啡店。
phrases.pinyin: měitiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu qù kāfēidiàn
phrases.translation: Every morning I go to the coffee shop.

phrases.text: 那里的咖啡很好喝。
phrases.pinyin: nàlǐ de kāfēi hěn hǎohē
phrases.translation: The coffee there is very good.

phrases.text: 我常常点一杯拿铁。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ chángcháng diǎn yī bēi nátiě
phrases.translation: I often order a latte.

phrases.text: 服务员认识我了。
phrases.pinyin: fúwùyuán rènshi wǒ le
phrases.translation: The waiter knows me now.

phrases.text: 我喜欢坐在窗边看书。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan zuò zài chuāngbiān kàn shū
phrases.translation: I like to sit by the window and read.

phrases.text: 咖啡店里很安静。
phrases.pinyin: kāfēidiàn lǐ hěn ānjìng
phrases.translation: Inside the coffee shop it's very quiet.

phrases.text: 这是我最喜欢的地方。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de dìfang
phrases.translation: This is my favorite place.

phrases.text: 小明是我最好的朋友。
phrases.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou
phrases.translation: Xiaoming is my best friend.

phrases.text: 我们一起长大的。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen yìqǐ zhǎngdà de
phrases.translation: We grew up together.

phrases.text: 他比我高一点。
phrases.pinyin: tā bǐ wǒ gāo yìdiǎn
phrases.translation: He is a bit taller than me.

phrases.text: 他非常聪明也很幽默。
phrases.pinyin: tā fēicháng cōngmíng yě hěn yōumò
phrases.translation: He's very smart and funny.

phrases.text: 我们每个星期都见面。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen měi gè xīngqī dōu jiànmiàn
phrases.translation: We meet every week.

phrases.text: 我们一起打篮球、看电影。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú kàn diànyǐng
phrases.translation: We play basketball and watch movies together.

phrases.text: 有这样的朋友我很幸运。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu zhèyàng de péngyou wǒ hěn xìngyùn
phrases.translation: I'm lucky to have a friend like this.

phrases.text: 今天是我妹妹的生日。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān shì wǒ mèimei de shēngrì
phrases.translation: Today is my younger sister's birthday.

phrases.text: 她今年十岁了。
phrases.pinyin: tā jīnnián shí suì le
phrases.translation: She is ten years old this year.

phrases.text: 妈妈做了一个大蛋糕。
phrases.pinyin: māma zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo
phrases.translation: Mom made a big cake.

phrases.text: 爸爸买了很多礼物。
phrases.pinyin: bàba mǎi le hěnduō lǐwù
phrases.translation: Dad bought many gifts.

phrases.text: 我们一起唱生日歌。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen yìqǐ chàng shēngrì gē
phrases.translation: We sang the birthday song together.

phrases.text: 妹妹非常开心。
phrases.pinyin: mèimei fēicháng kāixīn
phrases.translation: My sister was very happy.

phrases.text: 她许了一个愿望。
phrases.pinyin: tā xǔ le yī gè yuànwàng
phrases.translation: She made a wish.

phrases.text: 我每天坐地铁上班。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān zuò dìtiě shàng bān
phrases.translation: I take the subway to work every day.

phrases.text: 地铁又快又便宜。
phrases.pinyin: dìtiě yòu kuài yòu piányi
phrases.translation: The subway is both fast and cheap.

phrases.text: 早上人非常多。
phrases.pinyin: zǎoshang rén fēicháng duō
phrases.translation: In the morning there are a lot of people.

phrases.text: 有时候我找不到座位。
phrases.pinyin: yǒushíhou wǒ zhǎo bu dào zuòwèi
phrases.translation: Sometimes I can't find a seat.

phrases.text: 我要坐五站。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yào zuò wǔ zhàn
phrases.translation: I have to ride for five stops.

phrases.text: 下车以后我走路去公司。
phrases.pinyin: xià chē yǐhòu wǒ zǒu lù qù gōngsī
phrases.translation: After getting off I walk to the company.

phrases.text: 一共要三十分钟。
phrases.pinyin: yígòng yào sānshí fēnzhōng
phrases.translation: In total it takes thirty minutes.

phrases.text: 我的房间不大,但是很舒服。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de fángjiān bù dà dànshì hěn shūfu
phrases.translation: My room is not big, but it is comfortable.

phrases.text: 床在窗户旁边。
phrases.pinyin: chuáng zài chuānghu pángbiān
phrases.translation: The bed is next to the window.

phrases.text: 早上阳光很好。
phrases.pinyin: zǎoshang yángguāng hěn hǎo
phrases.translation: The morning sunlight is lovely.

phrases.text: 书桌上有一台电脑。
phrases.pinyin: shūzhuō shàng yǒu yì tái diànnǎo
phrases.translation: There is a computer on the desk.

phrases.text: 我常常在这里做作业。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ chángcháng zài zhèlǐ zuò zuòyè
phrases.translation: I often do homework here.

phrases.text: 墙上有几张照片。
phrases.pinyin: qiáng shàng yǒu jǐ zhāng zhàopiàn
phrases.translation: There are a few photos on the wall.

phrases.text: 都是我的家人和朋友。
phrases.pinyin: dōu shì wǒ de jiārén hé péngyou
phrases.translation: They're all my family and friends.

phrases.text: 我很喜欢我的房间。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐhuan wǒ de fángjiān
phrases.translation: I really like my room.

phrases.text: 最近我开始学做饭。
phrases.pinyin: zuìjìn wǒ kāishǐ xué zuò fàn
phrases.translation: Recently I started learning to cook.

phrases.text: 以前我总是点外卖。
phrases.pinyin: yǐqián wǒ zǒngshì diǎn wàimài
phrases.translation: Before, I always ordered takeout.

phrases.text: 妈妈说自己做饭更健康。
phrases.pinyin: māma shuō zìjǐ zuò fàn gèng jiànkāng
phrases.translation: Mom says cooking for yourself is healthier.

phrases.text: 我第一次做的是西红柿鸡蛋。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ dì yī cì zuò de shì xīhóngshì jīdàn
phrases.translation: The first thing I made was tomato and egg.

phrases.text: 开始的时候我做得不好。
phrases.pinyin: kāishǐ de shíhou wǒ zuò de bù hǎo
phrases.translation: At first I didn't do it well.

phrases.text: 但是妈妈帮我。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì māma bāng wǒ
phrases.translation: But Mom helped me.

phrases.text: 现在我可以做几个菜了。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ kěyǐ zuò jǐ gè cài le
phrases.translation: Now I can make a few dishes.

phrases.text: 做饭其实很有意思。
phrases.pinyin: zuò fàn qíshí hěn yǒu yìsi
phrases.translation: Cooking is actually quite interesting.

phrases.text: 我是南方人,没见过雪。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shì nánfāngrén méi jiàn guo xuě
phrases.translation: I'm from the south, I had never seen snow.

phrases.text: 去年冬天我去了北方。
phrases.pinyin: qùnián dōngtiān wǒ qù le běifāng
phrases.translation: Last winter I went to the north.

phrases.text: 那是我第一次看见雪。
phrases.pinyin: nà shì wǒ dì yī cì kànjiàn xuě
phrases.translation: That was the first time I saw snow.

phrases.text: 雪又白又软。
phrases.pinyin: xuě yòu bái yòu ruǎn
phrases.translation: The snow was white and soft.

phrases.text: 外面非常冷。
phrases.pinyin: wàimiàn fēicháng lěng
phrases.translation: It was extremely cold outside.

phrases.text: 可是我还是很兴奋。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì wǒ háishi hěn xīngfèn
phrases.translation: But I was still excited.

phrases.text: 我和朋友一起打雪仗。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hé péngyou yìqǐ dǎ xuězhàng
phrases.translation: My friend and I had a snowball fight.

phrases.text: 那一天我永远不会忘。
phrases.pinyin: nà yì tiān wǒ yǒngyuǎn bú huì wàng
phrases.translation: I will never forget that day.

phrases.text: 下个星期我开始新工作。
phrases.pinyin: xià gè xīngqī wǒ kāishǐ xīn gōngzuò
phrases.translation: Next week I start a new job.

phrases.text: 这家公司在市中心。
phrases.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī zài shì zhōngxīn
phrases.translation: The company is in the city center.

phrases.text: 我要坐公交车去上班。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yào zuò gōngjiāochē qù shàngbān
phrases.translation: I have to take the bus to work.

phrases.text: 我有一点紧张。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn jǐnzhāng
phrases.translation: I'm a little nervous.

phrases.text: 因为是我第一次工作。
phrases.pinyin: yīnwèi shì wǒ dì yī cì gōngzuò
phrases.translation: Because this is my first job.

phrases.text: 但是我也很期待。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì wǒ yě hěn qīdài
phrases.translation: But I'm also excited.

phrases.text: 同事们应该都很好。
phrases.pinyin: tóngshìmen yīnggāi dōu hěn hǎo
phrases.translation: My coworkers should all be nice.

phrases.text: 我希望一切都顺利。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xīwàng yíqiè dōu shùnlì
phrases.translation: I hope everything goes smoothly.

phrases.text: 我每天七点起床。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng
phrases.translation: I get up at seven every day.

phrases.text: 我先刷牙、洗脸。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiān shuā yá xǐ liǎn
phrases.translation: First I brush my teeth and wash my face.

phrases.text: 然后我吃早饭。
phrases.pinyin: ránhòu wǒ chī zǎofàn
phrases.translation: Then I eat breakfast.

phrases.text: 我喜欢喝牛奶和吃面包。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan hē niúnǎi hé chī miànbāo
phrases.translation: I like drinking milk and eating bread.

phrases.text: 八点我去上班。
phrases.pinyin: bā diǎn wǒ qù shàngbān
phrases.translation: At eight I go to work.

phrases.text: 我坐地铁去公司。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuò dìtiě qù gōngsī
phrases.translation: I take the subway to the company.

phrases.text: 地铁站离我家很近。
phrases.pinyin: dìtiě zhàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn
phrases.translation: The subway station is close to my home.

phrases.text: 路上我听音乐。
phrases.pinyin: lùshang wǒ tīng yīnyuè
phrases.translation: On the way I listen to music.

phrases.text: 九点我到公司。
phrases.pinyin: jiǔ diǎn wǒ dào gōngsī
phrases.translation: At nine I arrive at the company.

phrases.text: 工作日很忙。
phrases.pinyin: gōngzuò rì hěn máng
phrases.translation: Workdays are very busy.

phrases.text: 周末我去超市买东西。
phrases.pinyin: zhōumò wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi dōngxi
phrases.translation: On the weekend I go to the supermarket to buy things.

phrases.text: 超市很大,东西很多。
phrases.pinyin: chāoshì hěn dà dōngxi hěn duō
phrases.translation: The supermarket is big and has lots of stuff.

phrases.text: 我买了水果和蔬菜。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le shuǐguǒ hé shūcài
phrases.translation: I bought fruit and vegetables.

phrases.text: 我也买了牛奶和鸡蛋。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yě mǎi le niúnǎi hé jīdàn
phrases.translation: I also bought milk and eggs.

phrases.text: 苹果很新鲜,也不贵。
phrases.pinyin: píngguǒ hěn xīnxiān yě bù guì
phrases.translation: The apples were fresh and not expensive.

phrases.text: 我忘了买面包。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ wàng le mǎi miànbāo
phrases.translation: I forgot to buy bread.

phrases.text: 收银台有很多人。
phrases.pinyin: shōuyíntái yǒu hěn duō rén
phrases.translation: There were a lot of people at the checkout.

phrases.text: 我等了十分钟。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ děng le shí fēnzhōng
phrases.translation: I waited for ten minutes.

phrases.text: 回家以后,我做了晚饭。
phrases.pinyin: huí jiā yǐhòu wǒ zuò le wǎnfàn
phrases.translation: After I got home, I made dinner.

phrases.text: 喂,你好,是小李吗?
phrases.pinyin: wèi nǐ hǎo shì Xiǎo Lǐ ma
phrases.translation: Hello, is this Xiao Li?

phrases.text: 是我,你是谁?
phrases.pinyin: shì wǒ nǐ shì shéi
phrases.translation: It's me — who's this?

phrases.text: 我是你的同学小王。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shì nǐ de tóngxué Xiǎo Wáng
phrases.translation: I'm your classmate Xiao Wang.

phrases.text: 明天你有空吗?
phrases.pinyin: míngtiān nǐ yǒu kòng ma
phrases.translation: Are you free tomorrow?

phrases.text: 我想请你吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ chī fàn
phrases.translation: I'd like to take you out to eat.

phrases.text: 好啊,几点?
phrases.pinyin: hǎo a jǐ diǎn
phrases.translation: Sure, what time?

phrases.text: 晚上七点,老地方。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnshang qī diǎn lǎo dìfang
phrases.translation: Seven in the evening, the usual place.

phrases.text: 好的,明天见。
phrases.pinyin: hǎo de míngtiān jiàn
phrases.translation: Okay, see you tomorrow.

phrases.text: 再见。
phrases.pinyin: zàijiàn
phrases.translation: Goodbye.

phrases.text: 今天我去银行。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ qù yínháng
phrases.translation: Today I'm going to the bank.

phrases.text: 我要换一些钱。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yào huàn yìxiē qián
phrases.translation: I want to exchange some money.

phrases.text: 银行九点开门。
phrases.pinyin: yínháng jiǔ diǎn kāimén
phrases.translation: The bank opens at nine.

phrases.text: 我早上八点半就到了。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn jiù dào le
phrases.translation: I arrived at eight-thirty in the morning.

phrases.text: 等了一会儿,门开了。
phrases.pinyin: děng le yíhuìr mén kāi le
phrases.translation: After waiting a little, the door opened.

phrases.text: 里面人不多。
phrases.pinyin: lǐmiàn rén bù duō
phrases.translation: There weren't many people inside.

phrases.text: 我用了护照办事。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yòng le hùzhào bànshì
phrases.translation: I used my passport to take care of things.

phrases.text: 办完以后,我去上班。
phrases.pinyin: bàn wán yǐhòu wǒ qù shàngbān
phrases.translation: Afterward I went to work.

phrases.text: 我今天不舒服。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jīntiān bù shūfu
phrases.translation: I don't feel well today.

phrases.text: 我的头很疼。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de tóu hěn téng
phrases.translation: My head hurts.

phrases.text: 妈妈说我应该去医院。
phrases.pinyin: māma shuō wǒ yīnggāi qù yīyuàn
phrases.translation: Mom said I should go to the hospital.

phrases.text: 医生问我:你怎么了?
phrases.pinyin: yīshēng wèn wǒ nǐ zěnme le
phrases.translation: The doctor asked me: what's wrong?

phrases.text: 我说我头疼,也咳嗽。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shuō wǒ tóu téng yě késou
phrases.translation: I said my head hurts and I'm coughing too.

phrases.text: 医生让我吃药,多喝水。
phrases.pinyin: yīshēng ràng wǒ chī yào duō hē shuǐ
phrases.translation: The doctor had me take medicine and drink lots of water.

phrases.text: 他说我需要休息。
phrases.pinyin: tā shuō wǒ xūyào xiūxi
phrases.translation: He said I need to rest.

phrases.text: 下午我在家睡觉。
phrases.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒ zài jiā shuìjiào
phrases.translation: In the afternoon I slept at home.

phrases.text: 晚上我觉得好一点了。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒ juéde hǎo yì diǎn le
phrases.translation: By evening I felt a bit better.

phrases.text: 今天是我的生日。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì
phrases.translation: Today is my birthday.

phrases.text: 朋友们来我家玩。
phrases.pinyin: péngyou men lái wǒ jiā wán
phrases.translation: My friends came over to my house.

phrases.text: 他们带了很多礼物。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen dài le hěn duō lǐwù
phrases.translation: They brought a lot of presents.

phrases.text: 妈妈做了一个大蛋糕。
phrases.pinyin: māma zuò le yí gè dà dàngāo
phrases.translation: Mom made a big cake.

phrases.text: 上面有我的名字。
phrases.pinyin: shàngmiàn yǒu wǒ de míngzi
phrases.translation: On top was my name.

phrases.text: 我们一起唱生日歌。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen yìqǐ chàng shēngrì gē
phrases.translation: We sang the birthday song together.

phrases.text: 我许了一个愿望。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǔ le yí gè yuànwàng
phrases.translation: I made a wish.

phrases.text: 然后我切了蛋糕。
phrases.pinyin: ránhòu wǒ qiē le dàngāo
phrases.translation: Then I cut the cake.

phrases.text: 大家一起吃蛋糕。
phrases.pinyin: dàjiā yìqǐ chī dàngāo
phrases.translation: Everyone ate cake together.

phrases.text: 我今天很开心。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jīntiān hěn kāixīn
phrases.translation: I was very happy today.

phrases.text: 请问,地铁站在哪里?
phrases.pinyin: qǐngwèn dìtiě zhàn zài nǎli
phrases.translation: Excuse me, where is the subway station?

phrases.text: 地铁站在前面。
phrases.pinyin: dìtiě zhàn zài qiánmiàn
phrases.translation: The subway station is up ahead.

phrases.text: 一直往前走五分钟。
phrases.pinyin: yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng
phrases.translation: Walk straight for five minutes.

phrases.text: 然后向右转。
phrases.pinyin: ránhòu xiàng yòu zhuǎn
phrases.translation: Then turn right.

phrases.text: 你就会看到。
phrases.pinyin: nǐ jiù huì kàn dào
phrases.translation: You'll see it.

phrases.text: 谢谢你。
phrases.pinyin: xièxie nǐ
phrases.translation: Thank you.

phrases.text: 不客气。
phrases.pinyin: bú kèqi
phrases.translation: You're welcome.

phrases.text: 请问,从这里到机场远不远?
phrases.pinyin: qǐngwèn cóng zhèlǐ dào jīchǎng yuǎn bù yuǎn
phrases.translation: Excuse me, is the airport far from here?

phrases.text: 不太远,坐公交车三十分钟。
phrases.pinyin: bú tài yuǎn zuò gōngjiāo chē sānshí fēnzhōng
phrases.translation: Not too far — thirty minutes by bus.

phrases.text: 我常常去图书馆。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ chángcháng qù túshūguǎn
phrases.translation: I often go to the library.

phrases.text: 图书馆的书很多。
phrases.pinyin: túshūguǎn de shū hěn duō
phrases.translation: The library has many books.

phrases.text: 今天我借了三本书。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ jiè le sān běn shū
phrases.translation: Today I borrowed three books.

phrases.text: 一本是中文书。
phrases.pinyin: yì běn shì zhōngwén shū
phrases.translation: One is a Chinese book.

phrases.text: 一本是英文书。
phrases.pinyin: yì běn shì yīngwén shū
phrases.translation: One is an English book.

phrases.text: 还有一本是关于历史的。
phrases.pinyin: hái yǒu yì běn shì guānyú lìshǐ de
phrases.translation: And one is about history.

phrases.text: 借书要用图书证。
phrases.pinyin: jiè shū yào yòng túshū zhèng
phrases.translation: You need a library card to borrow books.

phrases.text: 书可以借两个星期。
phrases.pinyin: shū kěyǐ jiè liǎng gè xīngqī
phrases.translation: Books can be borrowed for two weeks.

phrases.text: 我喜欢在家里看书。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan zài jiā lǐ kàn shū
phrases.translation: I like reading at home.

phrases.text: 我住的地方没有地铁。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhù de dìfang méi yǒu dìtiě
phrases.translation: The place I live has no subway.

phrases.text: 所以我常常坐公交车。
phrases.pinyin: suǒyǐ wǒ chángcháng zuò gōngjiāo chē
phrases.translation: So I often take the bus.

phrases.text: 公交车站在我家门口。
phrases.pinyin: gōngjiāo chē zhàn zài wǒ jiā ménkǒu
phrases.translation: The bus stop is right outside my door.

phrases.text: 我坐三路车去学校。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuò sān lù chē qù xuéxiào
phrases.translation: I take bus number 3 to school.

phrases.text: 车票两块钱。
phrases.pinyin: chē piào liǎng kuài qián
phrases.translation: The ticket is two yuan.

phrases.text: 车里有时候人很多。
phrases.pinyin: chē lǐ yǒu shíhou rén hěn duō
phrases.translation: Sometimes there are a lot of people in the bus.

phrases.text: 我一般给老人让座。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yìbān gěi lǎorén ràng zuò
phrases.translation: I usually give my seat to elderly people.

phrases.text: 公交车比地铁慢一点。
phrases.pinyin: gōngjiāo chē bǐ dìtiě màn yì diǎn
phrases.translation: The bus is a bit slower than the subway.

phrases.text: 但是比地铁便宜。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì bǐ dìtiě piányi
phrases.translation: But it's cheaper than the subway.

phrases.text: 明天是星期六。
phrases.pinyin: míngtiān shì xīngqīliù
phrases.translation: Tomorrow is Saturday.

phrases.text: 我想和朋友一起出去玩。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hé péngyou yìqǐ chūqù wán
phrases.translation: I want to go out with friends.

phrases.text: 上午我们去公园跑步。
phrases.pinyin: shàngwǔ wǒmen qù gōngyuán pǎobù
phrases.translation: In the morning we'll go jogging at the park.

phrases.text: 中午我们在饭馆吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: zhōngwǔ wǒmen zài fànguǎn chī fàn
phrases.translation: At noon we'll eat at a restaurant.

phrases.text: 下午我们去看电影。
phrases.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng
phrases.translation: In the afternoon we'll see a movie.

phrases.text: 电影是新的,很好看。
phrases.pinyin: diànyǐng shì xīn de hěn hǎokàn
phrases.translation: The movie is new and very good.

phrases.text: 晚上我们一起做饭。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ zuò fàn
phrases.translation: In the evening we'll cook together.

phrases.text: 我们做了中国菜和日本菜。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen zuò le zhōngguó cài hé rìběn cài
phrases.translation: We'll make Chinese and Japanese dishes.

phrases.text: 周末过得很愉快。
phrases.pinyin: zhōumò guò de hěn yúkuài
phrases.translation: The weekend will be very enjoyable.

phrases.text: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
phrases.pinyin: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì
phrases.translation: Spring Festival is China's most important holiday.

phrases.text: 每年的一月或二月,我们过春节。
phrases.pinyin: měi nián de yī yuè huò èr yuè wǒmen guò Chūnjié
phrases.translation: Every year in January or February, we celebrate it.

phrases.text: 春节前,全家一起打扫房子。
phrases.pinyin: Chūnjié qián quán jiā yìqǐ dǎsǎo fángzi
phrases.translation: Before the festival, the whole family cleans the house together.

phrases.text: 我们在门上贴红色的对联。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen zài mén shàng tiē hóngsè de duìlián
phrases.translation: We stick red couplets on the doors.

phrases.text: 除夕晚上,全家人一起吃年夜饭。
phrases.pinyin: chúxī wǎnshang quán jiā rén yìqǐ chī nián yè fàn
phrases.translation: On New Year's Eve, the whole family eats dinner together.

phrases.text: 大家都喜欢吃饺子和鱼。
phrases.pinyin: dàjiā dōu xǐhuan chī jiǎozi hé yú
phrases.translation: Everyone loves dumplings and fish.

phrases.text: 孩子们收到红包,非常开心。
phrases.pinyin: háizimen shōudào hóngbāo fēicháng kāixīn
phrases.translation: Children receive red envelopes and are very happy.

phrases.text: 晚上我们一起看春节晚会。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ kàn Chūnjié wǎnhuì
phrases.translation: At night we watch the Spring Festival Gala.

phrases.text: 十二点,外面有很多烟花。
phrases.pinyin: shí èr diǎn wàimiàn yǒu hěn duō yānhuā
phrases.translation: At midnight, there are fireworks outside.

phrases.text: 第二天,我们去亲戚家拜年。
phrases.pinyin: dì èr tiān wǒmen qù qīnqi jiā bàinián
phrases.translation: The next day, we visit relatives' homes.

phrases.text: 大家互相说"新年快乐"。
phrases.pinyin: dàjiā hùxiāng shuō xīnnián kuàilè
phrases.translation: Everyone wishes each other "Happy New Year."

phrases.text: 春节真热闹!
phrases.pinyin: Chūnjié zhēn rènao
phrases.translation: Spring Festival is really lively!

phrases.text: 服务员:您好,几位?
phrases.pinyin: fúwùyuán nín hǎo jǐ wèi
phrases.translation: Waiter: Hello, how many people?

phrases.text: 客人:两位,谢谢。
phrases.pinyin: kèrén liǎng wèi xièxie
phrases.translation: Customer: Two, please.

phrases.text: 服务员:这边请,这是菜单。
phrases.pinyin: fúwùyuán zhèbiān qǐng zhè shì càidān
phrases.translation: Waiter: This way, please. Here's the menu.

phrases.text: 客人:谢谢。请问什么菜好吃?
phrases.pinyin: kèrén xièxie qǐngwèn shénme cài hǎochī
phrases.translation: Customer: Thanks. May I ask what is good here?

phrases.text: 服务员:我们的鸡肉很有名。
phrases.pinyin: fúwùyuán wǒmen de jīròu hěn yǒumíng
phrases.translation: Waiter: Our chicken is very famous.

phrases.text: 客人:好,来一份鸡肉。
phrases.pinyin: kèrén hǎo lái yí fèn jīròu
phrases.translation: Customer: Great, one order of chicken please.

phrases.text: 服务员:要米饭吗?
phrases.pinyin: fúwùyuán yào mǐfàn ma
phrases.translation: Waiter: Would you like rice?

phrases.text: 客人:要两碗,再来一个青菜。
phrases.pinyin: kèrén yào liǎng wǎn zài lái yí ge qīngcài
phrases.translation: Customer: Two bowls, and a vegetable dish too.

phrases.text: 服务员:喝什么?
phrases.pinyin: fúwùyuán hē shénme
phrases.translation: Waiter: What would you like to drink?

phrases.text: 客人:两杯茶,谢谢。
phrases.pinyin: kèrén liǎng bēi chá xièxie
phrases.translation: Customer: Two cups of tea, thank you.

phrases.text: 服务员:好的,请等一下。
phrases.pinyin: fúwùyuán hǎo de qǐng děng yíxià
phrases.translation: Waiter: Alright, please wait a moment.

phrases.text: 客人:服务员,买单!
phrases.pinyin: kèrén fúwùyuán mǎidān
phrases.translation: (Later) Customer: Waiter, the check please!

phrases.text: 亲爱的爸爸妈妈:
phrases.pinyin: qīn'ài de bàba māma
phrases.translation: Dear Mom and Dad:

phrases.text: 我到北京已经三个月了。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ dào Běijīng yǐjīng sān ge yuè le
phrases.translation: I've already been in Beijing for three months.

phrases.text: 北京的生活和家里很不一样。
phrases.pinyin: Běijīng de shēnghuó hé jiā lǐ hěn bù yíyàng
phrases.translation: Life in Beijing is very different from home.

phrases.text: 这里的冬天比南方冷得多。
phrases.pinyin: zhèlǐ de dōngtiān bǐ nánfāng lěng de duō
phrases.translation: The winters here are much colder than in the south.

phrases.text: 我常常穿大衣和围巾。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ chángcháng chuān dàyī hé wéijīn
phrases.translation: I often wear a coat and scarf.

phrases.text: 我的学校在城市的北边。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de xuéxiào zài chéngshì de běibiān
phrases.translation: My school is on the north side of the city.

phrases.text: 每天我坐地铁去上课。
phrases.pinyin: měi tiān wǒ zuò dìtiě qù shàngkè
phrases.translation: Every day I take the subway to class.

phrases.text: 老师非常认真,同学们也很友好。
phrases.pinyin: lǎoshī fēicháng rènzhēn tóngxuémen yě hěn yǒuhǎo
phrases.translation: The teachers are very dedicated and my classmates are friendly.

phrases.text: 上个周末,我和朋友去了长城。
phrases.pinyin: shàng ge zhōumò wǒ hé péngyou qù le Chángchéng
phrases.translation: Last weekend, I went to the Great Wall with friends.

phrases.text: 长城真长,也很壮观。
phrases.pinyin: Chángchéng zhēn cháng yě hěn zhuàngguān
phrases.translation: The Great Wall is really long and magnificent.

phrases.text: 我照了很多照片,下次回家给你们看。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhào le hěn duō zhàopiàn xià cì huí jiā gěi nǐmen kàn
phrases.translation: I took many photos — I'll show you next time I come home.

phrases.text: 虽然我有时候想家,但是我在这里过得很开心。
phrases.pinyin: suīrán wǒ yǒu shíhou xiǎng jiā dànshì wǒ zài zhèlǐ guò de hěn kāixīn
phrases.translation: Although I sometimes miss home, I'm happy here.

phrases.text: 请你们不要担心我。
phrases.pinyin: qǐng nǐmen bú yào dānxīn wǒ
phrases.translation: Please don't worry about me.

phrases.text: 等放假我就回去看你们。
phrases.pinyin: děng fàngjià wǒ jiù huíqù kàn nǐmen
phrases.translation: I'll come back to see you when vacation starts.

phrases.text: 爱你们的女儿小美。
phrases.pinyin: ài nǐmen de nǚ'ér Xiǎoměi
phrases.translation: Your daughter who loves you, Xiaomei.

phrases.text: 中国是一个很大的国家,四季分明。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngguó shì yí ge hěn dà de guójiā sì jì fēnmíng
phrases.translation: China is a very large country with four distinct seasons.

phrases.text: 春天,万物复苏。
phrases.pinyin: chūntiān wànwù fùsū
phrases.translation: In spring, all things come back to life.

phrases.text: 树上长出新的叶子,花也开了。
phrases.pinyin: shù shàng zhǎng chū xīn de yèzi huā yě kāi le
phrases.translation: New leaves grow on the trees, and flowers bloom.

phrases.text: 人们去公园散步,看樱花。
phrases.pinyin: rénmen qù gōngyuán sànbù kàn yīnghuā
phrases.translation: People go to parks to walk and see the cherry blossoms.

phrases.text: 夏天又热又潮湿。
phrases.pinyin: xiàtiān yòu rè yòu cháoshī
phrases.translation: Summer is hot and humid.

phrases.text: 很多人去海边游泳,或者去山里避暑。
phrases.pinyin: hěn duō rén qù hǎibiān yóuyǒng huòzhě qù shān lǐ bìshǔ
phrases.translation: Many people go to the beach to swim, or to the mountains to escape the heat.

phrases.text: 北方的夏天比南方短一点。
phrases.pinyin: běifāng de xiàtiān bǐ nánfāng duǎn yìdiǎn
phrases.translation: Summer in the north is a bit shorter than in the south.

phrases.text: 秋天是最舒服的季节。
phrases.pinyin: qiūtiān shì zuì shūfu de jìjié
phrases.translation: Autumn is the most comfortable season.

phrases.text: 天气不冷也不热,天空又高又蓝。
phrases.pinyin: tiānqì bù lěng yě bù rè tiānkōng yòu gāo yòu lán
phrases.translation: The weather is neither cold nor hot; the sky is high and blue.

phrases.text: 北京的香山,秋天的红叶特别美。
phrases.pinyin: Běijīng de Xiāngshān qiūtiān de hóngyè tèbié měi
phrases.translation: Beijing's Fragrant Hills — the autumn red leaves are especially beautiful.

phrases.text: 冬天,北方会下雪。
phrases.pinyin: dōngtiān běifāng huì xià xuě
phrases.translation: In winter, it snows in the north.

phrases.text: 孩子们喜欢堆雪人、打雪仗。
phrases.pinyin: háizimen xǐhuan duī xuěrén dǎ xuězhàng
phrases.translation: Children love building snowmen and having snowball fights.

phrases.text: 南方的冬天很少下雪,但是也很冷。
phrases.pinyin: nánfāng de dōngtiān hěn shǎo xià xuě dànshì yě hěn lěng
phrases.translation: Winter in the south rarely snows, but it's still very cold.

phrases.text: 每个季节都有它自己的美。
phrases.pinyin: měi ge jìjié dōu yǒu tā zìjǐ de měi
phrases.translation: Every season has its own beauty.

phrases.text: 去年夏天我和家人去了云南。
phrases.pinyin: qùnián xiàtiān wǒ hé jiārén qù le Yúnnán
phrases.translation: Last summer my family and I went to Yunnan.

phrases.text: 云南的风景特别美丽。
phrases.pinyin: Yúnnán de fēngjǐng tèbié měilì
phrases.translation: Yunnan's scenery is especially beautiful.

phrases.text: 我们爬了一座很高的山。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen pá le yí zuò hěn gāo de shān
phrases.translation: We climbed a very tall mountain.

phrases.text: 从山上看下去,一切都像一幅画。
phrases.pinyin: cóng shān shàng kàn xiàqù yíqiè dōu xiàng yì fú huà
phrases.translation: Looking down, everything was like a painting.

phrases.text: 晚上我们住在一个小村子里。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒmen zhù zài yí gè xiǎo cūnzi lǐ
phrases.translation: In the evening we stayed in a small village.

phrases.text: 当地人非常热情。
phrases.pinyin: dāngdì rén fēicháng rèqíng
phrases.translation: The locals were very warm-hearted.

phrases.text: 他们请我们吃了很多本地菜。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen qǐng wǒmen chī le hěnduō běndì cài
phrases.translation: They treated us to many local dishes.

phrases.text: 那是我第一次尝试这些菜。
phrases.pinyin: nà shì wǒ dì yī cì chángshì zhèxiē cài
phrases.translation: It was the first time I tried those dishes.

phrases.text: 这次旅行让我学到了很多东西。
phrases.pinyin: zhè cì lǚxíng ràng wǒ xué dào le hěnduō dōngxi
phrases.translation: This trip taught me many things.

phrases.text: 我永远不会忘记它。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yǒngyuǎn bú huì wàngjì tā
phrases.translation: I will never forget it.

phrases.text: 每年春节我都会回老家。
phrases.pinyin: měi nián Chūnjié wǒ dōu huì huí lǎojiā
phrases.translation: Every Spring Festival I go back to my hometown.

phrases.text: 坐火车回家要花十个小时。
phrases.pinyin: zuò huǒchē huí jiā yào huā shí gè xiǎoshí
phrases.translation: Taking the train home takes ten hours.

phrases.text: 虽然很累,但是我很开心。
phrases.pinyin: suīrán hěn lèi dànshì wǒ hěn kāixīn
phrases.translation: Though tiring, I'm very happy.

phrases.text: 到家以后我先去看爷爷奶奶。
phrases.pinyin: dào jiā yǐhòu wǒ xiān qù kàn yéye nǎinai
phrases.translation: After arriving home, I first visit my grandparents.

phrases.text: 奶奶总是准备很多好吃的。
phrases.pinyin: nǎinai zǒngshì zhǔnbèi hěnduō hǎochī de
phrases.translation: Grandma always prepares lots of delicious food.

phrases.text: 除夕晚上全家人一起吃年夜饭。
phrases.pinyin: chúxī wǎnshang quán jiā rén yìqǐ chī niányèfàn
phrases.translation: On New Year's Eve the whole family eats reunion dinner together.

phrases.text: 我们会放鞭炮,看春晚。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen huì fàng biānpào kàn Chūnwǎn
phrases.translation: We set off firecrackers and watch the Gala.

phrases.text: 孩子们最喜欢收红包。
phrases.pinyin: háizimen zuì xǐhuan shōu hóngbāo
phrases.translation: The children love getting red envelopes the most.

phrases.text: 这是一年中最重要的节日。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì yì nián zhōng zuì zhòngyào de jiérì
phrases.translation: This is the most important festival of the year.

phrases.text: 我的中文老师姓张。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de Zhōngwén lǎoshī xìng Zhāng
phrases.translation: My Chinese teacher's surname is Zhang.

phrases.text: 她已经教书二十多年了。
phrases.pinyin: tā yǐjīng jiāo shū èrshí duō nián le
phrases.translation: She has been teaching for over twenty years.

phrases.text: 她的教学方法非常有趣。
phrases.pinyin: tā de jiàoxué fāngfǎ fēicháng yǒuqù
phrases.translation: Her teaching methods are very interesting.

phrases.text: 她不只是教我们语言,也教我们文化。
phrases.pinyin: tā bù zhǐshì jiāo wǒmen yǔyán yě jiāo wǒmen wénhuà
phrases.translation: She teaches us not only the language but also the culture.

phrases.text: 课堂上我们经常玩游戏。
phrases.pinyin: kètáng shàng wǒmen jīngcháng wán yóuxì
phrases.translation: In class we often play games.

phrases.text: 虽然中文很难,但是我越来越喜欢。
phrases.pinyin: suīrán Zhōngwén hěn nán dànshì wǒ yuèláiyuè xǐhuan
phrases.translation: Though Chinese is hard, I like it more and more.

phrases.text: 张老师对每个学生都很耐心。
phrases.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī duì měi gè xuésheng dōu hěn nàixīn
phrases.translation: Teacher Zhang is patient with every student.

phrases.text: 我很幸运能遇到这样的老师。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hěn xìngyùn néng yùdào zhèyàng de lǎoshī
phrases.translation: I am lucky to have met such a teacher.

phrases.text: 现在很多人喜欢在网上买东西。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài hěnduō rén xǐhuan zài wǎngshàng mǎi dōngxi
phrases.translation: Now many people like shopping online.

phrases.text: 比去商店方便多了。
phrases.pinyin: bǐ qù shāngdiàn fāngbiàn duō le
phrases.translation: It's much more convenient than going to a store.

phrases.text: 只要点一点手机,东西就会送到家里。
phrases.pinyin: zhǐyào diǎn yi diǎn shǒujī dōngxi jiù huì sòng dào jiā lǐ
phrases.translation: You just tap your phone and things are delivered home.

phrases.text: 价格也常常比较便宜。
phrases.pinyin: jiàgé yě chángcháng bǐjiào piányi
phrases.translation: Prices are often cheaper, too.

phrases.text: 可是网上购物也有问题。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì wǎngshàng gòuwù yě yǒu wèntí
phrases.translation: But online shopping also has problems.

phrases.text: 有时候商品的质量不好。
phrases.pinyin: yǒushíhou shāngpǐn de zhìliàng bù hǎo
phrases.translation: Sometimes product quality is poor.

phrases.text: 或者跟图片看起来不一样。
phrases.pinyin: huòzhě gēn túpiàn kàn qǐlái bù yíyàng
phrases.translation: Or it looks different from the picture.

phrases.text: 所以买之前一定要看评论。
phrases.pinyin: suǒyǐ mǎi zhīqián yídìng yào kàn pínglùn
phrases.translation: So before buying, be sure to read the reviews.

phrases.text: 我一般只在大网站上购物。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yìbān zhǐ zài dà wǎngzhàn shàng gòuwù
phrases.translation: I usually only shop on big websites.

phrases.text: 学一门外语不是一件容易的事。
phrases.pinyin: xué yì mén wàiyǔ bú shì yí jiàn róngyì de shì
phrases.translation: Learning a foreign language is not easy.

phrases.text: 需要花很多时间和精力。
phrases.pinyin: xūyào huā hěnduō shíjiān hé jīnglì
phrases.translation: It requires a lot of time and energy.

phrases.text: 最大的挑战是坚持。
phrases.pinyin: zuì dà de tiǎozhàn shì jiānchí
phrases.translation: The biggest challenge is persistence.

phrases.text: 很多人开始的时候很有动力。
phrases.pinyin: hěnduō rén kāishǐ de shíhou hěn yǒu dònglì
phrases.translation: Many people are very motivated at the start.

phrases.text: 但是过了几个月就放弃了。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì guò le jǐ gè yuè jiù fàngqì le
phrases.translation: But after a few months they give up.

phrases.text: 其实最重要的是每天都练习。
phrases.pinyin: qíshí zuì zhòngyào de shì měitiān dōu liànxí
phrases.translation: Actually the most important thing is practicing daily.

phrases.text: 哪怕只有十五分钟也很有用。
phrases.pinyin: nǎpà zhǐ yǒu shíwǔ fēnzhōng yě hěn yǒuyòng
phrases.translation: Even just fifteen minutes is useful.

phrases.text: 还要找机会跟母语者说话。
phrases.pinyin: hái yào zhǎo jīhuì gēn mǔyǔ zhě shuō huà
phrases.translation: You also need to find chances to speak with native speakers.

phrases.text: 不要怕犯错误,犯错是学习的一部分。
phrases.pinyin: bú yào pà fàn cuòwù fàn cuò shì xuéxí de yí bùfèn
phrases.translation: Don't be afraid of making mistakes; mistakes are part of learning.

phrases.text: 我家附近有一家小餐馆。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā xiǎo cānguǎn
phrases.translation: There is a small restaurant near my home.

phrases.text: 老板是一对年轻的夫妻。
phrases.pinyin: lǎobǎn shì yí duì niánqīng de fūqī
phrases.translation: The owners are a young couple.

phrases.text: 他们每天早上五点就开始准备。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen měitiān zǎoshang wǔ diǎn jiù kāishǐ zhǔnbèi
phrases.translation: Every morning at five they start preparing.

phrases.text: 餐馆虽然不大,但是非常干净。
phrases.pinyin: cānguǎn suīrán bú dà dànshì fēicháng gānjìng
phrases.translation: Though small, the restaurant is very clean.

phrases.text: 他们做的饺子是最有名的。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen zuò de jiǎozi shì zuì yǒumíng de
phrases.translation: Their dumplings are the most famous.

phrases.text: 每天中午都有人排队。
phrases.pinyin: měitiān zhōngwǔ dōu yǒu rén pái duì
phrases.translation: Every day at noon people line up.

phrases.text: 有时候要等三十分钟。
phrases.pinyin: yǒushíhou yào děng sānshí fēnzhōng
phrases.translation: Sometimes you wait thirty minutes.

phrases.text: 不过饺子真的值得等。
phrases.pinyin: búguò jiǎozi zhēn de zhíde děng
phrases.translation: But the dumplings are really worth waiting for.

phrases.text: 我几乎每个星期都去。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jīhū měi gè xīngqī dōu qù
phrases.translation: I go almost every week.

phrases.text: 很多人讨论城市好还是乡村好。
phrases.pinyin: hěnduō rén tǎolùn chéngshì hǎo háishi xiāngcūn hǎo
phrases.translation: Many people debate whether city or country is better.

phrases.text: 城市里工作机会多,交通方便。
phrases.pinyin: chéngshì lǐ gōngzuò jīhuì duō jiāotōng fāngbiàn
phrases.translation: The city has many jobs and convenient transport.

phrases.text: 但是压力也很大,空气也不好。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì yālì yě hěn dà kōngqì yě bù hǎo
phrases.translation: But the pressure is high and the air is bad.

phrases.text: 乡村生活比较慢,比较安静。
phrases.pinyin: xiāngcūn shēnghuó bǐjiào màn bǐjiào ānjìng
phrases.translation: Country life is slower and quieter.

phrases.text: 可以呼吸新鲜的空气。
phrases.pinyin: kěyǐ hūxī xīnxiān de kōngqì
phrases.translation: You can breathe fresh air.

phrases.text: 但是工作不好找。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì gōngzuò bù hǎo zhǎo
phrases.translation: But jobs are hard to find.

phrases.text: 每个人的选择都不一样。
phrases.pinyin: měi gè rén de xuǎnzé dōu bù yíyàng
phrases.translation: Everyone's choice is different.

phrases.text: 我更喜欢城市,不过周末常常去乡下。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ gèng xǐhuan chéngshì búguò zhōumò chángcháng qù xiāngxià
phrases.translation: I prefer the city, but often visit the country on weekends.

phrases.text: 每个人都有自己的梦想。
phrases.pinyin: měi gè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng
phrases.translation: Everyone has their own dream.

phrases.text: 我的梦想是成为一名作家。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de mèngxiǎng shì chéngwéi yì míng zuòjiā
phrases.translation: My dream is to become a writer.

phrases.text: 从小我就喜欢读书和写故事。
phrases.pinyin: cóngxiǎo wǒ jiù xǐhuan dú shū hé xiě gùshi
phrases.translation: Since I was small I've liked reading and writing stories.

phrases.text: 虽然做作家不容易,但是我不想放弃。
phrases.pinyin: suīrán zuò zuòjiā bù róngyì dànshì wǒ bù xiǎng fàngqì
phrases.translation: Though being a writer isn't easy, I don't want to give up.

phrases.text: 我每天晚上都会写一点东西。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān wǎnshang dōu huì xiě yìdiǎn dōngxi
phrases.translation: I write something every evening.

phrases.text: 有时候灵感来得快,有时候很慢。
phrases.pinyin: yǒushíhou línggǎn lái de kuài yǒushíhou hěn màn
phrases.translation: Sometimes inspiration comes fast, sometimes slow.

phrases.text: 我希望有一天能出版自己的书。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xīwàng yǒu yì tiān néng chūbǎn zìjǐ de shū
phrases.translation: I hope one day I can publish my own book.

phrases.text: 就算别人不喜欢,我也要坚持下去。
phrases.pinyin: jiùsuàn biérén bù xǐhuan wǒ yě yào jiānchí xiàqù
phrases.translation: Even if others don't like it, I'll keep going.

phrases.text: 中秋节是中国一个很重要的节日。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngqiū jié shì Zhōngguó yí gè hěn zhòngyào de jiérì
phrases.translation: Mid-Autumn Festival is an important Chinese holiday.

phrases.text: 它通常在九月或十月。
phrases.pinyin: tā tōngcháng zài jiǔyuè huò shíyuè
phrases.translation: It's usually in September or October.

phrases.text: 那一天月亮又圆又亮。
phrases.pinyin: nà yì tiān yuèliang yòu yuán yòu liàng
phrases.translation: That day the moon is round and bright.

phrases.text: 全家人会一起赏月。
phrases.pinyin: quán jiā rén huì yìqǐ shǎng yuè
phrases.translation: The whole family admires the moon together.

phrases.text: 我们还会吃月饼。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen hái huì chī yuèbǐng
phrases.translation: We also eat mooncakes.

phrases.text: 月饼有很多不同的味道。
phrases.pinyin: yuèbǐng yǒu hěnduō bùtóng de wèidào
phrases.translation: Mooncakes come in many different flavors.

phrases.text: 我最喜欢莲蓉蛋黄的。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan liánróng dànhuáng de
phrases.translation: My favorite is lotus seed paste with egg yolk.

phrases.text: 中秋节的意思是团圆。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngqiū jié de yìsi shì tuányuán
phrases.translation: The meaning of Mid-Autumn Festival is reunion.

phrases.text: 所以很多人会回家过节。
phrases.pinyin: suǒyǐ hěnduō rén huì huí jiā guò jié
phrases.translation: So many people go home to celebrate.

phrases.text: 最近我开始注意自己的健康。
phrases.pinyin: zuìjìn wǒ kāishǐ zhùyì zìjǐ de jiànkāng
phrases.translation: Recently I've started paying attention to my health.

phrases.text: 以前我工作太忙,经常吃快餐。
phrases.pinyin: yǐqián wǒ gōngzuò tài máng jīngcháng chī kuàicān
phrases.translation: Before I was too busy and often ate fast food.

phrases.text: 现在我尽量自己做饭。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ jǐnliàng zìjǐ zuò fàn
phrases.translation: Now I try to cook for myself.

phrases.text: 我也开始每天早上跑步。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yě kāishǐ měitiān zǎoshang pǎo bù
phrases.translation: I've also started running every morning.

phrases.text: 开始的时候真的很难。
phrases.pinyin: kāishǐ de shíhou zhēn de hěn nán
phrases.translation: At the beginning it was really hard.

phrases.text: 但是一个月以后,我感觉好多了。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì yí gè yuè yǐhòu wǒ gǎnjué hǎo duō le
phrases.translation: But after a month I felt much better.

phrases.text: 睡觉的质量也变好了。
phrases.pinyin: shuìjiào de zhìliàng yě biàn hǎo le
phrases.translation: My sleep quality improved too.

phrases.text: 我还学会了放松。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hái xuéhuì le fàngsōng
phrases.translation: I've also learned to relax.

phrases.text: 健康的身体比什么都重要。
phrases.pinyin: jiànkāng de shēntǐ bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào
phrases.translation: A healthy body is more important than anything.

phrases.text: 我刚刚大学毕业,开始找工作。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ gānggāng dàxué bìyè kāishǐ zhǎo gōngzuò
phrases.translation: I just graduated from university and started looking for work.

phrases.text: 现在的工作不太好找。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài de gōngzuò bù tài hǎo zhǎo
phrases.translation: Jobs aren't easy to find these days.

phrases.text: 我在网上看了很多招聘广告。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zài wǎng shàng kàn le hěn duō zhāopìn guǎnggào
phrases.translation: I looked at many job ads online.

phrases.text: 有的公司要求有工作经验。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu de gōngsī yāoqiú yǒu gōngzuò jīngyàn
phrases.translation: Some companies require work experience.

phrases.text: 我没有经验,所以很难。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu jīngyàn suǒyǐ hěn nán
phrases.translation: I have no experience, so it's hard.

phrases.text: 我每天都投简历。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ měitiān dōu tóu jiǎnlì
phrases.translation: I send out resumes every day.

phrases.text: 上个星期,我接到了三个面试通知。
phrases.pinyin: shàng gè xīngqī wǒ jiēdào le sān gè miànshì tōngzhī
phrases.translation: Last week I got three interview invitations.

phrases.text: 我准备得很认真。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhǔnbèi de hěn rènzhēn
phrases.translation: I prepared very seriously.

phrases.text: 一家公司给了我机会。
phrases.pinyin: yì jiā gōngsī gěi le wǒ jīhuì
phrases.translation: One company gave me a chance.

phrases.text: 工资虽然不高,但是我很高兴。
phrases.pinyin: gōngzī suīrán bù gāo dànshì wǒ hěn gāoxìng
phrases.translation: Though the salary isn't high, I'm very happy.

phrases.text: 这是我人生的第一份工作。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ rénshēng de dì yī fèn gōngzuò
phrases.translation: This is the first job of my life.

phrases.text: 我决定好好努力。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ juédìng hǎohāo nǔlì
phrases.translation: I've decided to work hard.

phrases.text: 上个月我搬了家。
phrases.pinyin: shàng gè yuè wǒ bān le jiā
phrases.translation: Last month I moved.

phrases.text: 以前的房子太小了。
phrases.pinyin: yǐqián de fángzi tài xiǎo le
phrases.translation: My old place was too small.

phrases.text: 新的房子大一点,也更便宜。
phrases.pinyin: xīn de fángzi dà yì diǎn yě gèng piányi
phrases.translation: The new place is a bit bigger and cheaper too.

phrases.text: 搬家那天,朋友们都来帮忙。
phrases.pinyin: bān jiā nà tiān péngyou men dōu lái bāngmáng
phrases.translation: On moving day, friends came to help.

phrases.text: 我们搬了一整天。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen bān le yì zhěng tiān
phrases.translation: We moved for a whole day.

phrases.text: 最重的东西是冰箱和沙发。
phrases.pinyin: zuì zhòng de dōngxi shì bīngxiāng hé shāfā
phrases.translation: The heaviest things were the fridge and the sofa.

phrases.text: 新家的厨房比以前大。
phrases.pinyin: xīn jiā de chúfáng bǐ yǐqián dà
phrases.translation: The new kitchen is bigger than before.

phrases.text: 我在客厅放了一个书架。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zài kètīng fàng le yí gè shūjià
phrases.translation: I put a bookshelf in the living room.

phrases.text: 卧室里有一张大床。
phrases.pinyin: wòshì lǐ yǒu yì zhāng dà chuáng
phrases.translation: There's a big bed in the bedroom.

phrases.text: 搬家很累,但是很值得。
phrases.pinyin: bān jiā hěn lèi dànshì hěn zhídé
phrases.translation: Moving was tiring, but worth it.

phrases.text: 现在我很喜欢这个新家。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè gè xīn jiā
phrases.translation: Now I really like this new home.

phrases.text: 我打算请朋友们来吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ dǎsuan qǐng péngyou men lái chī fàn
phrases.translation: I plan to invite friends over for dinner.

phrases.text: 最近我经常在网上买东西。
phrases.pinyin: zuìjìn wǒ jīngcháng zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōngxi
phrases.translation: Lately I often buy things online.

phrases.text: 网购方便又便宜。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnggòu fāngbiàn yòu piányi
phrases.translation: Online shopping is convenient and cheap.

phrases.text: 我只需要用手机就可以下单。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ xūyào yòng shǒujī jiù kěyǐ xià dān
phrases.translation: I just need my phone to place an order.

phrases.text: 送货速度也越来越快。
phrases.pinyin: sòng huò sùdù yě yuè lái yuè kuài
phrases.translation: Delivery speed is getting faster.

phrases.text: 有时候第二天就到了。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu shíhou dì èr tiān jiù dào le
phrases.translation: Sometimes it arrives the next day.

phrases.text: 不过,有些东西网上的和实际不一样。
phrases.pinyin: búguò yǒu xiē dōngxi wǎng shàng de hé shíjì bù yíyàng
phrases.translation: But sometimes the item looks different from online.

phrases.text: 颜色可能不同。
phrases.pinyin: yánsè kěnéng bù tóng
phrases.translation: The color might be different.

phrases.text: 大小也可能不合适。
phrases.pinyin: dàxiǎo yě kěnéng bù héshì
phrases.translation: The size might not fit.

phrases.text: 如果不满意,还可以退货。
phrases.pinyin: rúguǒ bù mǎnyì hái kěyǐ tuì huò
phrases.translation: If you're not satisfied, you can return it.

phrases.text: 我上个月退了一件衣服。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shàng gè yuè tuì le yí jiàn yīfu
phrases.translation: I returned a piece of clothing last month.

phrases.text: 过程很简单。
phrases.pinyin: guòchéng hěn jiǎndān
phrases.translation: The process was very simple.

phrases.text: 我觉得网购改变了我们的生活。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ juéde wǎnggòu gǎibiàn le wǒmen de shēnghuó
phrases.translation: I feel online shopping has changed our lives.

phrases.text: 我最近在学开车。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuìjìn zài xué kāichē
phrases.translation: Recently I've been learning to drive.

phrases.text: 我报了一个驾校。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ bào le yí gè jiàxiào
phrases.translation: I signed up at a driving school.

phrases.text: 老师很有经验,也很耐心。
phrases.pinyin: lǎoshī hěn yǒu jīngyàn yě hěn nàixīn
phrases.translation: The instructor is experienced and very patient.

phrases.text: 第一次开车,我特别紧张。
phrases.pinyin: dì yī cì kāichē wǒ tèbié jǐnzhāng
phrases.translation: The first time driving, I was really nervous.

phrases.text: 手一直发抖。
phrases.pinyin: shǒu yìzhí fādǒu
phrases.translation: My hands kept shaking.

phrases.text: 老师告诉我要放松。
phrases.pinyin: lǎoshī gàosu wǒ yào fàngsōng
phrases.translation: The instructor told me to relax.

phrases.text: 慢慢地我开始习惯了。
phrases.pinyin: mànmàn de wǒ kāishǐ xíguàn le
phrases.translation: Slowly I got used to it.

phrases.text: 现在我已经学了两个月。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ yǐjīng xué le liǎng gè yuè
phrases.translation: Now I've been studying for two months already.

phrases.text: 下个月要考试。
phrases.pinyin: xià gè yuè yào kǎoshì
phrases.translation: Next month is the test.

phrases.text: 如果考过,我就可以开车上路。
phrases.pinyin: rúguǒ kǎo guò wǒ jiù kěyǐ kāichē shàng lù
phrases.translation: If I pass, I can drive on the road.

phrases.text: 我打算买一辆小汽车。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ dǎsuan mǎi yí liàng xiǎo qìchē
phrases.translation: I plan to buy a small car.

phrases.text: 有车以后出门会方便得多。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu chē yǐhòu chūmén huì fāngbiàn de duō
phrases.translation: Having a car will make going out much easier.

phrases.text: 今天我去一家公司面试。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ qù yì jiā gōngsī miànshì
phrases.translation: Today I went to a company for an interview.

phrases.text: 我七点就起床了。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ qī diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le
phrases.translation: I got up at seven.

phrases.text: 我穿了最好的衣服。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ chuān le zuì hǎo de yīfu
phrases.translation: I wore my best clothes.

phrases.text: 面试的地方离我家有点远。
phrases.pinyin: miànshì de dìfang lí wǒ jiā yǒu diǎn yuǎn
phrases.translation: The interview location was a bit far from home.

phrases.text: 我提前一个小时出门。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ tíqián yí gè xiǎoshí chūmén
phrases.translation: I left an hour early.

phrases.text: 到了公司,我在前台等了十分钟。
phrases.pinyin: dào le gōngsī wǒ zài qiántái děng le shí fēnzhōng
phrases.translation: At the company I waited ten minutes at the front desk.

phrases.text: 然后面试官叫我进办公室。
phrases.pinyin: ránhòu miànshì guān jiào wǒ jìn bàngōngshì
phrases.translation: Then the interviewer called me into the office.

phrases.text: 他问了我很多问题。
phrases.pinyin: tā wèn le wǒ hěn duō wèntí
phrases.translation: He asked me a lot of questions.

phrases.text: 有些问题比较难回答。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu xiē wèntí bǐjiào nán huídá
phrases.translation: Some were harder to answer.

phrases.text: 我尽量说实话。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jǐnliàng shuō shíhuà
phrases.translation: I tried to tell the truth.

phrases.text: 面试一共进行了四十分钟。
phrases.pinyin: miànshì yígòng jìnxíng le sìshí fēnzhōng
phrases.translation: The interview lasted forty minutes in total.

phrases.text: 他说下个星期给我消息。
phrases.pinyin: tā shuō xià gè xīngqī gěi wǒ xiāoxi
phrases.translation: He said he'd let me know next week.

phrases.text: 我希望能得到这份工作。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xīwàng néng dé dào zhè fèn gōngzuò
phrases.translation: I hope I get this job.

phrases.text: 保护环境越来越重要。
phrases.pinyin: bǎohù huánjìng yuè lái yuè zhòngyào
phrases.translation: Protecting the environment is more and more important.

phrases.text: 我们应该从日常生活开始。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen yīnggāi cóng rìcháng shēnghuó kāishǐ
phrases.translation: We should start from daily life.

phrases.text: 比如,少用塑料袋。
phrases.pinyin: bǐrú shǎo yòng sùliào dài
phrases.translation: For example, use fewer plastic bags.

phrases.text: 去超市的时候自己带袋子。
phrases.pinyin: qù chāoshì de shíhou zìjǐ dài dàizi
phrases.translation: Bring your own bag to the supermarket.

phrases.text: 也可以节约用水。
phrases.pinyin: yě kěyǐ jiéyuē yòng shuǐ
phrases.translation: You can also save water.

phrases.text: 刷牙的时候关水龙头。
phrases.pinyin: shuā yá de shíhou guān shuǐ lóngtóu
phrases.translation: Turn off the faucet when brushing your teeth.

phrases.text: 出门的时候关灯。
phrases.pinyin: chūmén de shíhou guān dēng
phrases.translation: Turn off the lights when you go out.

phrases.text: 如果路不远,可以走路或者骑自行车。
phrases.pinyin: rúguǒ lù bù yuǎn kěyǐ zǒulù huòzhě qí zìxíngchē
phrases.translation: If it's not far, walk or bike.

phrases.text: 这样不仅环保,而且对身体好。
phrases.pinyin: zhèyàng bùjǐn huánbǎo érqiě duì shēntǐ hǎo
phrases.translation: This is not only eco-friendly, but good for your body.

phrases.text: 很多年轻人现在都有环保意识。
phrases.pinyin: hěn duō niánqīng rén xiànzài dōu yǒu huánbǎo yìshi
phrases.translation: Many young people now have environmental awareness.

phrases.text: 这是一个好的变化。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì yí gè hǎo de biànhuà
phrases.translation: This is a good change.

phrases.text: 我相信环境会越来越好。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiāngxìn huánjìng huì yuè lái yuè hǎo
phrases.translation: I believe the environment will keep getting better.

phrases.text: 下个月我要去云南旅行。
phrases.pinyin: xià gè yuè wǒ yào qù Yúnnán lǚxíng
phrases.translation: Next month I'm traveling to Yunnan.

phrases.text: 这是我第一次去云南。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì qù Yúnnán
phrases.translation: This is my first time in Yunnan.

phrases.text: 我听说那里风景特别美。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ tīngshuō nàli fēngjǐng tèbié měi
phrases.translation: I hear the scenery there is really beautiful.

phrases.text: 我和两个朋友一起去。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hé liǎng gè péngyou yìqǐ qù
phrases.translation: I'm going with two friends.

phrases.text: 我们已经订了机票和酒店。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen yǐjīng dìng le jīpiào hé jiǔdiàn
phrases.translation: We've already booked flights and hotels.

phrases.text: 一共去七天。
phrases.pinyin: yígòng qù qī tiān
phrases.translation: We're going for seven days.

phrases.text: 我们打算先去昆明。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen dǎsuan xiān qù Kūnmíng
phrases.translation: We plan to go to Kunming first.

phrases.text: 然后去大理和丽江。
phrases.pinyin: ránhòu qù Dàlǐ hé Lìjiāng
phrases.translation: Then to Dali and Lijiang.

phrases.text: 那里有很多少数民族。
phrases.pinyin: nàli yǒu hěn duō shǎoshù mínzú
phrases.translation: There are many ethnic minorities there.

phrases.text: 我想尝一尝当地的菜。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng cháng yi cháng dāngdì de cài
phrases.translation: I want to try the local food.

phrases.text: 也要拍很多照片。
phrases.pinyin: yě yào pāi hěn duō zhàopiàn
phrases.translation: I'll also take lots of photos.

phrases.text: 我已经开始收拾行李了。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yǐjīng kāishǐ shōushi xíngli le
phrases.translation: I've already started packing.

phrases.text: 两年前,我的身体不太好。
phrases.pinyin: liǎng nián qián wǒ de shēntǐ bú tài hǎo
phrases.translation: Two years ago my body wasn't so great.

phrases.text: 我经常感冒,也容易累。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jīngcháng gǎnmào yě róngyì lèi
phrases.translation: I often caught colds and got tired easily.

phrases.text: 后来,我决定开始运动。
phrases.pinyin: hòulái wǒ juédìng kāishǐ yùndòng
phrases.translation: Later, I decided to start exercising.

phrases.text: 一开始我只是每天走路。
phrases.pinyin: yī kāishǐ wǒ zhǐ shì měitiān zǒulù
phrases.translation: At first I just walked every day.

phrases.text: 慢慢地,我开始跑步。
phrases.pinyin: mànmàn de wǒ kāishǐ pǎobù
phrases.translation: Gradually I started jogging.

phrases.text: 现在我每周去三次健身房。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ měi zhōu qù sān cì jiànshēn fáng
phrases.translation: Now I go to the gym three times a week.

phrases.text: 我也注意饮食。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yě zhùyì yǐnshí
phrases.translation: I also pay attention to my diet.

phrases.text: 少吃油腻的东西,多吃蔬菜水果。
phrases.pinyin: shǎo chī yóunì de dōngxi duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ
phrases.translation: Less oily food, more vegetables and fruit.

phrases.text: 我还学会了做一些健康的饭菜。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hái xuéhuì le zuò yìxiē jiànkāng de fàncài
phrases.translation: I've also learned to make some healthy meals.

phrases.text: 坚持运动以后,我的身体好多了。
phrases.pinyin: jiānchí yùndòng yǐhòu wǒ de shēntǐ hǎo duō le
phrases.translation: After sticking with exercise, my body is much better.

phrases.text: 我变得更有精神。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ biàn de gèng yǒu jīngshén
phrases.translation: I have more energy.

phrases.text: 健身已经成为我生活的一部分。
phrases.pinyin: jiànshēn yǐjīng chéngwéi wǒ shēnghuó de yí bùfèn
phrases.translation: Fitness has become a part of my life.

phrases.text: 我小时候有很多梦想。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎo shíhou yǒu hěn duō mèngxiǎng
phrases.translation: As a kid I had many dreams.

phrases.text: 我想当医生,也想当老师。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng dāng yīshēng yě xiǎng dāng lǎoshī
phrases.translation: I wanted to be a doctor and also a teacher.

phrases.text: 长大了以后,我的梦想变了。
phrases.pinyin: zhǎng dà le yǐhòu wǒ de mèngxiǎng biàn le
phrases.translation: When I grew up, my dream changed.

phrases.text: 现在我想开一家小咖啡店。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ xiǎng kāi yì jiā xiǎo kāfēi diàn
phrases.translation: Now I want to open a small café.

phrases.text: 一个安静又舒服的地方。
phrases.pinyin: yí gè ānjìng yòu shūfu de dìfang
phrases.translation: A quiet and comfortable place.

phrases.text: 客人可以在那里看书、聊天。
phrases.pinyin: kèrén kěyǐ zài nàli kànshū liáotiān
phrases.translation: Where customers can read and chat.

phrases.text: 我想自己做咖啡和蛋糕。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ zuò kāfēi hé dàngāo
phrases.translation: I want to make the coffee and cakes myself.

phrases.text: 我知道这不容易。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhīdào zhè bù róngyì
phrases.translation: I know it's not easy.

phrases.text: 我需要学很多东西。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xūyào xué hěn duō dōngxi
phrases.translation: I need to learn a lot.

phrases.text: 也需要很多钱。
phrases.pinyin: yě xūyào hěn duō qián
phrases.translation: I also need a lot of money.

phrases.text: 所以我现在努力工作,努力存钱。
phrases.pinyin: suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài nǔlì gōngzuò nǔlì cún qián
phrases.translation: So now I work hard and save carefully.

phrases.text: 我相信总有一天我能实现这个梦想。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiāngxìn zǒng yǒu yì tiān wǒ néng shíxiàn zhè gè mèngxiǎng
phrases.translation: I believe one day I'll make this dream real.

phrases.text: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
phrases.pinyin: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì
phrases.translation: Spring Festival is China's most important holiday.

phrases.text: 每年春节,我都回老家。
phrases.pinyin: měi nián Chūnjié wǒ dōu huí lǎojiā
phrases.translation: Every Spring Festival I go back to my hometown.

phrases.text: 我的家在南方的一个小城市。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de jiā zài nánfāng de yí gè xiǎo chéngshì
phrases.translation: My home is in a small city in the south.

phrases.text: 坐火车要十几个小时。
phrases.pinyin: zuò huǒchē yào shí jǐ gè xiǎoshí
phrases.translation: The train takes more than ten hours.

phrases.text: 火车票很难买。
phrases.pinyin: huǒchē piào hěn nán mǎi
phrases.translation: Train tickets are hard to get.

phrases.text: 但是我一定要回家。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì wǒ yídìng yào huí jiā
phrases.translation: But I definitely have to go home.

phrases.text: 除夕晚上,全家人一起吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: chúxī wǎnshang quán jiā rén yìqǐ chī fàn
phrases.translation: On New Year's Eve the whole family eats together.

phrases.text: 妈妈准备了很多好吃的。
phrases.pinyin: māma zhǔnbèi le hěn duō hǎo chī de
phrases.translation: Mom prepares a lot of delicious food.

phrases.text: 我们一边吃饭,一边看电视。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen yìbiān chī fàn yìbiān kàn diànshì
phrases.translation: We eat and watch TV at the same time.

phrases.text: 十二点的时候,外面开始放烟花。
phrases.pinyin: shí èr diǎn de shíhou wàimiàn kāishǐ fàng yānhuā
phrases.translation: At midnight fireworks start outside.

phrases.text: 我给爷爷奶奶拜年。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ gěi yéye nǎinai bàinián
phrases.translation: I wish my grandparents a happy new year.

phrases.text: 他们给我红包。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen gěi wǒ hóngbāo
phrases.translation: They give me red envelopes.

phrases.text: 和家人一起过年,我觉得最幸福。
phrases.pinyin: hé jiārén yìqǐ guònián wǒ juéde zuì xìngfú
phrases.translation: Celebrating with family feels like the greatest happiness.

phrases.text: 周六早上,我像往常一样去了家附近的咖啡馆。
phrases.pinyin: zhōuliù zǎoshang wǒ xiàng wǎngcháng yíyàng qù le jiā fùjìn de kāfēi guǎn
phrases.translation: Saturday morning, like usual, I went to the café near my home.

phrases.text: 我点了一杯拿铁,选了靠窗的位置。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ diǎn le yì bēi nátiě xuǎn le kào chuāng de wèizhi
phrases.translation: I ordered a latte and chose a seat by the window.

phrases.text: 阳光透过玻璃照进来,非常舒服。
phrases.pinyin: yángguāng tòuguò bōli zhào jìnlái fēicháng shūfu
phrases.translation: The sunlight streamed through the glass — it was very comfortable.

phrases.text: 旁边桌子上的老人在认真地看报纸。
phrases.pinyin: pángbiān zhuōzi shàng de lǎorén zài rènzhēn de kàn bàozhǐ
phrases.translation: An old man at the next table was reading the newspaper carefully.

phrases.text: 两个学生在热烈地讨论一个项目。
phrases.pinyin: liǎng ge xuésheng zài rèliè de tǎolùn yí ge xiàngmù
phrases.translation: Two students were passionately discussing some project.

phrases.text: 我拿出自己的书,却无法集中注意力。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ náchū zìjǐ de shū què wúfǎ jízhōng zhùyìlì
phrases.translation: I took out my book, but couldn't focus.

phrases.text: 在周末,咖啡馆更像一个公共客厅。
phrases.pinyin: zài zhōumò kāfēi guǎn gèng xiàng yí ge gōnggòng kètīng
phrases.translation: On weekends, the café feels more like a public living room.

phrases.text: 大家都有自己的生活,却一起分享安静的下午。
phrases.pinyin: dàjiā dōu yǒu zìjǐ de shēnghuó què yìqǐ fēnxiǎng ānjìng de xiàwǔ
phrases.translation: Everyone has their own life, sharing a peaceful afternoon together.

phrases.text: 咖啡馆的老板姓陈,他记得每个常客的口味。
phrases.pinyin: kāfēi guǎn de lǎobǎn xìng Chén tā jìde měi ge chángkè de kǒuwèi
phrases.translation: The café owner is surnamed Chen, and he remembers every regular's taste.

phrases.text: 我一进门,他就知道我要热的还是冰的。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yī jìn mén tā jiù zhīdào wǒ yào rè de háishi bīng de
phrases.translation: The moment I come through the door, he knows whether I want it hot or iced.

phrases.text: 下午三点左右,阳光慢慢移到了另一边。
phrases.pinyin: xiàwǔ sān diǎn zuǒyòu yángguāng mànmàn yí dào le lìng yì biān
phrases.translation: Around three in the afternoon, the sunlight slowly moved to the other side.

phrases.text: 一个女孩带着笔记本电脑坐下,开始工作。
phrases.pinyin: yí ge nǚhái dài zhe bǐjìběn diànnǎo zuò xià kāishǐ gōngzuò
phrases.translation: A girl sat down with a laptop and began to work.

phrases.text: 有人离开的时候,把一本读完的书留在了架子上。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu rén líkāi de shíhou bǎ yì běn dú wán de shū liú zài le jiàzi shàng
phrases.translation: When somebody left, they set a finished book on the shelf.

phrases.text: 那个架子上的书,都是客人留下的。
phrases.pinyin: nà ge jiàzi shàng de shū dōu shì kèrén liú xià de
phrases.translation: All the books on that shelf were left behind by customers.

phrases.text: 我想,这大概就是咖啡馆最好的地方。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhè dàgài jiùshì kāfēi guǎn zuì hǎo de dìfang
phrases.translation: I think this is probably the best thing about a café.

phrases.text: 你可以一个人待着,却不会觉得孤单。
phrases.pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ yí ge rén dāi zhe què bú huì juéde gūdān
phrases.translation: You can sit by yourself without feeling lonely.

phrases.text: 现在,越来越多的人喜欢在网上购物。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài yuèláiyuè duō de rén xǐhuan zài wǎngshàng gòuwù
phrases.translation: These days, more and more people prefer to shop online.

phrases.text: 无论是衣服、食品还是电子产品,几乎都能在网上买到。
phrases.pinyin: wúlùn shì yīfu shípǐn háishi diànzǐ chǎnpǐn jīhū dōu néng zài wǎngshàng mǎi dào
phrases.translation: Whether it's clothes, food, or electronics — almost everything can be bought online.

phrases.text: 网购的优点很明显:方便、快速,还可以比较价格。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnggòu de yōudiǎn hěn míngxiǎn fāngbiàn kuàisù hái kěyǐ bǐjiào jiàgé
phrases.translation: The advantages of online shopping are obvious: convenient, fast, and you can compare prices.

phrases.text: 不过它也有一些问题。
phrases.pinyin: búguò tā yě yǒu yìxiē wèntí
phrases.translation: But it also has some problems.

phrases.text: 有时候,实物和图片不一样。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu shíhou shíwù hé túpiàn bù yíyàng
phrases.translation: Sometimes the actual product doesn't match the picture.

phrases.text: 退货也很麻烦,要打包再寄回去。
phrases.pinyin: tuìhuò yě hěn máfan yào dǎbāo zài jì huíqù
phrases.translation: Returns are also a hassle — you have to package and ship it.
