phrases.text: 即便如此,我仍然觉得方便大于不便。
phrases.pinyin: jíbiàn rúcǐ wǒ réngrán juéde fāngbiàn dàyú búbiàn
phrases.translation: Even so, I still think the convenience outweighs the inconvenience.

phrases.text: 我记得第一次网购是十年前。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jìde dì yī cì wǎnggòu shì shí nián qián
phrases.translation: I remember my first online purchase, ten years ago.

phrases.text: 那时候付款要去银行,快递也要等一个星期。
phrases.pinyin: nà shíhou fùkuǎn yào qù yínháng kuàidì yě yào děng yí ge xīngqī
phrases.translation: Back then paying meant going to the bank, and delivery took a week.

phrases.text: 现在付款只要刷一下脸,第二天东西就到了。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài fùkuǎn zhǐ yào shuā yíxià liǎn dì èr tiān dōngxi jiù dào le
phrases.translation: Now paying takes one scan of your face, and the goods arrive the next day.

phrases.text: 双十一更是变成了全民的购物节。
phrases.pinyin: Shuāng Shíyī gèng shì biàn chéng le quánmín de gòuwù jié
phrases.translation: Double Eleven has even turned into a nationwide shopping festival.

phrases.text: 那一天,很多人熬夜等着零点下单。
phrases.pinyin: nà yì tiān hěn duō rén áoyè děng zhe líng diǎn xià dān
phrases.translation: On that day many people stay up waiting for midnight to place orders.

phrases.text: 商家提前一个月就开始做广告。
phrases.pinyin: shāngjiā tíqián yí ge yuè jiù kāishǐ zuò guǎnggào
phrases.translation: Merchants start advertising a full month ahead.

phrases.text: 不过这几年我慢慢学会了少买一些。
phrases.pinyin: búguò zhè jǐ nián wǒ mànmàn xuéhuì le shǎo mǎi yìxiē
phrases.translation: In recent years, though, I have gradually learned to buy less.

phrases.text: 便宜的东西买回来不用,也是浪费。
phrases.pinyin: piányi de dōngxi mǎi huílái bú yòng yě shì làngfèi
phrases.translation: Cheap things bought and never used are a waste too.

phrases.text: 上个月我从大学毕业,开始找工作。
phrases.pinyin: shàng ge yuè wǒ cóng dàxué bìyè kāishǐ zhǎo gōngzuò
phrases.translation: Last month I graduated from university and started looking for a job.

phrases.text: 我投了三十多份简历,却只收到三次面试机会。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ tóu le sānshí duō fèn jiǎnlì què zhǐ shōudào sān cì miànshì jīhuì
phrases.translation: I sent out more than thirty resumes but only got three interviews.

phrases.text: 每次面试都让我紧张,但也让我学到很多。
phrases.pinyin: měi cì miànshì dōu ràng wǒ jǐnzhāng dàn yě ràng wǒ xué dào hěn duō
phrases.translation: Every interview made me nervous, but I learned a lot too.

phrases.text: 有时候我会怀疑自己是不是选错了专业。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu shíhou wǒ huì huáiyí zìjǐ shì bu shì xuǎncuò le zhuānyè
phrases.translation: Sometimes I wondered if I had chosen the wrong field of study.

phrases.text: 朋友们告诉我别着急,万事开头难。
phrases.pinyin: péngyoumen gàosu wǒ bié zháojí wànshì kāitóu nán
phrases.translation: Friends told me not to worry — every beginning is hard.

phrases.text: 昨天我终于拿到了一份还算满意的工作。
phrases.pinyin: zuótiān wǒ zhōngyú nádào le yí fèn hái suàn mǎnyì de gōngzuò
phrases.translation: Yesterday I finally got an offer that I'm fairly satisfied with.

phrases.text: 现在回头看,那段等待的日子也没有白过。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài huítóu kàn nà duàn děngdài de rìzi yě méiyǒu bái guò
phrases.translation: Looking back now, those days of waiting weren't wasted.

phrases.text: 我还记得第一次面试时的样子。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ hái jìde dì yī cì miànshì shí de yàngzi
phrases.translation: I still remember what I was like at my first interview.

phrases.text: 我提前一个小时就到了公司楼下。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ tíqián yí ge xiǎoshí jiù dào le gōngsī lóu xià
phrases.translation: I arrived downstairs from the company a whole hour early.

phrases.text: 因为太紧张,我在外面走来走去。
phrases.pinyin: yīnwèi tài jǐnzhāng wǒ zài wàimiàn zǒu lái zǒu qù
phrases.translation: Because I was so nervous, I paced back and forth outside.

phrases.text: 面试官问我为什么想做这份工作。
phrases.pinyin: miànshì guān wèn wǒ wèi shénme xiǎng zuò zhè fèn gōngzuò
phrases.translation: The interviewer asked me why I wanted this job.

phrases.text: 我准备了很久的答案,却说得乱七八糟。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ de dá'àn què shuō de luàn qī bā zāo
phrases.translation: I had prepared an answer for a long time, yet I said it all in a muddle.

phrases.text: 后来我才明白,面试不只是回答问题。
phrases.pinyin: hòulái wǒ cái míngbai miànshì bù zhǐshì huídá wèntí
phrases.translation: Only later did I understand that an interview is not just answering questions.

phrases.text: 他们更想知道你是一个什么样的人。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen gèng xiǎng zhīdào nǐ shì yí ge shénme yàng de rén
phrases.translation: What they want more is to know what kind of person you are.

phrases.text: 现在我坐在自己的工位上,还常常想起那些日子。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ zuò zài zìjǐ de gōngwèi shàng hái chángcháng xiǎng qǐ nàxiē rìzi
phrases.translation: Now, sitting at my own desk, I still often think of those days.

phrases.text: 早上八点,北京地铁每节车厢都挤满了人。
phrases.pinyin: zǎoshang bā diǎn Běijīng dìtiě měi jié chēxiāng dōu jǐ mǎn le rén
phrases.translation: At eight in the morning on the Beijing subway, every car is packed.

phrases.text: 有的人在看手机,有的人还没完全睡醒。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu de rén zài kàn shǒujī yǒu de rén hái méi wánquán shuìxǐng
phrases.translation: Some are checking phones, some are still half asleep.

phrases.text: 列车到换乘站时,大家一下子都往前挤。
phrases.pinyin: lièchē dào huànchéng zhàn shí dàjiā yíxiàzi dōu wǎng qián jǐ
phrases.translation: When the train arrives at a transfer station, everyone surges forward at once.

phrases.text: 我紧紧抱住包,怕和东西分开。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jǐnjǐn bàozhù bāo pà hé dōngxi fēnkāi
phrases.translation: I held my bag tightly, afraid of being separated from my belongings.

phrases.text: 广播里反复提醒:"看好随身物品,站稳扶好。"
phrases.pinyin: guǎngbō lǐ fǎnfù tíxǐng kānhǎo suíshēn wùpǐn zhàn wěn fú hǎo
phrases.translation: The voice on the speaker repeats: "Mind your belongings, please stand firm."

phrases.text: 虽然拥挤,却没有人抱怨。
phrases.pinyin: suīrán yōngjǐ què méiyǒu rén bàoyuàn
phrases.translation: Although crowded, no one complains.

phrases.text: 这就是城市的节奏,既是压力,也是一种丰富的活力。
phrases.pinyin: zhè jiùshì chéngshì de jiézòu jì shì yālì yě shì yì zhǒng fēngfù de huólì
phrases.translation: This is the rhythm of the city — both pressure and a kind of rich vitality.

phrases.text: 十号线是北京最忙的线路之一。
phrases.pinyin: shí hào xiàn shì Běijīng zuì máng de xiànlù zhī yī
phrases.translation: Line 10 is one of the busiest lines in Beijing.

phrases.text: 有时候要等两三趟车才能挤上去。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu shíhou yào děng liǎng sān tàng chē cái néng jǐ shàngqù
phrases.translation: Sometimes you have to wait for two or three trains before you can squeeze on.

phrases.text: 站台上有工作人员帮忙把乘客推进车厢。
phrases.pinyin: zhàntái shàng yǒu gōngzuò rényuán bāngmáng bǎ chéngkè tuī jìn chēxiāng
phrases.translation: On the platform, staff help push passengers into the carriage.

phrases.text: 车厢里几乎没有人说话。
phrases.pinyin: chēxiāng lǐ jīhū méiyǒu rén shuōhuà
phrases.translation: Inside the carriage almost nobody speaks.

phrases.text: 只听得见广播和手机的声音。
phrases.pinyin: zhǐ tīng de jiàn guǎngbō hé shǒujī de shēngyīn
phrases.translation: You can hear only the announcements and the sound of phones.

phrases.text: 到了国贸站,一大半人同时下车。
phrases.pinyin: dào le Guómào zhàn yí dà bàn rén tóngshí xià chē
phrases.translation: At Guomao station, well over half the people get off at once.

phrases.text: 车厢忽然空了下来,我终于找到座位。
phrases.pinyin: chēxiāng hūrán kōng le xiàlái wǒ zhōngyú zhǎo dào zuòwèi
phrases.translation: The carriage suddenly empties, and I finally find a seat.

phrases.text: 可是再过两站,我也该下车了。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì zài guò liǎng zhàn wǒ yě gāi xià chē le
phrases.translation: But two stops later, it is my turn to get off as well.

phrases.text: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。
phrases.pinyin: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de chuántǒng jiérì
phrases.translation: Spring Festival is the most important traditional Chinese holiday.

phrases.text: 无论在哪里,人们都会想办法回家团圆。
phrases.pinyin: wúlùn zài nǎlǐ rénmen dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ huí jiā tuányuán
phrases.translation: No matter where they are, people try their best to go home for the reunion.

phrases.text: 除夕晚上,全家会聚在一起吃年夜饭。
phrases.pinyin: chúxī wǎnshang quánjiā huì jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn
phrases.translation: On New Year's Eve, the whole family gathers to eat the reunion dinner.

phrases.text: 饺子是北方必吃的一道菜,象征着好运。
phrases.pinyin: jiǎozi shì běifāng bì chī de yí dào cài xiàngzhēng zhe hǎoyùn
phrases.translation: Dumplings are a must-have dish in the north — they symbolize good fortune.

phrases.text: 饭后,孩子们会放鞭炮,大人则看春晚。
phrases.pinyin: fàn hòu háizimen huì fàng biānpào dàren zé kàn chūn wǎn
phrases.translation: After the meal, kids set off firecrackers and adults watch the TV gala.

phrases.text: 大年初一,人们互相拜年,送祝福。
phrases.pinyin: dànián chūyī rénmen hùxiāng bàinián sòng zhùfú
phrases.translation: On the first day of the new year, you visit relatives and offer New Year greetings.

phrases.text: 这些风俗背后,是中国人对家庭的重视。
phrases.pinyin: zhèxiē fēngsú bèihòu shì Zhōngguó rén duì jiātíng de zhòngshì
phrases.translation: Behind these customs is the importance Chinese people place on family.

phrases.text: 春节前,家家户户都要打扫房子。
phrases.pinyin: Chūnjié qián jiājiā hùhù dōu yào dǎsǎo fángzi
phrases.translation: Before Spring Festival, every household has to clean the house.

phrases.text: 这叫"扫尘",意思是把旧的一年扫出去。
phrases.pinyin: zhè jiào sǎo chén yìsi shì bǎ jiù de yì nián sǎo chūqù
phrases.translation: This is called "sweeping the dust" — it means sweeping the old year out.

phrases.text: 门上要贴红色的春联和"福"字。
phrases.pinyin: mén shàng yào tiē hóngsè de chūnlián hé fú zì
phrases.translation: Red couplets and the character for "fortune" go up on the door.

phrases.text: 有些人还会把"福"字倒着贴。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu xiē rén hái huì bǎ fú zì dào zhe tiē
phrases.translation: Some people even paste the "fortune" character upside down.

phrases.text: 因为"倒"和"到"同音,表示福气到了。
phrases.pinyin: yīnwèi dào hé dào tóngyīn biǎoshì fúqi dào le
phrases.translation: Because "upside down" and "arrived" sound the same, it says fortune has arrived.

phrases.text: 长辈会给孩子红包,里面装着压岁钱。
phrases.pinyin: zhǎngbèi huì gěi háizi hóngbāo lǐmiàn zhuāng zhe yāsuì qián
phrases.translation: Elders give children red envelopes holding lucky money.

phrases.text: 从初一到十五,亲戚之间互相走动。
phrases.pinyin: cóng chū yī dào shíwǔ qīnqi zhījiān hùxiāng zǒudòng
phrases.translation: From the first to the fifteenth, relatives visit back and forth.

phrases.text: 一直到元宵节,春节才算真正结束。
phrases.pinyin: yìzhí dào Yuánxiāo Jié Chūnjié cái suàn zhēnzhèng jiéshù
phrases.translation: Only at the Lantern Festival does Spring Festival truly end.

phrases.text: 长城是中国最有名的建筑之一。
phrases.pinyin: Chángchéng shì Zhōngguó zuì yǒumíng de jiànzhù zhī yī
phrases.translation: The Great Wall is one of China's most famous landmarks.

phrases.text: 它最初是为了防止北方民族的进攻而建造的。
phrases.pinyin: tā zuìchū shì wèile fángzhǐ běifāng mínzú de jìngōng ér jiànzào de
phrases.translation: It was originally built to defend against attacks from northern tribes.

phrases.text: 从春秋时期开始,许多诸侯国就开始修城墙。
phrases.pinyin: cóng Chūnqiū shíqī kāishǐ xǔduō zhūhóuguó jiù kāishǐ xiū chéngqiáng
phrases.translation: From the Spring and Autumn period onward, many states started building walls.

phrases.text: 秦始皇统一中国后,把它们连接成一条。
phrases.pinyin: Qín Shǐhuáng tǒngyī Zhōngguó hòu bǎ tāmen liánjiē chéng yì tiáo
phrases.translation: After Qin Shi Huang unified China, he connected the walls into one.

phrases.text: 我们今天看到的长城,大部分是明朝修建的。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen jīntiān kàndào de Chángchéng dàbùfen shì Míngcháo xiūjiàn de
phrases.translation: The Great Wall we see today was largely built during the Ming Dynasty.

phrases.text: 修建长城耗费了无数劳工和许多生命。
phrases.pinyin: xiūjiàn Chángchéng hàofèi le wúshù láogōng hé xǔduō shēngmìng
phrases.translation: Building the wall took countless laborers and many lives.

phrases.text: 如今,它已经不再是防御工事,而是历史的见证。
phrases.pinyin: rújīn tā yǐjīng búzài shì fángyù gōngshì érshì lìshǐ de jiànzhèng
phrases.translation: Today, it is no longer a defensive structure, but a witness to history.

phrases.text: 长城不是一道简单的墙。
phrases.pinyin: Chángchéng bú shì yí dào jiǎndān de qiáng
phrases.translation: The Great Wall is not one simple wall.

phrases.text: 它包括城墙、关口、烽火台和驻军的城堡。
phrases.pinyin: tā bāokuò chéngqiáng guānkǒu fēnghuǒ tái hé zhùjūn de chéngbǎo
phrases.translation: It includes ramparts, passes, beacon towers and garrison forts.

phrases.text: 烽火台是古代最快的通信方式。
phrases.pinyin: fēnghuǒ tái shì gǔdài zuì kuài de tōngxìn fāngshì
phrases.translation: The beacon towers were the fastest form of communication in antiquity.

phrases.text: 发现敌人的时候,白天放烟,晚上点火。
phrases.pinyin: fāxiàn dírén de shíhou báitiān fàng yān wǎnshang diǎn huǒ
phrases.translation: On sighting the enemy, they raised smoke by day and lit fire by night.

phrases.text: 一个信号可以在几个小时内传到很远的地方。
phrases.pinyin: yí ge xìnhào kěyǐ zài jǐ ge xiǎoshí nèi chuán dào hěn yuǎn de dìfang
phrases.translation: A single signal could travel a great distance within a few hours.

phrases.text: 有一句老话说:"不到长城非好汉。"
phrases.pinyin: yǒu yí jù lǎohuà shuō bú dào Chángchéng fēi hǎohàn
phrases.translation: There is an old saying: "You are no hero until you reach the Great Wall."

phrases.text: 今天每年有上千万人来这里爬长城。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān měi nián yǒu shàng qiān wàn rén lái zhèlǐ pá Chángchéng
phrases.translation: Today tens of millions of people come here every year to climb it.

phrases.text: 站在城墙上往远处看,你才明白它有多长。
phrases.pinyin: zhàn zài chéngqiáng shàng wǎng yuǎnchù kàn nǐ cái míngbai tā yǒu duō cháng
phrases.translation: Only standing on the rampart and looking into the distance do you grasp its length.

phrases.text: 中国是茶的故乡之一,饮茶已有几千年的历史。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngguó shì chá de gùxiāng zhī yī yǐnchá yǐ yǒu jǐqiān nián de lìshǐ
phrases.translation: China is one of the homelands of tea, and tea-drinking has thousands of years of history.

phrases.text: 茶的种类很多,有绿茶、乌龙茶、普洱、白茶等等。
phrases.pinyin: chá de zhǒnglèi hěn duō yǒu lǜchá wūlóng chá pǔ'ěr báichá děngděng
phrases.translation: There are many varieties of tea — green tea, oolong, pu'er, white tea, and so on.

phrases.text: 不同的茶需要不同的泡法和水温。
phrases.pinyin: bùtóng de chá xūyào bùtóng de pàofǎ hé shuǐwēn
phrases.translation: Different teas need different brewing methods and water temperatures.

phrases.text: 在中国南方,喝茶还是一种社交方式。
phrases.pinyin: zài Zhōngguó nánfāng hēchá háishi yì zhǒng shèjiāo fāngshì
phrases.translation: In southern China, tea-drinking is also a way to socialize.

phrases.text: 朋友在茶馆里见面,边喝茶边聊天,可以度过整个下午。
phrases.pinyin: péngyou zài cháguǎn lǐ jiànmiàn biān hēchá biān liáotiān kěyǐ dùguò zhěnggè xiàwǔ
phrases.translation: Friends meet in a teahouse, sip tea, and chat — it can pass an entire afternoon.

phrases.text: 茶道讲究"和、敬、清、寂"。
phrases.pinyin: chádào jiǎngjiu hé jìng qīng jì
phrases.translation: The tea ceremony emphasizes "harmony, respect, purity, tranquility."

phrases.text: 它不仅是一种饮料,也是一种生活态度。
phrases.pinyin: tā bùjǐn shì yì zhǒng yǐnliào yě shì yì zhǒng shēnghuó tàidu
phrases.translation: It's not just a drink — it's also a way of life.

phrases.text: 中国人喝茶讲究"看、闻、品"三步。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngguó rén hē chá jiǎngjiu kàn wén pǐn sān bù
phrases.translation: Chinese tea drinking observes three steps: look, smell, taste.

phrases.text: 先看茶叶的颜色和形状。
phrases.pinyin: xiān kàn cháyè de yánsè hé xíngzhuàng
phrases.translation: First look at the color and shape of the leaves.

phrases.text: 再闻它的香气。
phrases.pinyin: zài wén tā de xiāngqì
phrases.translation: Then smell its fragrance.

phrases.text: 最后小口地喝,让茶在嘴里停一会儿。
phrases.pinyin: zuìhòu xiǎo kǒu de hē ràng chá zài zuǐ lǐ tíng yíhuìr
phrases.translation: Finally sip it slowly, letting the tea rest a moment in your mouth.

phrases.text: 好茶喝完以后,嘴里会有回甘。
phrases.pinyin: hǎo chá hē wán yǐhòu zuǐ lǐ huì yǒu huígān
phrases.translation: After good tea, a sweetness comes back into the mouth.

phrases.text: 送茶给长辈是很常见的礼物。
phrases.pinyin: sòng chá gěi zhǎngbèi shì hěn chángjiàn de lǐwù
phrases.translation: Giving tea to an elder is a very common gift.

phrases.text: 不过送礼的时候要注意,不能送太便宜的茶。
phrases.pinyin: búguò sòng lǐ de shíhou yào zhùyì bù néng sòng tài piányi de chá
phrases.translation: But take care when giving it — you cannot give tea that is too cheap.

phrases.text: 在很多家庭里,泡一壶茶就是欢迎客人的方式。
phrases.pinyin: zài hěn duō jiātíng lǐ pào yì hú chá jiùshì huānyíng kèrén de fāngshì
phrases.translation: In many homes, brewing a pot of tea is simply how a guest is welcomed.

phrases.text: 京剧是中国传统戏剧的代表。
phrases.pinyin: jīngjù shì Zhōngguó chuántǒng xìjù de dàibiǎo
phrases.translation: Peking Opera is a representative form of traditional Chinese theatre.

phrases.text: 它融合了唱、念、做、打四种表演。
phrases.pinyin: tā rónghé le chàng niàn zuò dǎ sì zhǒng biǎoyǎn
phrases.translation: It combines singing, recitation, acting, and martial arts.

phrases.text: 演员穿着鲜艳的戏服,画着精致的脸谱。
phrases.pinyin: yǎnyuán chuānzhe xiānyàn de xìfú huà zhe jīngzhì de liǎnpǔ
phrases.translation: Performers wear bright costumes and exquisite face makeup.

phrases.text: 不同颜色和图案代表角色的性格。
phrases.pinyin: bùtóng yánsè hé tú'àn dàibiǎo juésè de xìnggé
phrases.translation: Different colors and patterns express the character's personality.

phrases.text: 比如,红色代表忠诚,白色则常常代表奸诈。
phrases.pinyin: bǐrú hóngsè dàibiǎo zhōngchéng báisè zé chángcháng dàibiǎo jiānzhà
phrases.translation: For example, red represents loyalty and white often represents cunning.

phrases.text: 外国观众刚开始会觉得它的节奏很慢。
phrases.pinyin: wàiguó guānzhòng gāng kāishǐ huì juéde tā de jiézòu hěn màn
phrases.translation: Foreign visitors at first feel its rhythm is slow.

phrases.text: 但一旦理解了它的象征语言,每一个动作都有意义。
phrases.pinyin: dàn yídàn lǐjiě le tā de xiàngzhēng yǔyán měi yí ge dòngzuò dōu yǒu yìyì
phrases.translation: Once you understand the symbolic language, every gesture has meaning.

phrases.text: 京剧的舞台其实很简单。
phrases.pinyin: Jīngjù de wǔtái qíshí hěn jiǎndān
phrases.translation: The Peking Opera stage is in fact very plain.

phrases.text: 台上常常只有一桌两椅。
phrases.pinyin: tái shàng chángcháng zhǐ yǒu yì zhuō liǎng yǐ
phrases.translation: Often there is only one table and two chairs on it.

phrases.text: 演员用动作告诉观众他在哪里。
phrases.pinyin: yǎnyuán yòng dòngzuò gàosu guānzhòng tā zài nǎlǐ
phrases.translation: The actor uses movement to tell the audience where he is.

phrases.text: 拿着马鞭走几步,就表示骑马走了很远。
phrases.pinyin: ná zhe mǎbiān zǒu jǐ bù jiù biǎoshì qí mǎ zǒu le hěn yuǎn
phrases.translation: Holding a riding crop and taking a few steps means he has ridden far.

phrases.text: 做出划桨的动作,就是在河上坐船。
phrases.pinyin: zuò chū huá jiǎng de dòngzuò jiùshì zài hé shàng zuò chuán
phrases.translation: Making the motion of an oar means travelling by boat on a river.

phrases.text: 这种表演方式叫"虚拟",全靠想象。
phrases.pinyin: zhè zhǒng biǎoyǎn fāngshì jiào xūnǐ quán kào xiǎngxiàng
phrases.translation: This manner of performing is called "the virtual", resting wholly on imagination.

phrases.text: 京剧最有名的剧目之一是《霸王别姬》。
phrases.pinyin: Jīngjù zuì yǒumíng de jùmù zhī yī shì Bà Wáng Bié Jī
phrases.translation: One of the most famous works is Farewell My Concubine.

phrases.text: 如果你只看一出戏,可以从它开始。
phrases.pinyin: rúguǒ nǐ zhǐ kàn yì chū xì kěyǐ cóng tā kāishǐ
phrases.translation: If you are only going to see one opera, you could start with that one.

phrases.text: 上个星期我有点不舒服,就去医院看医生。
phrases.pinyin: shàng ge xīngqī wǒ yǒudiǎn bù shūfu jiù qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng
phrases.translation: Last week I felt a bit unwell, so I went to the hospital to see a doctor.

phrases.text: 中国的医院跟西方的不太一样。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngguó de yīyuàn gēn xīfāng de bú tài yíyàng
phrases.translation: Chinese hospitals are not quite the same as Western ones.

phrases.text: 你不用先打电话预约,可以直接去挂号。
phrases.pinyin: nǐ búyòng xiān dǎ diànhuà yùyuē kěyǐ zhíjiē qù guàhào
phrases.translation: You don't need to call ahead for an appointment — you can just go and register.

phrases.text: 我在手机上挂了内科的号,省了不少时间。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zài shǒujī shàng guà le nèikē de hào shěng le bùshǎo shíjiān
phrases.translation: I booked an internal medicine slot on my phone, which saved a lot of time.

phrases.text: 等了大概二十分钟,护士就叫我的名字。
phrases.pinyin: děng le dàgài èrshí fēnzhōng hùshi jiù jiào wǒ de míngzi
phrases.translation: After waiting about twenty minutes, the nurse called my name.

phrases.text: 医生问我哪里不舒服,我说我嗓子疼,还有点发烧。
phrases.pinyin: yīshēng wèn wǒ nǎlǐ bù shūfu wǒ shuō wǒ sǎngzi téng hái yǒudiǎn fāshāo
phrases.translation: The doctor asked where it hurt; I said my throat was sore and I had a slight fever.

phrases.text: 他让我张开嘴,看了看,又量了体温。
phrases.pinyin: tā ràng wǒ zhāngkāi zuǐ kàn le kàn yòu liáng le tǐwēn
phrases.translation: He had me open my mouth, took a look, and then measured my temperature.

phrases.text: 他说我只是普通的感冒,不用太担心。
phrases.pinyin: tā shuō wǒ zhǐshì pǔtōng de gǎnmào búyòng tài dānxīn
phrases.translation: He said it was just an ordinary cold and there was no need to worry.

phrases.text: 然后他给我开了药,让我去一楼取药。
phrases.pinyin: ránhòu tā gěi wǒ kāi le yào ràng wǒ qù yī lóu qǔ yào
phrases.translation: Then he prescribed medicine and told me to collect it on the first floor.

phrases.text: 取药的地方排着长队,大家都很有耐心。
phrases.pinyin: qǔ yào de dìfang pái zhe cháng duì dàjiā dōu hěn yǒu nàixīn
phrases.translation: A long queue had formed at the pharmacy counter, and everyone was patient.

phrases.text: 药一共花了三十多块钱,比我想象的便宜。
phrases.pinyin: yào yígòng huā le sānshí duō kuài qián bǐ wǒ xiǎngxiàng de piányi
phrases.translation: The medicine cost a little over thirty yuan in total — cheaper than I had imagined.

phrases.text: 医生提醒我要多喝热水,多休息。
phrases.pinyin: yīshēng tíxǐng wǒ yào duō hē rèshuǐ duō xiūxi
phrases.translation: The doctor reminded me to drink plenty of hot water and get plenty of rest.

phrases.text: 回家以后我睡了一个下午。
phrases.pinyin: huí jiā yǐhòu wǒ shuì le yí ge xiàwǔ
phrases.translation: After getting home I slept the whole afternoon.

phrases.text: 过了两天,我果然好多了。
phrases.pinyin: guò le liǎng tiān wǒ guǒrán hǎo duō le
phrases.translation: Two days later, sure enough, I was much better.

phrases.text: 来北京工作以后,我做的第一件大事就是租房子。
phrases.pinyin: lái Běijīng gōngzuò yǐhòu wǒ zuò de dì yī jiàn dàshì jiùshì zū fángzi
phrases.translation: After coming to Beijing for work, the first big thing I did was rent an apartment.

phrases.text: 我在网上看了很多房子的照片,可是照片常常比真的好看。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zài wǎng shàng kàn le hěn duō fángzi de zhàopiàn kěshì zhàopiàn chángcháng bǐ zhēn de hǎokàn
phrases.translation: I looked at many photos of apartments online, but photos are often better-looking than the real thing.

phrases.text: 后来朋友介绍我认识了一位中介。
phrases.pinyin: hòulái péngyou jièshào wǒ rènshi le yí wèi zhōngjiè
phrases.translation: Later a friend introduced me to an agent.

phrases.text: 他带我一个下午看了四套房子。
phrases.pinyin: tā dài wǒ yí ge xiàwǔ kàn le sì tào fángzi
phrases.translation: In one afternoon he showed me four apartments.

phrases.text: 第一套离地铁站很近,但是太贵了。
phrases.pinyin: dì yī tào lí dìtiě zhàn hěn jìn dànshì tài guì le
phrases.translation: The first was very close to the subway station, but far too expensive.

phrases.text: 第二套房租便宜,可是楼太旧,厨房也很小。
phrases.pinyin: dì èr tào fángzū piányi kěshì lóu tài jiù chúfáng yě hěn xiǎo
phrases.translation: The second had cheap rent, but the building was too old and the kitchen was tiny.

phrases.text: 第三套朝北,一天到晚都晒不到太阳。
phrases.pinyin: dì sān tào cháo běi yì tiān dào wǎn dōu shài bú dào tàiyáng
phrases.translation: The third faced north and got no sun from morning to night.

phrases.text: 最后一套在六楼,没有电梯,不过房间又干净又亮。
phrases.pinyin: zuìhòu yí tào zài liù lóu méiyǒu diàntī búguò fángjiān yòu gānjìng yòu liàng
phrases.translation: The last was on the sixth floor with no elevator, but the rooms were clean and bright.

phrases.text: 我站在窗户前面,看见楼下有一棵大树。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhàn zài chuānghu qiánmiàn kànjiàn lóu xià yǒu yì kē dà shù
phrases.translation: I stood in front of the window and saw a big tree down below.

phrases.text: 就是那棵树让我决定租下来。
phrases.pinyin: jiùshì nà kē shù ràng wǒ juédìng zū xiàlái
phrases.translation: It was that tree that made me decide to take the place.

phrases.text: 签合同的时候,我看得特别仔细。
phrases.pinyin: qiān hétong de shíhou wǒ kàn de tèbié zǐxì
phrases.translation: When I signed the contract, I read it especially carefully.

phrases.text: 押金是两个月的房租,这在北京很常见。
phrases.pinyin: yājīn shì liǎng ge yuè de fángzū zhè zài Běijīng hěn chángjiàn
phrases.translation: The deposit was two months' rent, which is very common in Beijing.

phrases.text: 搬进去的那天晚上,我坐在空空的地板上吃泡面。
phrases.pinyin: bān jìnqù de nà tiān wǎnshang wǒ zuò zài kōngkōng de dìbǎn shàng chī pàomiàn
phrases.translation: The night I moved in, I sat on the empty floor eating instant noodles.

phrases.text: 虽然什么家具都没有,但我觉得心里很踏实。
phrases.pinyin: suīrán shénme jiājù dōu méiyǒu dàn wǒ juéde xīn lǐ hěn tāshi
phrases.translation: Although I had no furniture at all, I felt settled inside.

phrases.text: 在中国生活,最方便的事情之一就是点外卖。
phrases.pinyin: zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó zuì fāngbiàn de shìqing zhī yī jiùshì diǎn wàimài
phrases.translation: One of the most convenient things about living in China is ordering takeout.

phrases.text: 不管你想吃什么,手机上点几下就行了。
phrases.pinyin: bùguǎn nǐ xiǎng chī shénme shǒujī shàng diǎn jǐ xià jiù xíng le
phrases.translation: Whatever you want to eat, a few taps on your phone is enough.

phrases.text: 早上的豆浆油条,晚上的火锅,都可以送到家门口。
phrases.pinyin: zǎoshang de dòujiāng yóutiáo wǎnshang de huǒguō dōu kěyǐ sòng dào jiā ménkǒu
phrases.translation: Soy milk and fried dough sticks in the morning, hot pot at night — all delivered to your door.

phrases.text: 常常等不到三十分钟,外卖员就到了。
phrases.pinyin: chángcháng děng bú dào sānshí fēnzhōng wàimài yuán jiù dào le
phrases.translation: Often the delivery rider arrives in under thirty minutes.

phrases.text: 快递也一样快,有时候上午下单,下午就收到了。
phrases.pinyin: kuàidì yě yíyàng kuài yǒu shíhou shàngwǔ xià dān xiàwǔ jiù shōudào le
phrases.translation: Parcels are just as fast — sometimes you order in the morning and get it that afternoon.

phrases.text: 我住的楼下有一排快递柜。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zhù de lóu xià yǒu yì pái kuàidì guì
phrases.translation: There is a row of parcel lockers downstairs from where I live.

phrases.text: 每天下班回家,我都会顺便看看有没有我的包裹。
phrases.pinyin: měitiān xiàbān huí jiā wǒ dōu huì shùnbiàn kànkan yǒu méi yǒu wǒ de bāoguǒ
phrases.translation: Every day on my way home from work, I check whether any parcel is mine.

phrases.text: 这种方便当然有它的代价。
phrases.pinyin: zhè zhǒng fāngbiàn dāngrán yǒu tā de dàijià
phrases.translation: This kind of convenience naturally has its price.

phrases.text: 外卖员为了赶时间,在路上骑得很快。
phrases.pinyin: wàimài yuán wèile gǎn shíjiān zài lù shàng qí de hěn kuài
phrases.translation: To save time, delivery riders ride very fast on the road.

phrases.text: 一次下大雨,我看见一个外卖员浑身都湿透了。
phrases.pinyin: yí cì xià dà yǔ wǒ kànjiàn yí ge wàimài yuán húnshēn dōu shī tòu le
phrases.translation: Once during heavy rain, I saw a rider soaked from head to toe.

phrases.text: 他把餐盒抱在怀里,自己却站在雨里。
phrases.pinyin: tā bǎ cān hé bào zài huái lǐ zìjǐ què zhàn zài yǔ lǐ
phrases.translation: He held the food box against his chest while standing in the rain himself.

phrases.text: 我接过来的时候,盒子还是热的。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiē guòlái de shíhou hézi háishi rè de
phrases.translation: When I took it from him, the box was still warm.

phrases.text: 从那以后,我总会多说一句"谢谢,辛苦了"。
phrases.pinyin: cóng nà yǐhòu wǒ zǒng huì duō shuō yí jù xièxie xīnkǔ le
phrases.translation: Ever since then, I always add a line: "Thank you, that was hard work."

phrases.text: 方便的背后,是很多人跑出来的时间。
phrases.pinyin: fāngbiàn de bèihòu shì hěn duō rén pǎo chūlái de shíjiān
phrases.translation: Behind the convenience is a great deal of time that other people ran for you.

phrases.text: 农历八月十五是中秋节,是中国人很重视的节日。
phrases.pinyin: nónglì bā yuè shíwǔ shì Zhōngqiū Jié shì Zhōngguó rén hěn zhòngshì de jiérì
phrases.translation: The fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month is Mid-Autumn Festival, a holiday Chinese people take seriously.

phrases.text: 这一天的月亮最圆,也最亮。
phrases.pinyin: zhè yì tiān de yuèliang zuì yuán yě zuì liàng
phrases.translation: On this day the moon is at its roundest and brightest.

phrases.text: 中秋节最重要的事情,就是一家人团圆。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngqiū Jié zuì zhòngyào de shìqing jiùshì yì jiā rén tuányuán
phrases.translation: The most important thing about Mid-Autumn is the family being together.

phrases.text: 不管走得多远,很多人都会想办法回家。
phrases.pinyin: bùguǎn zǒu de duō yuǎn hěn duō rén dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ huí jiā
phrases.translation: No matter how far away they are, many people find a way to go home.

phrases.text: 晚饭以后,大家把桌子搬到院子里或者阳台上。
phrases.pinyin: wǎnfàn yǐhòu dàjiā bǎ zhuōzi bān dào yuànzi lǐ huòzhě yángtái shàng
phrases.translation: After dinner, everyone moves the table out to the courtyard or the balcony.

phrases.text: 桌上放着月饼、水果和热茶。
phrases.pinyin: zhuō shàng fàng zhe yuèbǐng shuǐguǒ hé rè chá
phrases.translation: On the table sit mooncakes, fruit and hot tea.

phrases.text: 月饼的味道很多,有豆沙的,有莲蓉的,还有咸蛋黄的。
phrases.pinyin: yuèbǐng de wèidào hěn duō yǒu dòushā de yǒu liánróng de hái yǒu xián dànhuáng de
phrases.translation: Mooncakes come in many flavors: red bean paste, lotus seed paste, and salted egg yolk.

phrases.text: 现在还出现了冰淇淋月饼和巧克力月饼。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài hái chūxiàn le bīngqílín yuèbǐng hé qiǎokèlì yuèbǐng
phrases.translation: These days there are even ice cream mooncakes and chocolate mooncakes.

phrases.text: 老人常常一边看月亮,一边讲嫦娥的故事。
phrases.pinyin: lǎorén chángcháng yìbiān kàn yuèliang yìbiān jiǎng Cháng'é de gùshi
phrases.translation: The old people often watch the moon while telling the story of Chang'e.

phrases.text: 传说嫦娥吃了长生不老药,飞到了月亮上。
phrases.pinyin: chuánshuō Cháng'é chī le chángshēng bù lǎo yào fēi dào le yuèliang shàng
phrases.translation: Legend says Chang'e swallowed the elixir of immortality and flew up to the moon.

phrases.text: 从此她就住在广寒宫里,再也回不来了。
phrases.pinyin: cóngcǐ tā jiù zhù zài Guǎnghán Gōng lǐ zài yě huí bù lái le
phrases.translation: From then on she lived in the Cold Palace and could never come back.

phrases.text: 所以中秋的月亮里,总有一点点寂寞。
phrases.pinyin: suǒyǐ Zhōngqiū de yuèliang lǐ zǒng yǒu yìdiǎndiǎn jìmò
phrases.translation: So in the Mid-Autumn moon there is always a little loneliness.

phrases.text: 如果那天你在外地,也不要难过。
phrases.pinyin: rúguǒ nà tiān nǐ zài wàidì yě búyào nánguò
phrases.translation: If you are away from home that day, don't be sad.

phrases.text: 因为你和家人看到的,是同一个月亮。
phrases.pinyin: yīnwèi nǐ hé jiārén kàndào de shì tóng yí ge yuèliang
phrases.translation: Because what you and your family see is one and the same moon.

phrases.text: 几年前,共享单车在中国的城市迅速普及。
phrases.pinyin: jǐ nián qián gòngxiǎng dānchē zài Zhōngguó de chéngshì xùnsù pǔjí
phrases.translation: A few years ago, shared bicycles spread rapidly across cities in China.

phrases.text: 只要用手机扫一下,就可以骑车去任何地方。
phrases.pinyin: zhǐyào yòng shǒujī sǎo yíxià jiù kěyǐ qíchē qù rènhé dìfang
phrases.translation: With just a swipe of your phone, you can ride one anywhere.

phrases.text: 它解决了所谓"最后一公里"的出行难题。
phrases.pinyin: tā jiějué le suǒwèi zuìhòu yì gōnglǐ de chūxíng nántí
phrases.translation: It solved the so-called "last mile" transportation problem.

phrases.text: 然而,盲目扩张很快带来了严重的管理问题。
phrases.pinyin: rán'ér mángmù kuòzhāng hěn kuài dàilái le yánzhòng de guǎnlǐ wèntí
phrases.translation: But blind expansion soon brought serious management problems.

phrases.text: 街道上的自行车乱停乱放,挡住了行人的路。
phrases.pinyin: jiēdào shàng de zìxíngchē luàn tíng luàn fàng dǎng zhù le xíngrén de lù
phrases.translation: Bicycles were piled randomly on sidewalks, blocking pedestrians.

phrases.text: 不少公司因为扩张太快,最后破产倒闭。
phrases.pinyin: bùshǎo gōngsī yīnwèi kuòzhāng tài kuài zuìhòu pòchǎn dǎobì
phrases.translation: Many companies expanded too fast and eventually went bankrupt.

phrases.text: 如今,这个行业已经成熟,共享单车成了城市基础设施的一部分。
phrases.pinyin: rújīn zhège hángyè yǐjīng chéngshú gòngxiǎng dānchē chéng le chéngshì jīchǔ shèshī de yí bùfen
phrases.translation: Now the industry has matured, and shared bicycles have become part of urban infrastructure.

phrases.text: 这是一个非常中国式的故事:先爆发式增长,再小心治理。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì yí ge fēicháng Zhōngguó shì de gùshi xiān bàofāshì zēngzhǎng zài xiǎoxīn zhìlǐ
phrases.translation: It's a very Chinese story — explosive growth followed by careful regulation.

phrases.text: 最疯狂的时候,有几十家公司同时投放单车。
phrases.pinyin: zuì fēngkuáng de shíhou yǒu jǐshí jiā gōngsī tóngshí tóufàng dānchē
phrases.translation: At the maddest point, dozens of companies were putting out bicycles at once.

phrases.text: 每家都用不同的颜色,街上像开了一场比赛。
phrases.pinyin: měi jiā dōu yòng bùtóng de yánsè jiē shàng xiàng kāi le yì chǎng bǐsài
phrases.translation: Each used a different color, and the streets looked like a race had opened.

phrases.text: 黄色、橙色、蓝色、绿色,人们叫它们"彩虹大战"。
phrases.pinyin: huángsè chéngsè lánsè lǜsè rénmen jiào tāmen cǎihóng dàzhàn
phrases.translation: Yellow, orange, blue, green — people called it the "rainbow war".

phrases.text: 公司为了抢用户,甚至推出一元骑一个月的活动。
phrases.pinyin: gōngsī wèile qiǎng yònghù shènzhì tuīchū yì yuán qí yí ge yuè de huódòng
phrases.translation: To grab users, companies even ran promotions of one yuan for a whole month.

phrases.text: 结果是钱烧完了,车却还堆在路边。
phrases.pinyin: jiéguǒ shì qián shāo wán le chē què hái duī zài lù biān
phrases.translation: The result was that the money burned away while the bikes still piled up on the roadside.

phrases.text: 有些城市出现了巨大的"单车坟场"。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu xiē chéngshì chūxiàn le jùdà de dānchē fénchǎng
phrases.translation: Some cities grew enormous "bicycle graveyards".

phrases.text: 成千上万辆车锈在空地上,从高处看非常震撼。
phrases.pinyin: chéng qiān shàng wàn liàng chē xiù zài kòngdì shàng cóng gāochù kàn fēicháng zhènhàn
phrases.translation: Tens of thousands of bikes rusted on open ground, staggering to see from above.

phrases.text: 后来政府开始限制投放的数量。
phrases.pinyin: hòulái zhèngfǔ kāishǐ xiànzhì tóufàng de shùliàng
phrases.translation: Later the government began limiting how many could be put out.

phrases.text: 也要求企业把用户的押金存进专门的账户。
phrases.pinyin: yě yāoqiú qǐyè bǎ yònghù de yājīn cún jìn zhuānmén de zhànghù
phrases.translation: It also required firms to hold user deposits in dedicated accounts.

phrases.text: 现在剩下的几家公司规模小了,却活得更稳。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài shèng xià de jǐ jiā gōngsī guīmó xiǎo le què huó de gèng wěn
phrases.translation: The few firms left today are smaller in scale but live far more steadily.

phrases.text: 疫情之后,许多公司开始允许员工在家办公。
phrases.pinyin: yìqíng zhīhòu xǔduō gōngsī kāishǐ yǔnxǔ yuángōng zàijiā bàngōng
phrases.translation: After the pandemic, many companies started letting employees work from home.

phrases.text: 以前我以为在家办公是最舒适的安排。
phrases.pinyin: yǐqián wǒ yǐwéi zàijiā bàngōng shì zuì shūshì de ānpái
phrases.translation: I used to think working from home would be the most comfortable arrangement.

phrases.text: 可是过了一段时间,我发现工作和生活的界限反而更模糊。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì guò le yí duàn shíjiān wǒ fāxiàn gōngzuò hé shēnghuó de jièxiàn fǎn'ér gèng móhu
phrases.translation: But after a while, I realized the boundary between work and life is more blurred.

phrases.text: 没有通勤,也意味着你可能二十四小时都在"上班"。
phrases.pinyin: méiyǒu tōngqín yě yìwèizhe nǐ kěnéng èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu zài shàngbān
phrases.translation: Without a commute, you can also feel like you're "on duty" 24 hours a day.

phrases.text: 和同事之间少了闲聊,创意上的协作也变得困难。
phrases.pinyin: hé tóngshì zhījiān shǎo le xiánliáo chuàngyì shàng de xiézuò yě biànde kùnnán
phrases.translation: There's no chitchat with colleagues, and creative collaboration becomes harder.

phrases.text: 我渐渐明白,在家工作的效率取决于自律。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiànjiàn míngbai zàijiā gōngzuò de xiàolǜ qǔjuéyú zìlǜ
phrases.translation: I gradually understood: efficiency at home depends on self-discipline.

phrases.text: 现在我每天设固定的工作时间,下班后绝不打开电脑。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ měi tiān shè gùdìng de gōngzuò shíjiān xiàbān hòu jué bù dǎkāi diànnǎo
phrases.translation: Now I set fixed working hours every day and don't open my laptop after work.

phrases.text: 自由,自有它的代价。
phrases.pinyin: zìyóu zì yǒu tā de dàijià
phrases.translation: Freedom comes with its own cost.

phrases.text: 刚开始在家办公的那几个星期,我很享受。
phrases.pinyin: gāng kāishǐ zài jiā bàngōng de nà jǐ ge xīngqī wǒ hěn xiǎngshòu
phrases.translation: In the first few weeks of working from home, I enjoyed it thoroughly.

phrases.text: 不用挤地铁,省下了每天两个小时。
phrases.pinyin: búyòng jǐ dìtiě shěng xià le měitiān liǎng ge xiǎoshí
phrases.translation: No packed subway, which saved me two hours every day.

phrases.text: 我可以睡到八点半,穿着睡衣就开始工作。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ shuì dào bā diǎn bàn chuān zhe shuìyī jiù kāishǐ gōngzuò
phrases.translation: I could sleep until half past eight and start work in my pyjamas.

phrases.text: 可是慢慢地,问题出现了。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì mànmàn de wèntí chūxiàn le
phrases.translation: But gradually the problems appeared.

phrases.text: 我的电脑就放在床边,晚上十一点还在回邮件。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ de diànnǎo jiù fàng zài chuáng biān wǎnshang shíyī diǎn hái zài huí yóujiàn
phrases.translation: My computer sat right beside the bed, and at eleven at night I was still answering mail.

phrases.text: 周末和工作日看起来几乎一样。
phrases.pinyin: zhōumò hé gōngzuò rì kàn qǐlái jīhū yíyàng
phrases.translation: Weekends and weekdays came to look almost the same.

phrases.text: 家里也有很多干扰,快递、家人、还有洗不完的碗。
phrases.pinyin: jiā lǐ yě yǒu hěn duō gānrǎo kuàidì jiārén hái yǒu xǐ bù wán de wǎn
phrases.translation: Home has plenty of distractions too: parcels, family, and dishes without end.

phrases.text: 后来我在房间里划出一个角落,只用来工作。
phrases.pinyin: hòulái wǒ zài fángjiān lǐ huà chū yí ge jiǎoluò zhǐ yòng lái gōngzuò
phrases.translation: Later I marked off one corner of the room, used only for work.

phrases.text: 离开那个角落,我就告诉自己今天结束了。
phrases.pinyin: líkāi nà ge jiǎoluò wǒ jiù gàosu zìjǐ jīntiān jiéshù le
phrases.translation: Leaving that corner, I tell myself the day is over.

phrases.text: 这个简单的办法,比任何软件都有效。
phrases.pinyin: zhè ge jiǎndān de bànfǎ bǐ rènhé ruǎnjiàn dōu yǒuxiào
phrases.translation: This simple method works better than any piece of software.

phrases.text: 上海弄堂的早晨开始得很早。
phrases.pinyin: Shànghǎi lòngtáng de zǎochén kāishǐ de hěn zǎo
phrases.translation: The morning of a Shanghai lane begins very early.

phrases.text: 天刚亮,街角的早餐铺已经冒着热气。
phrases.pinyin: tiān gāng liàng jiējiǎo de zǎocān pù yǐjīng mào zhe rèqì
phrases.translation: When the sky barely turns light, the breakfast stall on the corner is already steaming.

phrases.text: 阿姨们为一条鲜鱼讨价还价,挑、问、嫌弃。
phrases.pinyin: āyímen wèi yì tiáo xiānyú tǎojiàhuánjià tiāo wèn xiánqì
phrases.translation: The aunties bargain over fresh fish, picking, asking, mocking.

phrases.text: 老人家提着鸟笼出来,和朋友凑在一起喝茶聊天。
phrases.pinyin: lǎo rénjiā tí zhe niǎolóng chūlái hé péngyou còu zài yìqǐ hēchá liáotiān
phrases.translation: Old men carry cages out, gathering with friends to chat over tea.

phrases.text: 背着书包的小孩睡眼惺忪,被家长拉着往学校走。
phrases.pinyin: bēi zhe shūbāo de xiǎohái shuìyǎn xīngsōng bèi jiāzhǎng lā zhe wǎng xuéxiào zǒu
phrases.translation: Children with backpacks, half asleep, are dragged toward school.

phrases.text: 一墙之外,是城市的高楼大厦,还没有完全苏醒。
phrases.pinyin: yì qiáng zhī wài shì chéngshì de gāolóu dàshà hái méiyǒu wánquán sūxǐng
phrases.translation: Across the wall, the city's skyscrapers haven't quite woken up yet.

phrases.text: 弄堂里,藏着上海另一张更缓慢的面孔。
phrases.pinyin: lòngtáng lǐ cáng zhe Shànghǎi lìng yī zhāng gèng huǎnmàn de miànkǒng
phrases.translation: Within the lanes, the city's another, slower face is hidden.

phrases.text: 弄堂很窄,两个人并排走就有点挤。
phrases.pinyin: lòngtáng hěn zhǎi liǎng ge rén bìngpái zǒu jiù yǒudiǎn jǐ
phrases.translation: The lane is narrow — two people walking abreast is already a squeeze.

phrases.text: 墙上爬着电线,窗外挂着一排排衣服。
phrases.pinyin: qiáng shàng pá zhe diànxiàn chuāng wài guà zhe yì pái pái yīfu
phrases.translation: Wires climb the walls, and rows of clothes hang outside the windows.

phrases.text: 有人把竹竿架在两边的窗户之间晾被子。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu rén bǎ zhúgān jià zài liǎng biān de chuānghu zhījiān liàng bèizi
phrases.translation: Someone props a bamboo pole between the windows on either side to air the quilts.

phrases.text: 早晨的太阳照在被子上,有一种干净的味道。
phrases.pinyin: zǎochen de tàiyáng zhào zài bèizi shàng yǒu yì zhǒng gānjìng de wèidào
phrases.translation: The morning sun falls on the quilts, giving off a clean smell.

phrases.text: 修鞋的老师傅在门口摆开工具。
phrases.pinyin: xiū xié de lǎo shīfu zài ménkǒu bǎi kāi gōngjù
phrases.translation: The old shoe-mender lays out his tools in the doorway.

phrases.text: 卖豆浆的推着车,一边走一边喊。
phrases.pinyin: mài dòujiāng de tuī zhe chē yìbiān zǒu yìbiān hǎn
phrases.translation: The soy-milk seller pushes his cart along, calling out as he goes.

phrases.text: 这些声音混在一起,就是弄堂的闹钟。
phrases.pinyin: zhèxiē shēngyīn hùn zài yìqǐ jiùshì lòngtáng de nàozhōng
phrases.translation: These sounds mixed together are the lane's alarm clock.

phrases.text: 住在这里的人,大多认识彼此几十年了。
phrases.pinyin: zhù zài zhèlǐ de rén dàduō rènshi bǐcǐ jǐshí nián le
phrases.translation: Most of the people living here have known one another for decades.

phrases.text: 谁家孩子考上大学,整条弄堂都知道。
phrases.pinyin: shéi jiā háizi kǎo shàng dàxué zhěng tiáo lòngtáng dōu zhīdào
phrases.translation: When someone's child gets into university, the whole lane knows.

phrases.text: 这几年,很多弄堂被拆掉,盖起了新楼。
phrases.pinyin: zhè jǐ nián hěn duō lòngtáng bèi chāi diào gài qǐ le xīn lóu
phrases.translation: In recent years many lanes have been torn down and new blocks raised.

phrases.text: 留下来的那些,成了游客拍照的地方。
phrases.pinyin: liú xiàlái de nàxiē chéng le yóukè pāizhào de dìfang
phrases.translation: The ones that remain have become places for tourists to take photographs.

phrases.text: 在社交媒体上,我有几百个"朋友"。
phrases.pinyin: zài shèjiāo méitǐ shàng wǒ yǒu jǐ bǎi ge péngyou
phrases.translation: On social media, I have hundreds of "friends".

phrases.text: 但真正能在半夜打电话的,最多三个。
phrases.pinyin: dàn zhēnzhèng néng zài bànyè dǎ diànhuà de zuì duō sān ge
phrases.translation: But really being able to call someone in the middle of the night — there are at most three.

phrases.text: 我们习惯了互相点赞,却很少真正倾听。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen xíguàn le hùxiāng diǎn zàn què hěn shǎo zhēnzhèng qīngtīng
phrases.translation: We're used to giving each other a thumbs-up, but rarely truly listen.

phrases.text: 看到朋友在网上晒婚礼照片,我有时感到一种奇怪的距离。
phrases.pinyin: kàndào péngyou zài wǎngshàng shài hūnlǐ zhàopiàn wǒ yǒu shí gǎndào yì zhǒng qíguài de jùlí
phrases.translation: When I see a friend's wedding photo posted online, I sometimes feel a strange distance.

phrases.text: 不是因为不亲近,而是数字关系取代了面对面的联系。
phrases.pinyin: bú shì yīnwèi bù qīnjìn ér shì shùzì guānxi qǔdài le miànduìmiàn de liánxì
phrases.translation: It's not because we're not close — but because the digital relationship has replaced face-to-face connection.

phrases.text: 上周我特意约了几个老朋友出来吃饭。
phrases.pinyin: shàng zhōu wǒ tèyì yuē le jǐ ge lǎo péngyou chūlái chīfàn
phrases.translation: Last week I made an effort to invite a few old friends out to dinner.

phrases.text: 坐下来才发现,距离上次见面已经三年。
phrases.pinyin: zuò xiàlái cái fāxiàn jùlí shàng cì jiànmiàn yǐjīng sān nián
phrases.translation: Sitting down together, we suddenly realized — it had been three years since we last met.

phrases.text: 真正的友谊仍然需要时间和空间,而不只是一块屏幕。
phrases.pinyin: zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì réngrán xūyào shíjiān hé kōngjiān ér bù zhǐshì yī kuài píngmù
phrases.translation: True friendship still needs time and space — not just a screen.

phrases.text: 那天晚上我们聊了四个小时。
phrases.pinyin: nà tiān wǎnshang wǒmen liáo le sì ge xiǎoshí
phrases.translation: That evening we talked for four hours.

phrases.text: 说的都是些小事,工作、房子、父母的身体。
phrases.pinyin: shuō de dōu shì xiē xiǎoshì gōngzuò fángzi fùmǔ de shēntǐ
phrases.translation: It was all small things — work, apartments, our parents' health.

phrases.text: 可是那种感觉,是点赞给不了的。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì nà zhǒng gǎnjué shì diǎn zàn gěi bù liǎo de
phrases.translation: But that feeling is something a "like" cannot give you.

phrases.text: 我发现我其实并不了解他们最近的生活。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ fāxiàn wǒ qíshí bìng bù liǎojiě tāmen zuìjìn de shēnghuó
phrases.translation: I realised I did not actually know much about their recent lives.

phrases.text: 一个人换了工作,另一个刚离婚。
phrases.pinyin: yí ge rén huàn le gōngzuò lìng yí ge gāng líhūn
phrases.translation: One had changed jobs; another had just divorced.

phrases.text: 这些事情,他们都没有发在朋友圈里。
phrases.pinyin: zhèxiē shìqing tāmen dōu méiyǒu fā zài péngyou quān lǐ
phrases.translation: Neither of them had posted any of it on social media.

phrases.text: 真正重要的事,人们反而不会写在网上。
phrases.pinyin: zhēnzhèng zhòngyào de shì rénmen fǎn'ér bú huì xiě zài wǎng shàng
phrases.translation: The things that truly matter are exactly what people do not write online.

phrases.text: 网络让我们看见彼此的生活,却看不见彼此的心情。
phrases.pinyin: wǎngluò ràng wǒmen kànjiàn bǐcǐ de shēnghuó què kàn bú jiàn bǐcǐ de xīnqíng
phrases.translation: The network lets us see each other's lives but not each other's hearts.

phrases.text: 从那以后,我每个月都约一次老朋友。
phrases.pinyin: cóng nà yǐhòu wǒ měi ge yuè dōu yuē yí cì lǎo péngyou
phrases.translation: Ever since, I have arranged to see old friends once a month.

phrases.text: 见面很麻烦,但正是这份麻烦让关系变得真实。
phrases.pinyin: jiànmiàn hěn máfan dàn zhèng shì zhè fèn máfan ràng guānxi biàn de zhēnshí
phrases.translation: Meeting is a nuisance, but it is precisely that nuisance that makes it real.

phrases.text: 端午节在农历五月初五。
phrases.pinyin: Duānwǔjié zài nónglì wǔyuè chūwǔ
phrases.translation: The Dragon Boat Festival falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.

phrases.text: 传说这个节日是为了纪念古代爱国诗人屈原。
phrases.pinyin: chuánshuō zhège jiérì shì wèile jìniàn gǔdài àiguó shīrén Qū Yuán
phrases.translation: It is said this holiday is to commemorate Qu Yuan, an ancient patriotic poet.

phrases.text: 屈原在国家灭亡时,悲愤地投入汨罗江。
phrases.pinyin: Qū Yuán zài guójiā mièwáng shí bēifèn de tóurù Mìluó Jiāng
phrases.translation: When his country fell, Qu Yuan jumped into the Miluo River out of grief.

phrases.text: 当地百姓听说后,划着船去寻找他。
phrases.pinyin: dāngdì bǎixìng tīngshuō hòu huá zhe chuán qù xúnzhǎo tā
phrases.translation: When the local people heard, they paddled boats to look for him.

phrases.text: 为了不让鱼伤害他的身体,人们把米投入江中。
phrases.pinyin: wèile bù ràng yú shānghài tā de shēntǐ rénmen bǎ mǐ tóu rù jiāng zhōng
phrases.translation: To prevent fish from harming his body, they threw rice into the river.

phrases.text: 这两件事后来演变成赛龙舟和吃粽子的风俗。
phrases.pinyin: zhè liǎng jiàn shì hòulái yǎnbiàn chéng sài lóngzhōu hé chī zòngzi de fēngsú
phrases.translation: These two acts later evolved into dragon boat racing and eating zongzi.

phrases.text: 今天,端午节早已不仅是纪念,更成了文化认同的象征。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān Duānwǔjié zǎo yǐ bùjǐn shì jìniàn gèng chéng le wénhuà rèntóng de xiàngzhēng
phrases.translation: Today, the Dragon Boat Festival is no longer just memorial — it has become a symbol of cultural identity.

phrases.text: 屈原是战国时期楚国的大臣。
phrases.pinyin: Qū Yuán shì Zhànguó shíqī Chǔ guó de dàchén
phrases.translation: Qu Yuan was a minister of the state of Chu in the Warring States period.

phrases.text: 他主张联合抗秦,却被小人陷害,遭到流放。
phrases.pinyin: tā zhǔzhāng liánhé kàng Qín què bèi xiǎorén xiànhài zāodào liúfàng
phrases.translation: He argued for an alliance against Qin, but was framed by petty men and exiled.

phrases.text: 流放期间,他写下了《离骚》等不朽的诗篇。
phrases.pinyin: liúfàng qījiān tā xiě xià le Lí Sāo děng bùxiǔ de shīpiān
phrases.translation: During his exile he wrote Li Sao and other imperishable poems.

phrases.text: 那些诗至今仍是中国文学的高峰。
phrases.pinyin: nàxiē shī zhìjīn réng shì Zhōngguó wénxué de gāofēng
phrases.translation: Those poems remain a summit of Chinese literature to this day.

phrases.text: 秦军攻破楚国都城那年,他终于绝望了。
phrases.pinyin: Qín jūn gōngpò Chǔ guó dūchéng nà nián tā zhōngyú juéwàng le
phrases.translation: The year the Qin army broke the Chu capital, he despaired at last.

phrases.text: 五月初五那天,他抱着石头走进了江水。
phrases.pinyin: wǔ yuè chū wǔ nà tiān tā bào zhe shítou zǒu jìn le jiāngshuǐ
phrases.translation: On the fifth day of the fifth month, he walked into the river holding a stone.

phrases.text: 今天的赛龙舟已经成了一项国际比赛。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān de sài lóngzhōu yǐjīng chéng le yí xiàng guójì bǐsài
phrases.translation: Dragon boat racing today has become an international sport.

phrases.text: 鼓声一响,几十个人的桨同时落水。
phrases.pinyin: gǔ shēng yì xiǎng jǐshí ge rén de jiǎng tóngshí luò shuǐ
phrases.translation: The drum sounds, and dozens of oars strike the water at once.

phrases.text: 粽子的口味南北不同,北方多甜,南方多咸。
phrases.pinyin: zòngzi de kǒuwèi nán běi bùtóng běifāng duō tián nánfāng duō xián
phrases.translation: Zongzi taste different north and south — the north mostly sweet, the south mostly salty.

phrases.text: 为了甜粽还是咸粽,人们每年都要争论一次。
phrases.pinyin: wèile tián zòng háishi xián zòng rénmen měi nián dōu yào zhēnglùn yí cì
phrases.translation: Sweet zongzi or salty — people have the same argument once a year.

phrases.text: 一个两千多年前的故事,就这样活到了今天。
phrases.pinyin: yí ge liǎng qiān duō nián qián de gùshi jiù zhèyàng huó dào le jīntiān
phrases.translation: A story from over two thousand years ago has lived on to today just like that.

phrases.text: 丝绸之路是古代连接中国和西方的贸易通道。
phrases.pinyin: Sīchóu zhī Lù shì gǔdài liánjiē Zhōngguó hé xīfāng de màoyì tōngdào
phrases.translation: The Silk Road was an ancient network of trade routes connecting China and the West.

phrases.text: 它始于西汉时期,由外交官张骞开辟。
phrases.pinyin: tā shǐ yú Xī Hàn shíqī yóu wàijiāoguān Zhāng Qiān kāipì
phrases.translation: It originated in the Western Han dynasty, opened up by the diplomat Zhang Qian.

phrases.text: 商队把丝绸、瓷器和茶叶从长安运往西方。
phrases.pinyin: shāngduì bǎ sīchóu cíqì hé cháyè cóng Cháng'ān yùn wǎng xīfāng
phrases.translation: Caravans transported silk, porcelain, and tea from Chang'an westward.

phrases.text: 返程时,他们带回了葡萄、核桃、玻璃器和音乐。
phrases.pinyin: fǎnchéng shí tāmen dài huí le pútáo hétáo bōli qì hé yīnyuè
phrases.translation: On the return trip they brought back grapes, walnuts, glassware, and music.

phrases.text: 丝路的交流不仅是商业上的,也是宗教和艺术上的。
phrases.pinyin: Sī Lù de jiāoliú bùjǐn shì shāngyè shàng de yě shì zōngjiào hé yìshù shàng de
phrases.translation: Silk Road exchange was not only commercial — it was also religious and artistic.

phrases.text: 佛教就是沿着这条路传入中原的。
phrases.pinyin: Fójiào jiùshì yán zhe zhè tiáo lù chuán rù Zhōngyuán de
phrases.translation: Buddhism entered the Central Plains along this road.

phrases.text: 沙漠之行极其危险,风沙、强盗和疾病夺去了无数生命。
phrases.pinyin: shāmò zhī xíng jíqí wēixiǎn fēngshā qiángdào hé jíbìng duó qù le wúshù shēngmìng
phrases.translation: The desert journey was extremely dangerous — sandstorms, bandits, and disease all took countless lives.

phrases.text: 但正是这种艰难的交流,塑造了欧亚大陆丰富的文化多样性。
phrases.pinyin: dàn zhèng shì zhè zhǒng jiānnán de jiāoliú sùzào le Ōuyà dàlù fēngfù de wénhuà duōyàngxìng
phrases.translation: Yet it was precisely this difficult exchange that built the rich cultural diversity of Eurasia.

phrases.text: 张骞第一次出使时被匈奴抓住,扣留了十多年。
phrases.pinyin: Zhāng Qiān dì yī cì chūshǐ shí bèi Xiōngnú zhuā zhù kòuliú le shí duō nián
phrases.translation: On his first mission Zhang Qian was seized by the Xiongnu and held for over ten years.

phrases.text: 他没有放弃使命,后来找到机会逃走,继续西行。
phrases.pinyin: tā méiyǒu fàngqì shǐmìng hòulái zhǎo dào jīhuì táo zǒu jìxù xī xíng
phrases.translation: He did not abandon the mission; he later found a chance to escape and pressed west.

phrases.text: 回到长安时,一百多人的队伍只剩下两个人。
phrases.pinyin: huí dào Cháng'ān shí yì bǎi duō rén de duìwu zhǐ shèng xià liǎng ge rén
phrases.translation: When he returned to Chang'an, only two of a party of over a hundred were left.

phrases.text: 丝绸在罗马非常昂贵,据说和黄金同价。
phrases.pinyin: sīchóu zài Luómǎ fēicháng ángguì jùshuō hé huángjīn tóng jià
phrases.translation: Silk was extremely costly in Rome — said to be worth its weight in gold.

phrases.text: 罗马人很久都不知道丝是怎么做出来的。
phrases.pinyin: Luómǎ rén hěn jiǔ dōu bù zhīdào sī shì zěnme zuò chūlái de
phrases.translation: For a long time the Romans did not know how silk was made.

phrases.text: 他们以为丝长在树上。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen yǐwéi sī zhǎng zài shù shàng
phrases.translation: They believed silk grew on trees.

phrases.text: 沿途兴起了许多城市,比如敦煌、撒马尔罕。
phrases.pinyin: yántú xīngqǐ le xǔduō chéngshì bǐrú Dūnhuáng Sāmǎ'ěrhǎn
phrases.translation: Many cities rose along the route, such as Dunhuang and Samarkand.

phrases.text: 敦煌的莫高窟里,保存着上千年的壁画。
phrases.pinyin: Dūnhuáng de Mògāo Kū lǐ bǎocún zhe shàng qiān nián de bìhuà
phrases.translation: In the Mogao Caves at Dunhuang, murals a thousand years old are preserved.

phrases.text: 那些壁画上,能看到不同民族的面孔和服装。
phrases.pinyin: nàxiē bìhuà shàng néng kàndào bùtóng mínzú de miànkǒng hé fúzhuāng
phrases.translation: On those murals you can see the faces and dress of many different peoples.

phrases.text: 今天的"一带一路",名字就来自这条古道。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān de Yí Dài Yí Lù míngzi jiù láizì zhè tiáo gǔdào
phrases.translation: Today's "Belt and Road" takes its very name from this ancient route.

phrases.text: 科举是中国古代选拔官员的制度。
phrases.pinyin: kējǔ shì Zhōngguó gǔdài xuǎnbá guānyuán de zhìdù
phrases.translation: The keju was an ancient Chinese system for selecting officials.

phrases.text: 它始于隋朝,前后延续了一千三百多年。
phrases.pinyin: tā shǐ yú Suí cháo qiánhòu yánxù le yìqiān sānbǎi duō nián
phrases.translation: It began in the Sui dynasty and continued for over 1300 years.

phrases.text: 通过层层考试,考生要在经书、诗文和行政判断上接受考验。
phrases.pinyin: tōngguò céngcéng kǎoshì kǎoshēng yào zài jīngshū shī wén hé xíngzhèng pànduàn shàng jiēshòu kǎoyàn
phrases.translation: Through several rounds, candidates were tested on classics, poetry, and administrative judgment.

phrases.text: 理论上,即使一个贫寒的读书人,也能通过读书改变命运。
phrases.pinyin: lǐlùn shàng jíshǐ yí ge pín hán de dúshū rén yě néng tōngguò dúshū gǎibiàn mìngyùn
phrases.translation: In theory, even a poor scholar could change his fate through study.

phrases.text: 但现实中,备考的成本非常高昂。
phrases.pinyin: dàn xiànshí zhōng bèikǎo de chéngběn fēicháng gāo'áng
phrases.translation: But in practice, the cost of preparing for the exam was enormous.

phrases.text: 许多人一辈子研读经书,始终没能考上。
phrases.pinyin: xǔduō rén yíbèizi yándú jīngshū shǐzhōng méi néng kǎo shàng
phrases.translation: Many people studied the classics for an entire lifetime without ever passing.

phrases.text: 科举塑造了中国人"学而优则仕"的想象。
phrases.pinyin: kējǔ sùzào le Zhōngguó rén xué ér yōu zé shì de xiǎngxiàng
phrases.translation: The keju shaped the Chinese imagination of "learning leads to officialdom."

phrases.text: 即便是今天,现代高考仍被视为它的延续。
phrases.pinyin: jíbiàn shì jīntiān xiàndài gāokǎo réng bèi shì wéi tā de yánxù
phrases.translation: Even today, the modern college entrance exam is still seen as its echo.

phrases.text: 考试分好几级,从县里一直考到京城。
phrases.pinyin: kǎoshì fēn hǎo jǐ jí cóng xiàn lǐ yìzhí kǎo dào jīngchéng
phrases.translation: The examinations came in several grades, from the county all the way to the capital.

phrases.text: 最低一级叫童试,考中的人称为秀才。
phrases.pinyin: zuì dī yì jí jiào tóngshì kǎo zhòng de rén chēngwéi xiùcai
phrases.translation: The lowest grade was the child examination, and those who passed were called xiucai.

phrases.text: 再往上是乡试、会试,最后是皇帝亲自主持的殿试。
phrases.pinyin: zài wǎng shàng shì xiāngshì huìshì zuìhòu shì huángdì qīnzì zhǔchí de diànshì
phrases.translation: Above that came the provincial and metropolitan exams, then the palace exam the emperor presided over himself.

phrases.text: 殿试的第一名叫状元,是天下读书人的梦想。
phrases.pinyin: diànshì de dì yī míng jiào zhuàngyuán shì tiānxià dúshū rén de mèngxiǎng
phrases.translation: First place in the palace exam was the zhuangyuan, the dream of every scholar under heaven.

phrases.text: 考场是一间间小屋子,只有一张桌子那么大。
phrases.pinyin: kǎochǎng shì yì jiān jiān xiǎo wūzi zhǐ yǒu yì zhāng zhuōzi nàme dà
phrases.translation: The examination hall was a row of tiny cells, each about the size of one desk.

phrases.text: 考生要在里面待上几天几夜,吃住都在其中。
phrases.pinyin: kǎoshēng yào zài lǐmiàn dāi shàng jǐ tiān jǐ yè chī zhù dōu zài qízhōng
phrases.translation: Candidates stayed inside for several days and nights, eating and sleeping there.

phrases.text: 为了防止作弊,考生进场前要被搜身。
phrases.pinyin: wèile fángzhǐ zuòbì kǎoshēng jìn chǎng qián yào bèi sōushēn
phrases.translation: To prevent cheating, candidates were searched before entering.

phrases.text: 有人把小抄写在衣服的夹层里,甚至写在毛笔杆上。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu rén bǎ xiǎochāo xiě zài yīfu de jiācéng lǐ shènzhì xiě zài máobǐ gǎn shàng
phrases.translation: Some wrote crib notes into the lining of their clothes, even onto the shaft of a brush.

phrases.text: 也有人考了一辈子,头发白了还在考。
phrases.pinyin: yě yǒu rén kǎo le yíbèizi tóufa bái le hái zài kǎo
phrases.translation: Others sat the exam their whole lives, still sitting it when their hair had turned white.

phrases.text: 《儒林外史》里的范进,中举时高兴得发了疯。
phrases.pinyin: Rúlín Wàishǐ lǐ de Fàn Jìn zhòng jǔ shí gāoxìng de fā le fēng
phrases.translation: Fan Jin, in The Scholars, went mad with joy when he finally passed.

phrases.text: 造纸术、印刷术、火药和指南针,被称为中国"四大发明"。
phrases.pinyin: zàozhǐ shù yìnshuā shù huǒyào hé zhǐnánzhēn bèi chēng wéi Zhōngguó sì dà fāmíng
phrases.translation: Papermaking, printing, gunpowder, and the compass are called China's "Four Great Inventions."

phrases.text: 这些发明不仅深刻地改变了中国,也改变了世界。
phrases.pinyin: zhèxiē fāmíng bùjǐn shēn kè de gǎibiàn le Zhōngguó yě gǎibiàn le shìjiè
phrases.translation: These inventions deeply changed not only China but also the world.

phrases.text: 东汉的蔡伦改进了造纸术,使书写变得廉价普及。
phrases.pinyin: Dōng Hàn de Cài Lún gǎijìn le zàozhǐ shù shǐ shūxiě biànde liánjià pǔjí
phrases.translation: Cai Lun improved papermaking in the Eastern Han, making writing cheap and widespread.

phrases.text: 毕昇的活字印刷则进一步加速了知识的传播。
phrases.pinyin: Bì Shēng de huózì yìnshuā zé jìn yí bù jiāsù le zhīshi de chuánbō
phrases.translation: Bi Sheng's movable-type printing further accelerated the spread of knowledge.

phrases.text: 火药最初是炼丹术的副产品,后来彻底改变了战争的形态。
phrases.pinyin: huǒyào zuìchū shì liàndān shù de fù chǎnpǐn hòulái chèdǐ gǎibiàn le zhànzhēng de xíngtài
phrases.translation: Gunpowder, originally a byproduct of alchemy, eventually transformed warfare.

phrases.text: 指南针让远洋航海成为可能。
phrases.pinyin: zhǐnánzhēn ràng yuǎn yáng hánghǎi chéng wéi kěnéng
phrases.translation: The compass made long-distance ocean navigation possible.

phrases.text: 如果没有这些发明,世界史将完全不同。
phrases.pinyin: rúguǒ méiyǒu zhèxiē fāmíng shìjiè shǐ jiāng wánquán bùtóng
phrases.translation: Without these inventions, world history would be completely different.

phrases.text: 在纸出现以前,中国人在竹简上写字。
phrases.pinyin: zài zhǐ chūxiàn yǐqián Zhōngguó rén zài zhújiǎn shàng xiě zì
phrases.translation: Before paper appeared, Chinese people wrote on bamboo slips.

phrases.text: 一部书可能要用几十斤重的竹片。
phrases.pinyin: yí bù shū kěnéng yào yòng jǐshí jīn zhòng de zhúpiàn
phrases.translation: A single book might take tens of catties' weight of bamboo strips.

phrases.text: 据说秦始皇每天要看一百二十斤的奏章。
phrases.pinyin: jùshuō Qín Shǐhuáng měitiān yào kàn yì bǎi èrshí jīn de zòuzhāng
phrases.translation: The First Emperor is said to have read a hundred and twenty catties of memorials daily.

phrases.text: 蔡伦用树皮、麻布和渔网造出了便宜的纸。
phrases.pinyin: Cài Lún yòng shùpí mábù hé yúwǎng zào chū le piányi de zhǐ
phrases.translation: Cai Lun made cheap paper out of bark, hemp cloth and fishing nets.

phrases.text: 从此知识不再只属于贵族。
phrases.pinyin: cóngcǐ zhīshi bú zài zhǐ shǔyú guìzú
phrases.translation: From then on, knowledge no longer belonged to the aristocracy alone.

phrases.text: 毕昇的活字是用胶泥做的,一个字一个印。
phrases.pinyin: Bì Shēng de huózì shì yòng jiāoní zuò de yí ge zì yí ge yìn
phrases.translation: Bi Sheng's movable type was made of clay, one character to a piece.

phrases.text: 排好版印完以后,字还可以拆下来再用。
phrases.pinyin: pái hǎo bǎn yìn wán yǐhòu zì hái kěyǐ chāi xiàlái zài yòng
phrases.translation: Once the page was set and printed, the characters could be taken apart and used again.

phrases.text: 火药本来是道士炼长生不老药时发现的。
phrases.pinyin: huǒyào běnlái shì dàoshi liàn chángshēng bù lǎo yào shí fāxiàn de
phrases.translation: Gunpowder was originally found by Daoists brewing an elixir of immortality.

phrases.text: 他们想求长生,却造出了最致命的东西。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen xiǎng qiú chángshēng què zào chū le zuì zhìmìng de dōngxi
phrases.translation: They sought long life and produced the deadliest thing of all.

phrases.text: 指南针最早叫司南,样子像一把勺子。
phrases.pinyin: zhǐnánzhēn zuì zǎo jiào sīnán yàngzi xiàng yì bǎ sháozi
phrases.translation: The earliest compass was called the sinan and looked like a spoon.

phrases.text: 这四样东西传到欧洲后,推动了那里的巨大变革。
phrases.pinyin: zhè sì yàng dōngxi chuán dào Ōuzhōu hòu tuīdòng le nàlǐ de jùdà biàngé
phrases.translation: After these four things reached Europe, they drove enormous change there.

phrases.text: 每年六月初,中国有上千万的学生走进同一个考场。
phrases.pinyin: měi nián liù yuè chū Zhōngguó yǒu shàng qiān wàn de xuéshēng zǒu jìn tóng yí ge kǎochǎng
phrases.translation: In early June each year, tens of millions of Chinese students walk into the same examination hall.

phrases.text: 这场考试叫高考,是决定他们能上哪所大学的关键。
phrases.pinyin: zhè chǎng kǎoshì jiào gāokǎo shì juédìng tāmen néng shàng nǎ suǒ dàxué de guānjiàn
phrases.translation: This exam is called the gaokao, and it decides which university they can attend.

phrases.text: 对很多家庭来说,高考几乎是一年中最重要的日子。
phrases.pinyin: duì hěn duō jiātíng lái shuō gāokǎo jīhū shì yì nián zhōng zuì zhòngyào de rìzi
phrases.translation: For many families, the gaokao is almost the most important day of the year.

phrases.text: 考试前的那个月,整个社会都会为考生让路。
phrases.pinyin: kǎoshì qián de nà ge yuè zhěnggè shèhuì dōu huì wèi kǎoshēng ràng lù
phrases.translation: In the month before the exam, the whole society makes way for the candidates.

phrases.text: 学校附近的工地必须停工,以免影响学生休息。
phrases.pinyin: xuéxiào fùjìn de gōngdì bìxū tíng gōng yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng xuéshēng xiūxi
phrases.translation: Construction sites near schools must halt work so students' rest is not disturbed.

phrases.text: 交通警察会专门为送考的车辆开路。
phrases.pinyin: jiāotōng jǐngchá huì zhuānmén wèi sòng kǎo de chēliàng kāi lù
phrases.translation: Traffic police clear the way specially for vehicles carrying students to the exam.

phrases.text: 有的城市甚至规定,考试期间不许按喇叭。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu de chéngshì shènzhì guīdìng kǎoshì qījiān bùxǔ àn lǎba
phrases.translation: Some cities even rule that horns may not be sounded during the exam period.

phrases.text: 家长站在考场外面,一站就是三个小时。
phrases.pinyin: jiāzhǎng zhàn zài kǎochǎng wàimiàn yí zhàn jiùshì sān ge xiǎoshí
phrases.translation: Parents stand outside the exam hall, and once they start they stand for three hours.

phrases.text: 他们不敢走远,怕孩子出来的时候找不到人。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen bù gǎn zǒu yuǎn pà háizi chūlái de shíhou zhǎo bú dào rén
phrases.translation: They dare not walk far, afraid their child will not find them coming out.

phrases.text: 有人拿着水,有人拿着伞,更多的人只是沉默地等着。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu rén ná zhe shuǐ yǒu rén ná zhe sǎn gèng duō de rén zhǐshì chénmò de děng zhe
phrases.translation: Some hold water, some hold umbrellas, and more of them simply wait in silence.

phrases.text: 支持高考的人认为,它给了普通家庭一条公平的路。
phrases.pinyin: zhīchí gāokǎo de rén rènwéi tā gěi le pǔtōng jiātíng yì tiáo gōngpíng de lù
phrases.translation: Those who support the gaokao believe it gives ordinary families a fair road.

phrases.text: 无论你出生在城市还是农村,分数面前人人平等。
phrases.pinyin: wúlùn nǐ chūshēng zài chéngshì háishi nóngcūn fēnshù miànqián rénrén píngděng
phrases.translation: Whether you are born in the city or the countryside, before a score everyone is equal.

phrases.text: 反对的人则说,一次考试不应该决定一个人的一生。
phrases.pinyin: fǎnduì de rén zé shuō yí cì kǎoshì bù yīnggāi juédìng yí ge rén de yìshēng
phrases.translation: Opponents say that a single exam should not decide a person's whole life.

phrases.text: 他们担心学生只学会了考试,却没学会思考。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen dānxīn xuéshēng zhǐ xuéhuì le kǎoshì què méi xuéhuì sīkǎo
phrases.translation: They worry that students only learn to take exams, without learning to think.

phrases.text: 这两种看法都有道理,争论了几十年也没有结果。
phrases.pinyin: zhè liǎng zhǒng kànfǎ dōu yǒu dàolǐ zhēnglùn le jǐshí nián yě méiyǒu jiéguǒ
phrases.translation: Both views have their reasons, and decades of argument have settled nothing.

phrases.text: 但有一点大家都同意:那个夏天,谁也不会忘记。
phrases.pinyin: dàn yǒu yì diǎn dàjiā dōu tóngyì nà ge xiàtiān shéi yě bú huì wàngjì
phrases.translation: But on one point everyone agrees: nobody ever forgets that summer.

phrases.text: 从上世纪八十年代开始,中国实行了三十多年的独生子女政策。
phrases.pinyin: cóng shàng shìjì bāshí niándài kāishǐ Zhōngguó shíxíng le sānshí duō nián de dúshēng zǐnǚ zhèngcè
phrases.translation: From the 1980s onward, China carried out the one-child policy for more than thirty years.

phrases.text: 因此出现了世界上规模最大的一代独生子女。
phrases.pinyin: yīncǐ chūxiàn le shìjiè shàng guīmó zuì dà de yí dài dúshēng zǐnǚ
phrases.translation: As a result there appeared the largest generation of only children in the world.

phrases.text: 我就是其中之一,家里只有我一个孩子。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiùshì qízhōng zhī yī jiā lǐ zhǐ yǒu wǒ yí ge háizi
phrases.translation: I am one of them; there was only me at home.

phrases.text: 小时候,我几乎得到了父母全部的关注和资源。
phrases.pinyin: xiǎo shíhou wǒ jīhū dédào le fùmǔ quánbù de guānzhù hé zīyuán
phrases.translation: As a child I received almost all of my parents' attention and resources.

phrases.text: 我有自己的房间,自己的书桌,不用跟任何人分。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ yǒu zìjǐ de fángjiān zìjǐ de shūzhuō búyòng gēn rènhé rén fēn
phrases.translation: I had my own room and my own desk, and shared them with nobody.

phrases.text: 外人常说,独生子女被宠坏了,自私又任性。
phrases.pinyin: wàirén cháng shuō dúshēng zǐnǚ bèi chǒng huài le zìsī yòu rènxìng
phrases.translation: Outsiders often said only children were spoiled, selfish and willful.

phrases.text: 可是他们很少看到硬币的另一面。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì tāmen hěn shǎo kàndào yìngbì de lìng yí miàn
phrases.translation: But they rarely saw the other side of the coin.

phrases.text: 没有兄弟姐妹,意味着所有的期望都压在一个人身上。
phrases.pinyin: méiyǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi yìwèi zhe suǒyǒu de qīwàng dōu yā zài yí ge rén shēn shàng
phrases.translation: Having no siblings meant every expectation pressed down on one person.

phrases.text: 考试考砸了,没有人可以分担父母的失望。
phrases.pinyin: kǎoshì kǎo zá le méiyǒu rén kěyǐ fēndān fùmǔ de shīwàng
phrases.translation: If you failed an exam, there was nobody to share your parents' disappointment.

phrases.text: 长大以后,压力变得更加具体。
phrases.pinyin: zhǎng dà yǐhòu yālì biàn de gèngjiā jùtǐ
phrases.translation: Once we grew up, the pressure became more concrete.

phrases.text: 一对夫妻,可能要照顾四位老人,还要养自己的孩子。
phrases.pinyin: yí duì fūqī kěnéng yào zhàogù sì wèi lǎorén hái yào yǎng zìjǐ de háizi
phrases.translation: One couple may have to care for four elderly parents and raise their own child.

phrases.text: 这被称为"四二一"结构,像一座倒过来的金字塔。
phrases.pinyin: zhè bèi chēngwéi sì èr yī jiégòu xiàng yí zuò dào guòlái de jīnzìtǎ
phrases.translation: This is called the "four-two-one" structure, like an upside-down pyramid.

phrases.text: 父母生病的时候,你才真正明白独生的意思。
phrases.pinyin: fùmǔ shēngbìng de shíhou nǐ cái zhēnzhèng míngbai dúshēng de yìsi
phrases.translation: Only when your parents fall ill do you truly understand what being an only child means.

phrases.text: 病房外面的走廊上,只有你一个人在打电话。
phrases.pinyin: bìngfáng wàimiàn de zǒuláng shàng zhǐ yǒu nǐ yí ge rén zài dǎ diànhuà
phrases.translation: In the corridor outside the ward, you are the only one making phone calls.

phrases.text: 现在政策已经放开了,可以生两个甚至三个孩子。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài zhèngcè yǐjīng fàng kāi le kěyǐ shēng liǎng ge shènzhì sān ge háizi
phrases.translation: The policy has now been relaxed, and people may have two or even three children.

phrases.text: 但对我们这一代来说,有些东西已经无法重来。
phrases.pinyin: dàn duì wǒmen zhè yí dài lái shuō yǒu xiē dōngxi yǐjīng wúfǎ chóng lái
phrases.translation: But for our generation, some things can never be lived over again.

phrases.text: 中国有几百种方言,有些方言之间的差别比欧洲的语言还大。
phrases.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǒu jǐ bǎi zhǒng fāngyán yǒu xiē fāngyán zhījiān de chābié bǐ Ōuzhōu de yǔyán hái dà
phrases.translation: China has several hundred dialects, some differing more than European languages do.

phrases.text: 一个说粤语的人和一个说闽南话的人,可能完全听不懂对方。
phrases.pinyin: yí ge shuō Yuèyǔ de rén hé yí ge shuō Mǐnnán huà de rén kěnéng wánquán tīng bù dǒng duìfāng
phrases.translation: A Cantonese speaker and a Hokkien speaker may not understand each other at all.

phrases.text: 为了让全国人能够交流,国家推广了普通话。
phrases.pinyin: wèile ràng quánguó rén nénggòu jiāoliú guójiā tuīguǎng le pǔtōnghuà
phrases.translation: So that the whole country could communicate, the state promoted Mandarin.

phrases.text: 这在教育和经济上确实带来了巨大的好处。
phrases.pinyin: zhè zài jiàoyù hé jīngjì shàng quèshí dàilái le jùdà de hǎochù
phrases.translation: This did bring enormous benefits in education and the economy.

phrases.text: 但是几十年以后,人们开始发现一个问题。
phrases.pinyin: dànshì jǐshí nián yǐhòu rénmen kāishǐ fāxiàn yí ge wèntí
phrases.translation: But decades later, people began to notice a problem.

phrases.text: 越来越多的孩子,已经不会说自己父母的方言了。
phrases.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de háizi yǐjīng bú huì shuō zìjǐ fùmǔ de fāngyán le
phrases.translation: More and more children can no longer speak their own parents' dialect.

phrases.text: 在上海,很多小学生听得懂上海话,却不会说。
phrases.pinyin: zài Shànghǎi hěn duō xiǎoxuéshēng tīng de dǒng Shànghǎi huà què bú huì shuō
phrases.translation: In Shanghai, many primary school pupils understand Shanghainese but cannot speak it.

phrases.text: 在很多城市,方言只剩下老人还在使用。
phrases.pinyin: zài hěn duō chéngshì fāngyán zhǐ shèng xià lǎorén hái zài shǐyòng
phrases.translation: In many cities, the dialect survives only among the elderly.

phrases.text: 语言学家说,一种方言消失,不只是少了一种口音。
phrases.pinyin: yǔyánxuéjiā shuō yì zhǒng fāngyán xiāoshī bù zhǐshì shǎo le yì zhǒng kǒuyīn
phrases.translation: Linguists say that when a dialect vanishes, it is not merely one accent fewer.

phrases.text: 方言里保存着当地的历史、笑话和看世界的方式。
phrases.pinyin: fāngyán lǐ bǎocún zhe dāngdì de lìshǐ xiàohuà hé kàn shìjiè de fāngshì
phrases.translation: A dialect preserves local history, its jokes, and its way of seeing the world.

phrases.text: 有些词在普通话里根本找不到对应的说法。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu xiē cí zài pǔtōnghuà lǐ gēnběn zhǎo bú dào duìyìng de shuōfǎ
phrases.translation: Some words simply have no equivalent in Mandarin at all.

phrases.text: 比如形容一种说不出的闷热,或者一种特别的亲切。
phrases.pinyin: bǐrú xíngróng yì zhǒng shuō bù chū de mēnrè huòzhě yì zhǒng tèbié de qīnqiè
phrases.translation: For instance, a stifling heat you cannot name, or a particular kind of warmth.

phrases.text: 这几年,有人开始录制老人说方言的声音。
phrases.pinyin: zhè jǐ nián yǒu rén kāishǐ lùzhì lǎorén shuō fāngyán de shēngyīn
phrases.translation: In recent years, some people have begun recording old people speaking dialect.

phrases.text: 也有学校尝试开设方言课,教孩子唱当地的童谣。
phrases.pinyin: yě yǒu xuéxiào chángshì kāishè fāngyán kè jiāo háizi chàng dāngdì de tóngyáo
phrases.translation: Some schools have also tried offering dialect classes, teaching local nursery rhymes.

phrases.text: 没有人想回到互相听不懂的时代。
phrases.pinyin: méiyǒu rén xiǎng huí dào hùxiāng tīng bù dǒng de shídài
phrases.translation: Nobody wants to return to an age when people could not understand one another.

phrases.text: 但也许我们可以既说普通话,也记得奶奶的口音。
phrases.pinyin: dàn yěxǔ wǒmen kěyǐ jì shuō pǔtōnghuà yě jìde nǎinai de kǒuyīn
phrases.translation: But perhaps we can speak Mandarin and still remember our grandmother's accent.

phrases.text: 走进一家中药店,你会闻到一种很特别的味道。
phrases.pinyin: zǒu jìn yì jiā zhōngyào diàn nǐ huì wén dào yì zhǒng hěn tèbié de wèidào
phrases.translation: Walk into a Chinese pharmacy and you meet a very particular smell.

phrases.text: 那是几百种草药混在一起的气味,又苦又香。
phrases.pinyin: nà shì jǐ bǎi zhǒng cǎoyào hùn zài yìqǐ de qìwèi yòu kǔ yòu xiāng
phrases.translation: It is hundreds of herbs mixed together, both bitter and fragrant.

phrases.text: 中医有两千多年的历史,是中国文化的重要部分。
phrases.pinyin: zhōngyī yǒu liǎng qiān duō nián de lìshǐ shì Zhōngguó wénhuà de zhòngyào bùfen
phrases.translation: Chinese medicine has over two thousand years of history and is a major part of the culture.

phrases.text: 中医看病的方法和西医很不一样。
phrases.pinyin: zhōngyī kàn bìng de fāngfǎ hé xīyī hěn bù yíyàng
phrases.translation: The way Chinese medicine examines a patient differs greatly from Western medicine.

phrases.text: 医生会看你的舌头,听你的声音,还要摸你的脉。
phrases.pinyin: yīshēng huì kàn nǐ de shétou tīng nǐ de shēngyīn hái yào mō nǐ de mài
phrases.translation: The doctor looks at your tongue, listens to your voice, and takes your pulse.

phrases.text: 他关心的不只是病,还有你整个人的状态。
phrases.pinyin: tā guānxīn de bù zhǐshì bìng hái yǒu nǐ zhěnggè rén de zhuàngtài
phrases.translation: What concerns him is not only the illness but the state of your whole person.

phrases.text: 中医认为身体讲究平衡,太热或者太寒都会生病。
phrases.pinyin: zhōngyī rènwéi shēntǐ jiǎngjiu pínghéng tài rè huòzhě tài hán dōu huì shēngbìng
phrases.translation: Chinese medicine holds that the body needs balance; too hot or too cold makes you ill.

phrases.text: 所以中医常说"调理",而不是简单地"治好"。
phrases.pinyin: suǒyǐ zhōngyī cháng shuō tiáolǐ ér bú shì jiǎndān de zhì hǎo
phrases.translation: So Chinese doctors speak of "regulating" rather than simply "curing".

phrases.text: 今天在中国,中医和西医常常一起使用。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān zài Zhōngguó zhōngyī hé xīyī chángcháng yìqǐ shǐyòng
phrases.translation: In China today, Chinese and Western medicine are often used together.

phrases.text: 感冒的时候,有人吃西药,也有人先喝一碗中药。
phrases.pinyin: gǎnmào de shíhou yǒu rén chī xīyào yě yǒu rén xiān hē yì wǎn zhōngyào
phrases.translation: With a cold, some take Western pills, and some first drink a bowl of herbal decoction.

phrases.text: 针灸在很多国家也越来越受欢迎。
phrases.pinyin: zhēnjiǔ zài hěn duō guójiā yě yuè lái yuè shòu huānyíng
phrases.translation: Acupuncture is also growing more popular in many countries.

phrases.text: 不过关于中医的争论一直没有停过。
phrases.pinyin: búguò guānyú zhōngyī de zhēnglùn yìzhí méiyǒu tíng guo
phrases.translation: The argument about Chinese medicine has never stopped, though.

phrases.text: 批评的人认为,很多方子缺少现代科学的证明。
phrases.pinyin: pīpíng de rén rènwéi hěn duō fāngzi quēshǎo xiàndài kēxué de zhèngmíng
phrases.translation: Critics hold that many prescriptions lack modern scientific proof.

phrases.text: 支持的人则说,有效果几千年了,不能简单否定。
phrases.pinyin: zhīchí de rén zé shuō yǒu xiàoguǒ jǐ qiān nián le bù néng jiǎndān fǒudìng
phrases.translation: Supporters reply that it has worked for thousands of years and cannot be dismissed.

phrases.text: 也许最合理的态度,是既不盲目相信,也不轻易否定。
phrases.pinyin: yěxǔ zuì hélǐ de tàidù shì jì bù mángmù xiāngxìn yě bù qīngyì fǒudìng
phrases.translation: Perhaps the soundest attitude is neither blind faith nor easy dismissal.

phrases.text: 让证据说话,同时尊重经验留下来的东西。
phrases.pinyin: ràng zhèngjù shuōhuà tóngshí zūnzhòng jīngyàn liú xiàlái de dōngxi
phrases.translation: Let the evidence speak, while respecting what experience has left behind.

phrases.text: 夜里十一点过后,街道渐渐安静下来。
phrases.pinyin: yè lǐ shíyī diǎn guò hòu jiēdào jiànjiàn ānjìng xiàlái
phrases.translation: Past 11 p.m., the streets gradually quiet down.

phrases.text: 但高楼底下,深夜食堂依然灯火通明,像一座座温暖的小岛。
phrases.pinyin: dàn gāolóu dǐxia shēnyè shítáng yīrán dēnghuǒ tōngmíng xiàng yí zuò zuò wēnnuǎn de xiǎo dǎo
phrases.translation: But beneath the high-rises, late-night canteens are still lit, like islands of warmth.

phrases.text: 加班的白领一边松领带,一边走进店里。
phrases.pinyin: jiābān de báilǐng yìbiān sōng lǐngdài yìbiān zǒu jìn diàn lǐ
phrases.translation: Office workers loosen their ties as they walk in.

phrases.text: 刚下班的司机默默地喝完一碗牛肉面。
phrases.pinyin: gāng xiàbān de sījī mòmò de hē wán yī wǎn niúròu miàn
phrases.translation: Drivers, just off shift, quietly gulp down a bowl of beef noodles.

phrases.text: 还有三两成群的年轻人,在过着"夜宵"。
phrases.pinyin: hái yǒu sān liǎng chéng qún de niánqīng rén zài guò zhe yèxiāo
phrases.translation: There are also young people, having an after-midnight feast in twos and threes.

phrases.text: 城市的灯光温柔,城市的孤独也温柔。
phrases.pinyin: chéngshì de dēngguāng wēnróu chéngshì de gūdú yě wēnróu
phrases.translation: City lights are gentle, but city loneliness is also gentle.

phrases.text: 在放下筷子以前,没有人急着离开。
phrases.pinyin: zài fàngxià kuàizi yǐqián méiyǒu rén jí zhe líkāi
phrases.translation: Before the chopsticks are put down, no one is in a rush to leave.

phrases.text: 夜归,成了这座城市最安静的仪式。
phrases.pinyin: yè guī chéng le zhè zuò chéngshì zuì ānjìng de yíshì
phrases.translation: Returning home from the night becomes the city's quietest ritual.

phrases.text: 深夜食堂的老板往往话不多。
phrases.pinyin: shēnyè shítáng de lǎobǎn wǎngwǎng huà bù duō
phrases.translation: The owner of a late-night canteen is usually a man of few words.

phrases.text: 他知道谁刚失恋,谁刚被辞退,却从来不问。
phrases.pinyin: tā zhīdào shéi gāng shīliàn shéi gāng bèi cítuì què cónglái bú wèn
phrases.translation: He knows who has just been left and who has just been let go, and never asks.

phrases.text: 他只是把面煮得更久一点,汤盛得更满一些。
phrases.pinyin: tā zhǐshì bǎ miàn zhǔ de gèng jiǔ yìdiǎn tāng chéng de gèng mǎn yìxiē
phrases.translation: He only boils the noodles a little longer and fills the bowl a little fuller.

phrases.text: 有人喝完酒,趴在桌子上睡着了。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu rén hē wán jiǔ pā zài zhuōzi shàng shuì zháo le
phrases.translation: Someone finished his drink and fell asleep slumped over the table.

phrases.text: 老板给他盖了一件外套,没有叫醒他。
phrases.pinyin: lǎobǎn gěi tā gài le yí jiàn wàitào méiyǒu jiào xǐng tā
phrases.translation: The owner laid a coat over him and did not wake him.

phrases.text: 凌晨两点,最后一班地铁早已停运。
phrases.pinyin: língchén liǎng diǎn zuìhòu yì bān dìtiě zǎo yǐ tíngyùn
phrases.translation: At two in the morning, the last subway has long since stopped running.

phrases.text: 街上只剩下代驾和网约车的灯。
phrases.pinyin: jiē shàng zhǐ shèng xià dàijià hé wǎngyuē chē de dēng
phrases.translation: Only the lights of substitute drivers and ride-hailing cars are left on the street.

phrases.text: 他们也在等,等着把别人送回家。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen yě zài děng děng zhe bǎ biérén sòng huí jiā
phrases.translation: They are waiting too — waiting to carry other people home.

phrases.text: 天快亮的时候,卖早点的摊子开始支起来。
phrases.pinyin: tiān kuài liàng de shíhou mài zǎodiǎn de tānzi kāishǐ zhī qǐlái
phrases.translation: As the sky begins to lighten, the breakfast stalls start going up.

phrases.text: 城市的夜和城市的早晨,在这一刻交接。
phrases.pinyin: chéngshì de yè hé chéngshì de zǎochen zài zhè yí kè jiāojiē
phrases.translation: The city's night and the city's morning hand over to each other at this moment.

phrases.text: 谁也没有说话,但一切都在继续。
phrases.pinyin: shéi yě méiyǒu shuōhuà dàn yíqiè dōu zài jìxù
phrases.translation: Nobody says a word, but everything goes on.

phrases.text: 亲爱的故乡:距离我离开你,已经十年。
phrases.pinyin: qīn'ài de gùxiāng jùlí wǒ líkāi nǐ yǐjīng shí nián
phrases.translation: Dear hometown — it has been ten years since I left.

phrases.text: 我常常梦见村口的那口老井。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ chángcháng mèngjiàn cūn kǒu de nà kǒu lǎo jǐng
phrases.translation: I often dream of the well at the end of the village.

phrases.text: 母亲说井已经被填了,取代它的是一个小小的广场。
phrases.pinyin: mǔqīn shuō jǐng yǐjīng bèi tián le qǔdài tā de shì yí ge xiǎoxiǎo de guǎngchǎng
phrases.translation: Mother said the well had been filled in — replaced by a small playground.

phrases.text: 我小时候读过书的那棵柳树也不在了。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ xiǎo shíhou dú guò shū de nà kē liǔshù yě bù zài le
phrases.translation: There is no longer the willow tree where, as a child, I once read.

phrases.text: 巷中开裂的石头,也被换成了整齐的方砖。
phrases.pinyin: xiàng zhōng kāiliè de shítou yě bèi huàn chéng le zhěngqí de fāng zhuān
phrases.translation: The cracked stones in the alley have all been replaced by neat brick.

phrases.text: 故乡,你仍是你,却已不再是记忆中的你。
phrases.pinyin: gùxiāng nǐ réng shì nǐ què yǐ búzài shì jìyì zhōng de nǐ
phrases.translation: Hometown, you are still you — but you are no longer the you of memory.

phrases.text: 也许我也早已不是当年那个小小的我。
phrases.pinyin: yěxǔ wǒ yě zǎo yǐ bú shì dāng nián nà ge xiǎoxiǎo de wǒ
phrases.translation: Perhaps I am also no longer that small me from back then.

phrases.text: 但我还是想给你写一封信,说给自己的过去听。
phrases.pinyin: dàn wǒ hái shì xiǎng gěi nǐ xiě yì fēng xìn shuō gěi zìjǐ de guòqù tīng
phrases.translation: Yet I still want to write you a letter — to say something to my own past.

phrases.text: 我记得夏天的傍晚,大人们把凉席铺在门口。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jìde xiàtiān de bàngwǎn dàrén men bǎ liángxí pū zài ménkǒu
phrases.translation: I remember summer evenings, when the grown-ups spread bamboo mats by the door.

phrases.text: 我们躺在上面数星星,直到被蚊子赶回屋里。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen tǎng zài shàngmiàn shǔ xīngxing zhídào bèi wénzi gǎn huí wū lǐ
phrases.translation: We lay on them counting stars until the mosquitoes drove us back inside.

phrases.text: 那时候没有空调,却好像没有那么热。
phrases.pinyin: nà shíhou méiyǒu kōngtiáo què hǎoxiàng méiyǒu nàme rè
phrases.translation: There was no air conditioning then, yet somehow it did not feel so hot.

phrases.text: 现在我住在有二十四层的楼里。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ zhù zài yǒu èrshísì céng de lóu lǐ
phrases.translation: Now I live in a building of twenty-four floors.

phrases.text: 邻居换了三次,我一个也叫不出名字。
phrases.pinyin: línjū huàn le sān cì wǒ yí ge yě jiào bù chū míngzi
phrases.translation: The neighbours have changed three times, and I cannot name a single one.
