phrases.text: 去年过年我回去了一趟,只待了三天。
phrases.pinyin: qùnián guònián wǒ huíqù le yí tàng zhǐ dāi le sān tiān
phrases.translation: Last New Year I went back once, and stayed only three days.

phrases.text: 村里的年轻人几乎都走了,只剩老人和小孩。
phrases.pinyin: cūn lǐ de niánqīng rén jīhū dōu zǒu le zhǐ shèng lǎorén hé xiǎohái
phrases.translation: Nearly all the young people have left the village; only the old and the children remain.

phrases.text: 我在老屋门口站了很久,却没有进去。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zài lǎo wū ménkǒu zhàn le hěn jiǔ què méiyǒu jìnqù
phrases.translation: I stood a long while at the door of the old house, but did not go in.

phrases.text: 也许我怕看见里面已经空了。
phrases.pinyin: yěxǔ wǒ pà kànjiàn lǐmiàn yǐjīng kōng le
phrases.translation: Perhaps I was afraid of seeing that it was already empty inside.

phrases.text: 故乡,原谅我把你留在了记忆里。
phrases.pinyin: gùxiāng yuánliàng wǒ bǎ nǐ liú zài le jìyì lǐ
phrases.translation: Hometown, forgive me for leaving you behind in memory.

phrases.text: 因为只有在记忆里,你才不会变。
phrases.pinyin: yīnwèi zhǐyǒu zài jìyì lǐ nǐ cái bú huì biàn
phrases.translation: Because only in memory will you never change.

phrases.text: 每天早晨,我做的第一件事,是打开手机。
phrases.pinyin: měi tiān zǎochén wǒ zuò de dì yī jiàn shì shì dǎkāi shǒujī
phrases.translation: Every morning, the first thing I do is open my phone.

phrases.text: 算法精准地嗅出我每一种偏好。
phrases.pinyin: suànfǎ jīngzhǔn de xiù chū wǒ měi yì zhǒng piānhào
phrases.translation: The algorithm precisely sniffs out my every preference.

phrases.text: 它只推给我我想看的内容。
phrases.pinyin: tā zhǐ tuī gěi wǒ wǒ xiǎng kàn de nèiróng
phrases.translation: It pushes me only the content I want to see.

phrases.text: 我渐渐意识到,自己被困在所谓"信息茧房"中。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ jiànjiàn yìshí dào zìjǐ bèi kùn zài suǒwèi xìnxī jiǎnfáng zhōng
phrases.translation: I gradually realize I'm trapped in a so-called "information cocoon."

phrases.text: 不同的声音,被系统自动过滤掉。
phrases.pinyin: bùtóng de shēngyīn bèi xìtǒng zìdòng guòlǜ diào
phrases.translation: Different views are filtered out by the system.

phrases.text: 每个人都活在自己"完美"的小世界。
phrases.pinyin: měi gèrén dōu huó zài zìjǐ wánměi de xiǎo shìjiè
phrases.translation: Everyone lives inside their own "perfect" little world.

phrases.text: 然而,这种"完美"中,藏着前所未有的孤独。
phrases.pinyin: rán'ér zhè zhǒng wánměi zhōng cáng zhe qián suǒ wèi yǒu de gūdú
phrases.translation: Yet within this "perfection" lies a never-before-seen loneliness.

phrases.text: 也许我们缺的不是信息,而是面对陌生的勇气。
phrases.pinyin: yěxǔ wǒmen quē de bú shì xìnxī ér shì miànduì mòshēng de yǒngqì
phrases.translation: Maybe what we lack is not information, but the courage to face the unfamiliar.

phrases.text: 我做过一个实验,把推荐关掉一个星期。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuò guo yí ge shíyàn bǎ tuījiàn guān diào yí ge xīngqī
phrases.translation: I once ran an experiment and turned the recommendations off for a week.

phrases.text: 那几天我很不习惯,像走进了陌生的城市。
phrases.pinyin: nà jǐ tiān wǒ hěn bù xíguàn xiàng zǒu jìn le mòshēng de chéngshì
phrases.translation: Those days felt very strange, like walking into an unfamiliar city.

phrases.text: 我看到了很多我平时不会点开的东西。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ kàndào le hěn duō wǒ píngshí bú huì diǎn kāi de dōngxi
phrases.translation: I saw a great many things I would never normally have opened.

phrases.text: 有些让我不舒服,有些让我重新思考。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu xiē ràng wǒ bù shūfu yǒu xiē ràng wǒ chóngxīn sīkǎo
phrases.translation: Some made me uncomfortable; some made me think again.

phrases.text: 算法最可怕的地方,不是它骗你。
phrases.pinyin: suànfǎ zuì kěpà de dìfang bú shì tā piàn nǐ
phrases.translation: The frightening thing about an algorithm is not that it deceives you.

phrases.text: 而是它太懂你,懂到你不再需要选择。
phrases.pinyin: ér shì tā tài dǒng nǐ dǒng dào nǐ bú zài xūyào xuǎnzé
phrases.translation: It is that it understands you so well you no longer need to choose.

phrases.text: 你以为那是你的口味,其实是它训练出来的。
phrases.pinyin: nǐ yǐwéi nà shì nǐ de kǒuwèi qíshí shì tā xùnliàn chūlái de
phrases.translation: You think that is your taste, when in fact it was trained into you.

phrases.text: 我们每一次停留,每一次划过,都在教它。
phrases.pinyin: wǒmen měi yí cì tíngliú měi yí cì huá guò dōu zài jiāo tā
phrases.translation: Every pause of ours, every swipe past, is teaching it.

phrases.text: 然后它把我们教出来的东西,再喂回给我们。
phrases.pinyin: ránhòu tā bǎ wǒmen jiāo chūlái de dōngxi zài wèi huí gěi wǒmen
phrases.translation: Then it feeds what we taught it straight back to us.

phrases.text: 这是一个越转越紧的圈。
phrases.pinyin: zhè shì yí ge yuè zhuàn yuè jǐn de quān
phrases.translation: It is a circle that winds tighter the longer it turns.

phrases.text: 要走出去,可能只需要一点不方便。
phrases.pinyin: yào zǒu chūqù kěnéng zhǐ xūyào yìdiǎn bù fāngbiàn
phrases.translation: Getting out of it may take no more than a little inconvenience.

phrases.text: 胡同是老北京的灵魂。
phrases.pinyin: hútòng shì Lǎo Běijīng de línghún
phrases.translation: Hutongs are the soul of old Beijing.

phrases.text: 它们狭窄的石砖路承载着几百年的故事。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen xiázhǎi de shí zhuān lù chéngzài zhe jǐ bǎi nián de gùshi
phrases.translation: Their narrow stone-paved lanes carry centuries of stories.

phrases.text: 晾衣服的大妈,下棋的老人,追着跑的小孩。
phrases.pinyin: liàng yīfu de dàmā xià qí de lǎorén zhuī zhe pǎo de xiǎohái
phrases.translation: Aunties drying clothes, old men playing chess, kids chasing each other.

phrases.text: 这些平凡的画面,曾是北京最日常的面孔。
phrases.pinyin: zhèxiē píngfán de huàmiàn céng shì Běijīng zuì rìcháng de miànkǒng
phrases.translation: These ordinary scenes were the most everyday face of Beijing.

phrases.text: 然而,随着城市扩张,胡同在不断地被拆除。
phrases.pinyin: rán'ér suízhe chéngshì kuòzhāng hútòng zài búduàn de bèi chāichú
phrases.translation: Yet with the city's expansion, hutongs are constantly being demolished.

phrases.text: 高楼代替了四合院,邻里情谊也随墙一起消失。
phrases.pinyin: gāolóu dàitì le sìhéyuàn línlǐ qíngyì yě suí qiáng yìqǐ xiāoshī
phrases.translation: Skyscrapers replace courtyards, and neighborly bonds vanish along with the walls.

phrases.text: 一些留下来的胡同,成了游客的打卡地。
phrases.pinyin: yìxiē liú xiàlái de hútòng chéng le yóukè de dǎkǎ dì
phrases.translation: Some of the remaining hutongs have become tourist attractions.

phrases.text: 可当原住民离开以后,胡同成了没有演员的舞台。
phrases.pinyin: kě dāng yuán zhùmín líkāi yǐhòu hútòng chéng le méiyǒu yǎnyuán de wǔtái
phrases.translation: Yet when the locals leave, the hutongs become a stage with no actors.

phrases.text: 胡同这个词,据说来自蒙古语,原意是水井。
phrases.pinyin: hútòng zhè ge cí jùshuō láizì Ménggǔ yǔ yuányì shì shuǐjǐng
phrases.translation: The word hutong is said to come from Mongolian, where it meant a well.

phrases.text: 有水的地方就有人家,有人家就成了巷子。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu shuǐ de dìfang jiù yǒu rénjiā yǒu rénjiā jiù chéng le xiàngzi
phrases.translation: Where there was water there were households, and households made a lane.

phrases.text: 北京最窄的胡同不到一米,两个人要侧身才能过。
phrases.pinyin: Běijīng zuì zhǎi de hútòng bú dào yì mǐ liǎng ge rén yào cè shēn cái néng guò
phrases.translation: Beijing's narrowest hutong is under a metre; two people must turn sideways to pass.

phrases.text: 每条胡同都有自己的名字,有的很土气。
phrases.pinyin: měi tiáo hútòng dōu yǒu zìjǐ de míngzi yǒu de hěn tǔqì
phrases.translation: Every hutong has its own name, and some are decidedly rustic.

phrases.text: 比如"炒豆胡同"、"狗尾巴胡同"。
phrases.pinyin: bǐrú Chǎodòu Hútòng Gǒuwěiba Hútòng
phrases.translation: For instance Fried Bean Hutong, or Dog Tail Hutong.

phrases.text: 名字里藏着从前住在这里的人做什么营生。
phrases.pinyin: míngzi lǐ cáng zhe cóngqián zhù zài zhèlǐ de rén zuò shénme yíngshēng
phrases.translation: Hidden in the names is what the people who once lived there did for a living.

phrases.text: 四合院的门口常有两个石墩子。
phrases.pinyin: sìhéyuàn de ménkǒu cháng yǒu liǎng ge shí dūnzi
phrases.translation: At the gate of a courtyard house there are often two stone blocks.

phrases.text: 老人说,看门墩就知道这家从前是文官还是武官。
phrases.pinyin: lǎorén shuō kàn méndūn jiù zhīdào zhè jiā cóngqián shì wénguān háishi wǔguān
phrases.translation: The old people say the gate blocks tell you whether the family were civil or military officials.

phrases.text: 冬天的胡同里,煤炉的烟从屋顶慢慢升起来。
phrases.pinyin: dōngtiān de hútòng lǐ méilú de yān cóng wūdǐng mànmàn shēng qǐlái
phrases.translation: In the winter hutong, coal-stove smoke rose slowly from the rooftops.

phrases.text: 那种味道,现在的孩子已经闻不到了。
phrases.pinyin: nà zhǒng wèidào xiànzài de háizi yǐjīng wén bú dào le
phrases.translation: That smell is one today's children can no longer catch.

phrases.text: 公元一零八零年,苏轼被贬到黄州。
phrases.pinyin: gōngyuán yī líng bā líng nián Sū Shì bèi biǎn dào Huángzhōu
phrases.translation: In 1080, Su Shi was demoted to Huangzhou.

phrases.text: 他人生陷入低谷,被诬陷诽谤朝廷。
phrases.pinyin: tā rénshēng xiànrù dīgǔ bèi wūxiàn fěibàng cháotíng
phrases.translation: He had hit a low point in life — falsely accused of slandering the court.

phrases.text: 在黄州,他缺衣少食,亲自耕种一块坡地。
phrases.pinyin: zài Huángzhōu tā quēyī shǎoshí qīnzì gēngzhòng yī kuài pō dì
phrases.translation: In Huangzhou, lacking food and clothing, he started farming a piece of slope land himself.

phrases.text: 他把那块地取名"东坡",自号"东坡居士"。
phrases.pinyin: tā bǎ nà kuài dì qǔ míng Dōngpō zì hào Dōngpō Jūshì
phrases.translation: He named that piece of land "Eastern Slope," and from it took the literary name Dongpo Jushi.

phrases.text: 正是这段时间,他写出了他最伟大的作品。
phrases.pinyin: zhèng shì zhè duàn shíjiān tā xiě chū le tā zuì wěidà de zuòpǐn
phrases.translation: It was during this period that he wrote his greatest works.

phrases.text: 《赤壁怀古》就是在这时完成的。
phrases.pinyin: Chìbì Huái Gǔ jiùshì zài zhèshí wánchéng de
phrases.translation: "Reflections at Red Cliff" was completed at exactly this moment.

phrases.text: 他不再哀叹命运的不公,反而学会了对命运微笑。
phrases.pinyin: tā búzài āitàn mìngyùn de bùgōng fǎn'ér xué huì le duì mìngyùn wēixiào
phrases.translation: He no longer lamented misfortune — he learned to smile at fate.

phrases.text: 黄州毁掉了政治家苏轼,却成就了文学家东坡。
phrases.pinyin: Huángzhōu huǐdiào le zhèngzhì jiā Sū Shì què chéngjiù le wénxué jiā Dōngpō
phrases.translation: Huangzhou ruined the politician but completed the writer.

phrases.text: 到黄州的第二年,他在城东开了五十亩荒地。
phrases.pinyin: dào Huángzhōu de dì èr nián tā zài chéng dōng kāi le wǔshí mǔ huāngdì
phrases.translation: In his second year at Huangzhou he opened up fifty mu of waste ground east of the town.

phrases.text: 他写信给朋友说,自己现在是个农夫了。
phrases.pinyin: tā xiě xìn gěi péngyou shuō zìjǐ xiànzài shì ge nóngfū le
phrases.translation: He wrote to a friend saying that he was now a farmer.

phrases.text: 他还发明了一道菜,用小火慢慢炖猪肉。
phrases.pinyin: tā hái fāmíng le yí dào cài yòng xiǎo huǒ mànmàn dùn zhūròu
phrases.translation: He also invented a dish — pork stewed slowly over a low flame.

phrases.text: 那道菜后来就叫东坡肉,一直传到今天。
phrases.pinyin: nà dào cài hòulái jiù jiào Dōngpō ròu yìzhí chuán dào jīntiān
phrases.translation: That dish came to be called Dongpo pork, and has lasted to this day.

phrases.text: 一个被贬的官员,教会了中国人怎么吃肉。
phrases.pinyin: yí ge bèi biǎn de guānyuán jiāohuì le Zhōngguó rén zěnme chī ròu
phrases.translation: A demoted official taught the Chinese how to cook pork.

phrases.text: 他在黄州写的《寒食帖》,被称为天下第三行书。
phrases.pinyin: tā zài Huángzhōu xiě de Hán Shí Tiě bèi chēngwéi tiānxià dì sān xíngshū
phrases.translation: The Cold Food Observance he wrote at Huangzhou is called the third finest running script under heaven.

phrases.text: 那幅字里,能看出他写的时候心情起伏。
phrases.pinyin: nà fú zì lǐ néng kàn chū tā xiě de shíhou xīnqíng qǐfú
phrases.translation: In that piece of calligraphy you can see his mood rise and fall as he wrote.

phrases.text: 有一次他和朋友夜游赤壁,忽然想通了。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu yí cì tā hé péngyou yè yóu Chìbì hūrán xiǎng tōng le
phrases.translation: Once he went boating by night at Red Cliff with friends, and something came clear to him.

phrases.text: 他说,江上的清风和山间的明月,是取之不尽的。
phrases.pinyin: tā shuō jiāng shàng de qīngfēng hé shān jiān de míngyuè shì qǔ zhī bú jìn de
phrases.translation: He said the clear wind on the river and the bright moon in the hills are inexhaustible.

phrases.text: 那是造物者留给所有人的,不用花一分钱。
phrases.pinyin: nà shì zàowùzhě liú gěi suǒyǒu rén de búyòng huā yì fēn qián
phrases.translation: They are what the Maker left for everyone, and cost not a single coin.

phrases.text: 故宫的红墙黄瓦,可算是皇家建筑的缩影。
phrases.pinyin: Gùgōng de hóng qiáng huáng wǎ kě suàn shì huángjiā jiànzhù de suōyǐng
phrases.translation: The Forbidden City's red walls and yellow tiles can stand as a reduction of all imperial architecture.

phrases.text: 红色代表权威与尊贵,黄色象征皇权。
phrases.pinyin: hóngsè dàibiǎo quánwēi yǔ zūnguì huángsè xiàngzhēng huáng quán
phrases.translation: Red represents power and dignity, yellow symbolizes the throne.

phrases.text: 我曾在初冬的清晨站在这些高墙下。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ céng zài chū dōng de qīngchén zhàn zài zhèxiē gāoqiáng xià
phrases.translation: I once stood beneath these high walls in early winter.

phrases.text: 阳光缓缓地在墙上移动,像一场无声的潮水。
phrases.pinyin: yángguāng huǎnhuǎn de zài qiáng shàng yídòng xiàng yì chǎng wúshēng de cháoshuǐ
phrases.translation: Sunlight slowly traveled across the wall, like a quiet tide.

phrases.text: 乌鸦从金顶上飞过,留下几声尖锐的鸣叫。
phrases.pinyin: wūyā cóng jīn dǐng shàng fēi guò liúxià jǐ shēng jiānruì de míngjiào
phrases.translation: Crows passed over the gold-tiled roofs, leaving a few sharp cries.

phrases.text: 王朝的主人早已在这里化为尘土。
phrases.pinyin: wángcháo de zhǔrén zǎo yǐ zài zhèlǐ huà wéi chéntǔ
phrases.translation: The rulers of dynasties have all turned to dust here.

phrases.text: 但红墙依然挺立,见证着时光缓慢的流动。
phrases.pinyin: dàn hóng qiáng yīrán tǐnglì jiànzhèng zhe shíguāng huǎnmàn de liúdòng
phrases.translation: But the red walls are still standing, witnessing the slow course of time.

phrases.text: 走出宫门,我忽然感到一种人间的安静。
phrases.pinyin: zǒu chū gōng mén wǒ hūrán gǎndào yì zhǒng rénjiān de ānjìng
phrases.translation: Walking out of the palace, I suddenly felt a kind of human stillness.

phrases.text: 故宫有九千多间房子,走完要好几天。
phrases.pinyin: Gùgōng yǒu jiǔ qiān duō jiān fángzi zǒu wán yào hǎo jǐ tiān
phrases.translation: The Forbidden City has over nine thousand rooms; walking them all takes days.

phrases.text: 从前住在这里的人,一辈子也见不到皇帝几次。
phrases.pinyin: cóngqián zhù zài zhèlǐ de rén yíbèizi yě jiàn bú dào huángdì jǐ cì
phrases.translation: Those who once lived here might not see the emperor more than a few times in a lifetime.

phrases.text: 宫女进宫的时候大多十三四岁。
phrases.pinyin: gōngnǚ jìn gōng de shíhou dàduō shísān sì suì
phrases.translation: Most palace maids entered the palace at thirteen or fourteen.

phrases.text: 她们中的很多人,再也没有走出过这道门。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen zhōng de hěn duō rén zài yě méiyǒu zǒu chū guo zhè dào mén
phrases.translation: Many of them never walked back out through this gate again.

phrases.text: 红墙的颜色其实每隔几年就要重新刷一次。
phrases.pinyin: hóng qiáng de yánsè qíshí měi gé jǐ nián jiù yào chóngxīn shuā yí cì
phrases.translation: The color of the red walls in fact has to be repainted every few years.

phrases.text: 工匠说,那种红要用矿石磨成粉,再一层层上。
phrases.pinyin: gōngjiàng shuō nà zhǒng hóng yào yòng kuàngshí mó chéng fěn zài yì céng céng shàng
phrases.translation: The craftsmen say that red is ground from mineral stone and laid on layer by layer.

phrases.text: 太阳晒久了会褪色,雨水也会带走一些。
phrases.pinyin: tàiyáng shài jiǔ le huì tuìsè yǔshuǐ yě huì dài zǒu yìxiē
phrases.translation: Long sun fades it, and the rain carries some of it away.

phrases.text: 所以我们看到的红,是一代代人不断补上去的。
phrases.pinyin: suǒyǐ wǒmen kàndào de hóng shì yí dài dài rén búduàn bǔ shàngqù de
phrases.translation: So the red we see is what generation after generation kept putting back.

phrases.text: 建筑不会自己活下来,是有人一直在照顾它。
phrases.pinyin: jiànzhù bú huì zìjǐ huó xiàlái shì yǒu rén yìzhí zài zhàogù tā
phrases.translation: A building does not survive by itself; someone has been caring for it all along.

phrases.text: 这大概也是一种记忆的方式。
phrases.pinyin: zhè dàgài yě shì yì zhǒng jìyì de fāngshì
phrases.translation: That is probably a form of memory as well.

phrases.text: 鲁迅被普遍视为中国现代文学的奠基人。
phrases.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn bèi pǔbiàn shì wéi Zhōngguó xiàndài wénxué de diànjī rén
phrases.translation: Lu Xun is widely seen as the founder of modern Chinese literature.

phrases.text: 他原本赴日学医,希望治病救人。
phrases.pinyin: tā yuánběn fù Rì xué yī xīwàng zhìbìng jiùrén
phrases.translation: He had originally gone to Japan to study medicine.

phrases.text: 但他后来认为,更致命的病,是中国人的精神。
phrases.pinyin: dàn tā hòulái rènwéi gèng zhìmìng de bìng shì Zhōngguó rén de jīngshén
phrases.translation: But he later believed: a more terminal illness was the spirit of the Chinese.

phrases.text: 于是他弃医从文,以笔为刀,剖开国人的麻木。
phrases.pinyin: yúshì tā qìyī cóng wén yǐ bǐ wéi dāo pōukāi guórén de mámù
phrases.translation: So he abandoned medicine to take up writing — using the pen as a scalpel.

phrases.text: 《狂人日记》、《阿Q正传》是他的代表作品。
phrases.pinyin: Kuáng Rén Rìjì Ā Q Zhèngzhuàn shì tā de dàibiǎo zuòpǐn
phrases.translation: "A Madman's Diary" and "The True Story of Ah Q" are his representative works.

phrases.text: 他看到礼教中"吃人"的本质。
phrases.pinyin: tā kàndào lǐjiào zhōng chī rén de běnzhì
phrases.translation: He saw "man eating man" within the Confucian classics.

phrases.text: 他的文字犀利,心中却怀有无限的温情。
phrases.pinyin: tā de wénzì xīlì xīnzhōng què huái yǒu wúxiàn de wēnqíng
phrases.translation: His writing was sharp, but his heart held boundless tenderness.

phrases.text: 他曾经说:"世上本没有路,走的人多了,也便成了路。"
phrases.pinyin: tā céngjīng shuō shì shàng běn méiyǒu lù zǒu de rén duō le yě biàn chéng le lù
phrases.translation: He once said: "There was originally no road, but as walkers came, a road formed."

phrases.text: 他在日本看过一张幻灯片。
phrases.pinyin: tā zài Rìběn kàn guo yì zhāng huàndēng piàn
phrases.translation: In Japan he once saw a lantern slide.

phrases.text: 片子里,一个中国人要被砍头,旁边围着一群中国人看热闹。
phrases.pinyin: piànzi lǐ yí ge Zhōngguó rén yào bèi kǎn tóu pángbiān wéi zhe yì qún Zhōngguó rén kàn rènao
phrases.translation: In it a Chinese man was about to be beheaded, ringed by a crowd of Chinese watching the spectacle.

phrases.text: 那些看客的表情麻木而好奇。
phrases.pinyin: nàxiē kànkè de biǎoqíng mámù ér hàoqí
phrases.translation: The faces of those onlookers were numb and curious.

phrases.text: 他后来说,那一刻他决定不再学医。
phrases.pinyin: tā hòulái shuō nà yí kè tā juédìng bú zài xué yī
phrases.translation: He said later that in that instant he decided to stop studying medicine.

phrases.text: 身体再好也没有用,如果精神是麻木的。
phrases.pinyin: shēntǐ zài hǎo yě méiyǒu yòng rúguǒ jīngshén shì mámù de
phrases.translation: However sound the body, it is no use if the spirit is numb.

phrases.text: 《狂人日记》是中国第一篇白话小说。
phrases.pinyin: Kuángrén Rìjì shì Zhōngguó dì yī piān báihuà xiǎoshuō
phrases.translation: A Madman's Diary was the first story in vernacular Chinese.

phrases.text: 那个"狂人"翻开历史书,满本都写着"仁义道德"。
phrases.pinyin: nà ge kuángrén fān kāi lìshǐ shū mǎn běn dōu xiě zhe rényì dàodé
phrases.translation: The madman opens the history books and every page is written with "benevolence and virtue".

phrases.text: 可是他仔细看,字缝里却全是"吃人"两个字。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì tā zǐxì kàn zì fèng lǐ què quán shì chī rén liǎng ge zì
phrases.translation: But looking closely, between the lines it is nothing but the words "eat people".

phrases.text: 鲁迅一生都在骂,却也一生都在帮年轻人。
phrases.pinyin: Lǔ Xùn yìshēng dōu zài mà què yě yìshēng dōu zài bāng niánqīng rén
phrases.translation: Lu Xun spent his life railing, and spent it just as much helping the young.

phrases.text: 他常常自己掏钱,给学生印书。
phrases.pinyin: tā chángcháng zìjǐ tāo qián gěi xuéshēng yìn shū
phrases.translation: He often paid out of his own pocket to have students' books printed.

phrases.text: 他去世的时候,棺材上盖着三个字:民族魂。
phrases.pinyin: tā qùshì de shíhou guāncai shàng gài zhe sān ge zì mínzú hún
phrases.translation: When he died, three characters were laid over his coffin: Soul of the Nation.

phrases.text: 茶马古道是中国西南与西藏之间最古老的山间贸易通道之一。
phrases.pinyin: Chá Mǎ Gǔdào shì Zhōngguó xīnán yǔ Xīzàng zhījiān zuì gǔlǎo de shān jiān màoyì tōngdào zhī yī
phrases.translation: The Tea Horse Road is one of the oldest mountain trade routes between southwest China and Tibet.

phrases.text: 始于唐宋年间,商队沿着这条古道以茶换马。
phrases.pinyin: shǐ yú Táng Sòng niánjiān shāngduì yán zhe zhè tiáo gǔdào yǐ chá huàn mǎ
phrases.translation: Beginning in the Tang and Song, caravans traded tea for horses along this road.

phrases.text: 路线穿越高山大江,是世界上最凶险的商道之一。
phrases.pinyin: lùxiàn chuānyuè gāoshān dà jiāng shì shìjiè shàng zuì xiōngxiǎn de shāngdào zhī yī
phrases.translation: The route winds through mountains and rivers, the most dangerous in the world.

phrases.text: 马帮在路上一走就是几个月。
phrases.pinyin: mǎbāng zài lù shàng yī zǒu jiùshì jǐ ge yuè
phrases.translation: The horse caravans (mabang) walked the road for months on end.

phrases.text: 头马的铃铛日夜作响。
phrases.pinyin: tóu mǎ de língdang rìyè zuò xiǎng
phrases.translation: The bell on the head horse rang day and night.

phrases.text: 他们把茶叶、盐和丝绸运进藏区。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen bǎ cháyè yán hé sīchóu yùn jìn Zàng qū
phrases.translation: They brought tea, salt, and silk into Tibet.

phrases.text: 回程时则运回马匹、皮毛与藏药。
phrases.pinyin: huíchéng shí zé yùn huí mǎpǐ pímáo yǔ zàng yào
phrases.translation: On the way back they brought horses, hides, and Tibetan medicine.

phrases.text: 它如今已无人行走,但那些山道仍在,风也在。
phrases.pinyin: tā rújīn yǐ wú rén xíngzǒu dàn nà xiē shāndào réng zài fēng yě zài
phrases.translation: It is no longer in use, but those mountain paths still endure.

phrases.text: 谁走过一次,都会听见一首从过去传来的沉郁长歌。
phrases.pinyin: shuí zǒu guò yí cì dōu huì tīngjiàn yì shǒu cóng guòqù chuán lái de chényù cháng gē
phrases.translation: Whoever walks them once will hear a deep song coming from the past.

phrases.text: 马帮的队伍里,每个人都有自己的位置。
phrases.pinyin: mǎbāng de duìwu lǐ měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de wèizhi
phrases.translation: In a caravan every man had his own place.

phrases.text: 走在最前面的叫锅头,他决定今天走到哪里。
phrases.pinyin: zǒu zài zuì qiánmiàn de jiào guōtóu tā juédìng jīntiān zǒu dào nǎlǐ
phrases.translation: The man walking at the front was the guotou, and he decided how far they went that day.

phrases.text: 路窄的地方,一边是山壁,一边是几百米的深谷。
phrases.pinyin: lù zhǎi de dìfang yì biān shì shānbì yì biān shì jǐ bǎi mǐ de shēngǔ
phrases.translation: Where the path narrowed, one side was rock wall and the other a gorge hundreds of metres deep.

phrases.text: 马失前蹄的事,每年都会发生几次。
phrases.pinyin: mǎ shī qián tí de shì měi nián dōu huì fāshēng jǐ cì
phrases.translation: A horse losing its footing happened several times a year.

phrases.text: 他们在山里睡觉,把马围成一圈挡风。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen zài shān lǐ shuìjiào bǎ mǎ wéi chéng yì quān dǎng fēng
phrases.translation: They slept in the mountains, ringing the horses around them to block the wind.

phrases.text: 到了藏区,一块砖茶可以换一匹好马。
phrases.pinyin: dào le Zàng qū yí kuài zhuān chá kěyǐ huàn yì pǐ hǎo mǎ
phrases.translation: In the Tibetan regions, one brick of tea could be traded for a good horse.

phrases.text: 茶在高原上不是饮料,而是必需品。
phrases.pinyin: chá zài gāoyuán shàng bú shì yǐnliào ér shì bìxūpǐn
phrases.translation: On the plateau tea was not a drink but a necessity.

phrases.text: 那里蔬菜很少,茶能补充身体需要的东西。
phrases.pinyin: nàlǐ shūcài hěn shǎo chá néng bǔchōng shēntǐ xūyào de dōngxi
phrases.translation: Vegetables were scarce there, and tea supplied what the body needed.

phrases.text: 二十世纪五十年代,公路修通了。
phrases.pinyin: èrshí shìjì wǔshí niándài gōnglù xiū tōng le
phrases.translation: In the 1950s the motor road was put through.

phrases.text: 铃铛声停了,可是路还在山上,一圈一圈地绕。
phrases.pinyin: língdang shēng tíng le kěshì lù hái zài shān shàng yì quān yì quān de rào
phrases.translation: The bells stopped, but the road is still on the mountain, winding round and round.

phrases.text: 长江从青藏高原奔流而下,在西陵、巫峡、瞿塘之间被群山紧紧夹住。
phrases.pinyin: Chángjiāng cóng Qīng-Zàng Gāoyuán bēnliú ér xià zài Xīlíng Wū Xiá Qútáng zhījiān bèi qún shān jǐnjǐn jiā zhù
phrases.translation: The Yangtze rushes down from the Tibetan Plateau and is gripped tight by mountains between Xiling, Wu and Qutang.

phrases.text: 那一段两百公里的水路,古人称之为三峡。
phrases.pinyin: nà yí duàn liǎng bǎi gōnglǐ de shuǐlù gǔrén chēng zhī wéi Sān Xiá
phrases.translation: That two-hundred-kilometre stretch of water the ancients called the Three Gorges.

phrases.text: 两岸的悬崖高得几乎看不见天,江水在中间挤出一条窄窄的路。
phrases.pinyin: liǎng àn de xuányá gāo de jīhū kàn bú jiàn tiān jiāngshuǐ zài zhōngjiān jǐ chū yì tiáo zhǎizhǎi de lù
phrases.translation: The cliffs on both banks rise so high the sky is nearly invisible, and the water squeezes a narrow road between them.

phrases.text: 一千五百年前,郦道元在《水经注》里写下"重岩叠嶂,隐天蔽日"。
phrases.pinyin: yì qiān wǔ bǎi nián qián Lì Dàoyuán zài Shuǐ Jīng Zhù lǐ xiě xià chóng yán dié zhàng yǐn tiān bì rì
phrases.translation: Fifteen centuries ago Li Daoyuan wrote in the Commentary on the Waterways Classic: "Layered cliffs and folded peaks, hiding the sky and blotting out the sun."

phrases.text: 唐朝的李白也曾在这里留下"两岸猿声啼不住,轻舟已过万重山"。
phrases.pinyin: Táng cháo de Lǐ Bái yě céng zài zhèlǐ liú xià liǎng àn yuán shēng tí bú zhù qīng zhōu yǐ guò wàn chóng shān
phrases.translation: Li Bai of the Tang also left lines here: "The apes on both banks cry without cease, as the light boat has passed ten thousand mountains."

phrases.text: 那是被赦免以后顺流而下的快意,一日千里。
phrases.pinyin: nà shì bèi shèmiǎn yǐhòu shùn liú ér xià de kuàiyì yí rì qiān lǐ
phrases.translation: That was the exhilaration of drifting downstream after being pardoned — a thousand li in a single day.

phrases.text: 千百年来,三峡既是绝景,也是险途。
phrases.pinyin: qiān bǎi nián lái Sān Xiá jì shì jué jǐng yě shì xiǎn tú
phrases.translation: For centuries the Three Gorges were both a sublime sight and a perilous passage.

phrases.text: 江面上常有沉船的传说,纤夫赤着脚在岩壁上拉船前行。
phrases.pinyin: jiāngmiàn shàng cháng yǒu chén chuán de chuánshuō qiànfū chì zhe jiǎo zài yánbì shàng lā chuán qiánxíng
phrases.translation: Legends of sunken boats haunted the water, while barefoot trackers hauled vessels forward along the rock face.

phrases.text: 二十世纪末,一座巨大的水坝在这里开始修建。
phrases.pinyin: èrshí shìjì mò yí zuò jùdà de shuǐbà zài zhèlǐ kāishǐ xiūjiàn
phrases.translation: At the end of the twentieth century, an enormous dam began to rise here.

phrases.text: 它带来了世界上最大的水电站,也带来了防洪的能力。
phrases.pinyin: tā dàilái le shìjiè shàng zuì dà de shuǐdiàn zhàn yě dàilái le fánghóng de nénglì
phrases.translation: It brought the world's largest hydroelectric station, and flood control as well.

phrases.text: 但水位上升了一百多米,淹没了上千个村庄和城镇。
phrases.pinyin: dàn shuǐwèi shàngshēng le yì bǎi duō mǐ yānmò le shàng qiān ge cūnzhuāng hé chéngzhèn
phrases.translation: But the water rose more than a hundred metres, drowning over a thousand villages and towns.

phrases.text: 一百多万人离开了祖祖辈辈生活的土地。
phrases.pinyin: yì bǎi duō wàn rén líkāi le zǔzǔ bèibèi shēnghuó de tǔdì
phrases.translation: More than a million people left land their families had worked for generations.

phrases.text: 有些古迹被整体搬到了高处,有些永远沉在了水下。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu xiē gǔjì bèi zhěngtǐ bān dào le gāo chù yǒu xiē yǒngyuǎn chén zài le shuǐ xià
phrases.translation: Some ancient sites were moved whole to higher ground; others lie under the water forever.

phrases.text: 今天的游船平稳地驶过,乘客举着手机拍照。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān de yóuchuán píngwěn de shǐ guò chéngkè jǔ zhe shǒujī pāizhào
phrases.translation: Today the cruise boats glide through smoothly, passengers holding up their phones.

phrases.text: 江面比从前宽阔,也比从前安静。
phrases.pinyin: jiāngmiàn bǐ cóngqián kuānkuò yě bǐ cóngqián ānjìng
phrases.translation: The river is broader than it once was, and quieter than it once was.

phrases.text: 那些猿声早已听不见了,只有山还站在原来的地方。
phrases.pinyin: nàxiē yuán shēng zǎo yǐ tīng bú jiàn le zhǐ yǒu shān hái zhàn zài yuánlái de dìfang
phrases.translation: Those ape cries have long been beyond hearing; only the mountains still stand where they stood.

phrases.text: 在钟表和日历出现以前,中国人用二十四个节气来分辨时间。
phrases.pinyin: zài zhōngbiǎo hé rìlì chūxiàn yǐqián Zhōngguó rén yòng èrshísì ge jiéqì lái fēnbiàn shíjiān
phrases.translation: Before clocks and calendars existed, Chinese people distinguished time by twenty-four solar terms.

phrases.text: 它们把一年切成二十四段,每一段大约十五天。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen bǎ yì nián qiē chéng èrshísì duàn měi yí duàn dàyuē shíwǔ tiān
phrases.translation: They cut the year into twenty-four segments, each about fifteen days.

phrases.text: 这些名字本身就像诗:立春、惊蛰、清明、芒种、霜降、大寒。
phrases.pinyin: zhèxiē míngzi běnshēn jiù xiàng shī lìchūn jīngzhé qīngmíng mángzhòng shuāngjiàng dàhán
phrases.translation: The names themselves read like poetry: Beginning of Spring, Waking of Insects, Clear and Bright, Grain in Ear, Frost's Descent, Great Cold.

phrases.text: 惊蛰的意思是,春雷响了,冬眠的虫子被惊醒。
phrases.pinyin: jīngzhé de yìsi shì chūnléi xiǎng le dōngmián de chóngzi bèi jīngxǐng
phrases.translation: Waking of Insects means the spring thunder has sounded and the hibernating creatures are startled awake.

phrases.text: 清明前后,种瓜点豆,农民知道该下地了。
phrases.pinyin: qīngmíng qiánhòu zhòng guā diǎn dòu nóngmín zhīdào gāi xià dì le
phrases.translation: Around Clear and Bright one sows melons and beans; the farmer knows it is time to go to the fields.

phrases.text: 芒种是最忙的时候,要收麦子,又要插秧。
phrases.pinyin: mángzhòng shì zuì máng de shíhou yào shōu màizi yòu yào chā yāng
phrases.translation: Grain in Ear is the busiest time: the wheat must be reaped and the rice seedlings transplanted.

phrases.text: 霜降之后,天气转冷,树叶开始落下。
phrases.pinyin: shuāngjiàng zhīhòu tiānqì zhuǎn lěng shùyè kāishǐ luò xià
phrases.translation: After Frost's Descent the weather turns cold and the leaves begin to fall.

phrases.text: 每一个节气都对应着天上的位置和地上的农事。
phrases.pinyin: měi yí ge jiéqì dōu duìyìng zhe tiān shàng de wèizhi hé dì shàng de nóngshì
phrases.translation: Every solar term corresponds to a position in the sky and a task on the ground.

phrases.text: 古人没有精密的仪器,靠的是一代代的观察和记忆。
phrases.pinyin: gǔrén méiyǒu jīngmì de yíqì kào de shì yí dài dài de guānchá hé jìyì
phrases.translation: The ancients had no precise instruments; they relied on generations of observation and memory.

phrases.text: 他们把太阳走过的路,变成了可以背诵的句子。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen bǎ tàiyáng zǒu guò de lù biàn chéng le kěyǐ bèisòng de jùzi
phrases.translation: They turned the path the sun travelled into sentences that could be recited.

phrases.text: 今天大多数人不再种地,节气似乎离生活远了。
phrases.pinyin: jīntiān dà duōshù rén bú zài zhòng dì jiéqì sìhū lí shēnghuó yuǎn le
phrases.translation: Today most people no longer farm, and the solar terms seem remote from daily life.

phrases.text: 可是每到冬至,北方人还是会包饺子。
phrases.pinyin: kěshì měi dào dōngzhì běifāng rén háishi huì bāo jiǎozi
phrases.translation: Yet whenever Winter Solstice comes, northerners still wrap dumplings.

phrases.text: 每到清明,人们仍旧会去给祖先扫墓。
phrases.pinyin: měi dào qīngmíng rénmen réngjiù huì qù gěi zǔxiān sǎomù
phrases.translation: Whenever Clear and Bright comes, people still go to sweep their ancestors' graves.

phrases.text: 天气预报比节气准确得多,但节气里有别的东西。
phrases.pinyin: tiānqì yùbào bǐ jiéqì zhǔnquè de duō dàn jiéqì lǐ yǒu bié de dōngxi
phrases.translation: Weather forecasts are far more accurate than the solar terms, but the terms hold something else.

phrases.text: 它提醒我们,时间不是数字,而是风、雨和光的变化。
phrases.pinyin: tā tíxǐng wǒmen shíjiān bú shì shùzì ér shì fēng yǔ hé guāng de biànhuà
phrases.translation: They remind us that time is not a number but the changing of wind, rain and light.

phrases.text: 二零一六年,二十四节气被列入了世界非物质文化遗产。
phrases.pinyin: èr líng yī liù nián èrshísì jiéqì bèi liè rù le shìjiè fēi wùzhì wénhuà yíchǎn
phrases.translation: In 2016 the twenty-four solar terms were inscribed as world intangible cultural heritage.

phrases.text: 在中国的诗人里,没有谁比李白更爱月亮。
phrases.pinyin: zài Zhōngguó de shīrén lǐ méiyǒu shéi bǐ Lǐ Bái gèng ài yuèliang
phrases.translation: Among Chinese poets, none loved the moon more than Li Bai.

phrases.text: 据说他的一生写了上千首诗,其中提到月亮的有三百多处。
phrases.pinyin: jùshuō tā de yìshēng xiě le shàng qiān shǒu shī qízhōng tí dào yuèliang de yǒu sān bǎi duō chù
phrases.translation: He is said to have written a thousand poems, of which more than three hundred mention the moon.

phrases.text: 月亮是他的酒伴,也是他的镜子。
phrases.pinyin: yuèliang shì tā de jiǔ bàn yě shì tā de jìngzi
phrases.translation: The moon was his drinking companion, and also his mirror.

phrases.text: 最有名的那首只有二十个字,几乎每个中国孩子都会背。
phrases.pinyin: zuì yǒumíng de nà shǒu zhǐ yǒu èrshí ge zì jīhū měi ge Zhōngguó háizi dōu huì bèi
phrases.translation: His most famous poem is only twenty characters long, and nearly every Chinese child can recite it.

phrases.text: "床前明月光,疑是地上霜。举头望明月,低头思故乡。"
phrases.pinyin: chuáng qián míng yuè guāng yí shì dì shàng shuāng jǔ tóu wàng míng yuè dī tóu sī gùxiāng
phrases.translation: "Before my bed, the bright moonlight — I suspect it is frost on the ground. I raise my head to gaze at the bright moon; I lower my head and think of home."

phrases.text: 语言简单得像说话,却写尽了所有游子的心情。
phrases.pinyin: yǔyán jiǎndān de xiàng shuōhuà què xiě jìn le suǒyǒu yóuzǐ de xīnqíng
phrases.translation: The language is as plain as speech, yet it exhausts the feeling of everyone far from home.

phrases.text: 他一生都在路上,很少停下来。
phrases.pinyin: tā yìshēng dōu zài lù shàng hěn shǎo tíng xiàlái
phrases.translation: He spent his whole life on the road and rarely stopped.

phrases.text: 他去过长安,做过皇帝身边的官,也很快就被赶了出来。
phrases.pinyin: tā qù guo Cháng'ān zuò guo huángdì shēnbiān de guān yě hěn kuài jiù bèi gǎn le chūlái
phrases.translation: He went to Chang'an and served as an official beside the emperor — and was soon driven out.

phrases.text: 他不适合官场,正如官场不适合他。
phrases.pinyin: tā bú shìhé guānchǎng zhèngrú guānchǎng bú shìhé tā
phrases.translation: He did not suit the court, just as the court did not suit him.

phrases.text: 于是他继续漫游,喝酒,写诗,交朋友。
phrases.pinyin: yúshì tā jìxù mànyóu hē jiǔ xiě shī jiāo péngyou
phrases.translation: So he went on wandering, drinking, writing poems and making friends.

phrases.text: 有一首诗里,他一个人在花间喝酒,便邀请月亮来陪。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu yì shǒu shī lǐ tā yí ge rén zài huā jiān hē jiǔ biàn yāoqǐng yuèliang lái péi
phrases.translation: In one poem he drinks alone among the flowers and invites the moon to keep him company.

phrases.text: "举杯邀明月,对影成三人。"
phrases.pinyin: jǔ bēi yāo míng yuè duì yǐng chéng sān rén
phrases.translation: "I raise my cup to invite the bright moon; facing my shadow, we become three."

phrases.text: 孤独到极点的时候,他把孤独写成了热闹。
phrases.pinyin: gūdú dào jídiǎn de shíhou tā bǎ gūdú xiě chéng le rènao
phrases.translation: At the very extreme of loneliness, he wrote loneliness into company.

phrases.text: 传说他最后是在水中捞月时淹死的。
phrases.pinyin: chuánshuō tā zuìhòu shì zài shuǐ zhōng lāo yuè shí yān sǐ de
phrases.translation: Legend says he finally drowned while reaching into the water for the moon.

phrases.text: 这个故事多半不是真的,但人们愿意相信。
phrases.pinyin: zhè ge gùshi duōbàn bú shì zhēn de dàn rénmen yuànyì xiāngxìn
phrases.translation: This story is most likely untrue, but people are willing to believe it.

phrases.text: 因为对李白来说,为了月亮而死,似乎是最合适的结局。
phrases.pinyin: yīnwèi duì Lǐ Bái lái shuō wèile yuèliang ér sǐ sìhū shì zuì héshì de jiéjú
phrases.translation: Because for Li Bai, to die for the moon seems the most fitting ending of all.

phrases.text: 每年农历新年之前,中国会发生一场人类历史上规模最大的迁徙。
phrases.pinyin: měi nián nónglì xīnnián zhīqián Zhōngguó huì fāshēng yì chǎng rénlèi lìshǐ shàng guīmó zuì dà de qiānxǐ
phrases.translation: Before the lunar new year each year, China sees the largest migration in human history.

phrases.text: 这场迁徙有一个专门的名字,叫春运。
phrases.pinyin: zhè chǎng qiānxǐ yǒu yí ge zhuānmén de míngzi jiào chūnyùn
phrases.translation: This migration has a name of its own: chunyun, the spring transport.

phrases.text: 在四十天里,几十亿人次要在这片土地上移动。
phrases.pinyin: zài sìshí tiān lǐ jǐ shí yì réncì yào zài zhè piàn tǔdì shàng yídòng
phrases.translation: Over forty days, billions of trips are made across this land.

phrases.text: 他们大多是离开家乡去外地工作的人。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen dàduō shì líkāi jiāxiāng qù wàidì gōngzuò de rén
phrases.translation: Most of them are people who left their hometowns to work elsewhere.

phrases.text: 一年到头,只有这个时候能回去看看父母和孩子。
phrases.pinyin: yì nián dào tóu zhǐ yǒu zhè ge shíhou néng huíqù kànkan fùmǔ hé háizi
phrases.translation: All year round, this is the only time they can go back and see their parents and children.

phrases.text: 从前买票要在售票窗口排一整夜的队。
phrases.pinyin: cóngqián mǎi piào yào zài shòupiào chuāngkǒu pái yì zhěng yè de duì
phrases.translation: In the past, buying a ticket meant queueing all night at the ticket window.

phrases.text: 人们带着被子和小板凳,在寒风里守着位置。
phrases.pinyin: rénmen dài zhe bèizi hé xiǎo bǎndèng zài hánfēng lǐ shǒu zhe wèizhi
phrases.translation: People brought quilts and little stools, guarding their places in the cold wind.

phrases.text: 现在抢票在手机上进行,可是那种紧张一点也没有减少。
phrases.pinyin: xiànzài qiǎng piào zài shǒujī shàng jìnxíng kěshì nà zhǒng jǐnzhāng yìdiǎn yě méiyǒu jiǎnshǎo
phrases.translation: Now the scramble happens on phones, but the tension has not lessened in the slightest.

phrases.text: 放票的那一刻,几百万人同时点下同一个按钮。
phrases.pinyin: fàng piào de nà yí kè jǐ bǎi wàn rén tóngshí diǎn xià tóng yí ge ànniǔ
phrases.translation: At the instant tickets are released, millions press the same button at once.

phrases.text: 火车站的候车厅里,行李堆得像小山。
phrases.pinyin: huǒchē zhàn de hòuchē tīng lǐ xíngli duī de xiàng xiǎo shān
phrases.translation: In the station waiting halls, the luggage is piled up like small hills.

phrases.text: 有人扛着一整箱特产,有人抱着睡着的孩子。
phrases.pinyin: yǒu rén káng zhe yì zhěng xiāng tèchǎn yǒu rén bào zhe shuì zháo de háizi
phrases.translation: Some shoulder a whole crate of local specialities; some carry a sleeping child.

phrases.text: 也有人骑着摩托车,走上千公里的国道回家。
phrases.pinyin: yě yǒu rén qí zhe mótuōchē zǒu shàng qiān gōnglǐ de guódào huí jiā
phrases.translation: Others ride motorcycles, travelling a thousand kilometres of highway to get home.

phrases.text: 他们把这叫做"摩托大军",风吹了几天几夜。
phrases.pinyin: tāmen bǎ zhè jiàozuò mótuō dàjūn fēng chuī le jǐ tiān jǐ yè
phrases.translation: They call this the "motorcycle army", blown by the wind for days and nights.

phrases.text: 支撑着这一切的,其实只是一顿年夜饭。
phrases.pinyin: zhīchēng zhe zhè yíqiè de qíshí zhǐshì yí dùn nián yè fàn
phrases.translation: What holds all of this up is, in the end, just one New Year's Eve dinner.

phrases.text: 车到站的时候,母亲往往已经在出站口等了很久。
phrases.pinyin: chē dào zhàn de shíhou mǔqīn wǎngwǎng yǐjīng zài chū zhàn kǒu děng le hěn jiǔ
phrases.translation: When the train pulls in, the mother has usually been waiting a long time at the exit.

phrases.text: 那一刻,所有的辛苦都变得可以承受。
phrases.pinyin: nà yí kè suǒyǒu de xīnkǔ dōu biàn de kěyǐ chéngshòu
phrases.translation: In that moment, all the hardship becomes bearable.
